5.215.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
anye'pi vividhāḥ kālāḥ santi puṇyatamā dvija ..
kasmācceṃdukṣaye śrāddhaṃ viśeṣā tsamudāhṛtam.. 1 ..
5.215.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
अन्येऽपि विविधाः कालाः सन्ति पुण्यतमा द्विज ..
कस्माच्चेंदुक्षये श्राद्धं विशेषा त्समुदाहृतम्.. 1 ..
5.215.m: Ānarta said: / There are also other various times that are most meritorious, O twice-born one. / Why is śrāddha declared specifically at the waning of the moon?

5.215.s: etanme sarvamācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmune .. 2 ..
5.215.d: एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण महामुने .. 2 ..
5.215.m: Tell me all this in detail, O great sage.

5.215.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahārāja śrāddhārhāḥ saṃti bhūriśaḥ ..
kālāḥ pitṛgaṇānāṃ ca tṛptidāstuṣṭidāśca ye .. 3 ..
5.215.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाराज श्राद्धार्हाः संति भूरिशः ..
कालाः पितृगणानां च तृप्तिदास्तुष्टिदाश्च ये .. 3 ..
5.215.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / This is true, O great king; there are abundant times worthy of śrāddha / that bestow satisfaction and contentment to the hosts of ancestors:

5.215.s:
manvādyā vā yugādyāśca teṣāṃ saṃkrāṃtayo'parāḥ ..
vyatīpāto gajacchāyā grahaṇaṃ soma sūryayoḥ .. 4 ..
5.215.d:
मन्वाद्या वा युगाद्याश्च तेषां संक्रांतयोऽपराः ..
व्यतीपातो गजच्छाया ग्रहणं सोम सूर्ययोः .. 4 ..
5.215.m: The beginnings of the Manvantaras, the beginnings of the Yugas, the other transits of the sun among them, / the Vyatīpāta, the Gajacchāyā, and the eclipses of the moon and sun.

5.215.s:
eteṣu yujyate śrāddhaṃ prakartuṃ pitṛtṛptaye ..
tathā tīrthe viśeṣeṇa puṇya āyatane śubhe .. 5 ..
5.215.d:
एतेषु युज्यते श्राद्धं प्रकर्तुं पितृतृप्तये ..
तथा तीर्थे विशेषेण पुण्य आयतने शुभे .. 5 ..
5.215.m: At these, it is proper to perform a śrāddha for the satisfaction of the ancestors, / and particularly at a sacred ford, in an auspicious and holy sanctuary.

5.215.s:
śrāddhārhairbrāhmaṇaiḥ prāptairdravyairvā pitṛvallabhaiḥ ..
aparvaṇyapi kartavyaṃ sadā śrāddhaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 6 ..
5.215.d:
श्राद्धार्हैर्ब्राह्मणैः प्राप्तैर्द्रव्यैर्वा पितृवल्लभैः ..
अपर्वण्यपि कर्तव्यं सदा श्राद्धं विचक्षणैः .. 6 ..
5.215.m: When brahmins worthy of a śrāddha are found, or items dear to the ancestors, / a śrāddha must always be performed by the wise even on a non-festival day.

5.215.s:
somakṣaye viśeṣeṇa śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa ..
amā nāma rave raśmisahasrapramukhaḥ sthitaḥ .. 7 ..
5.215.d:
सोमक्षये विशेषेण शृणुष्वैकमना नृप ..
अमा नाम रवे रश्मिसहस्रप्रमुखः स्थितः .. 7 ..
5.215.m: Listen with single-minded attention, O king, concerning [the day of] the waning of the moon in particular. / The chief of the thousand rays of the sun stands by the name Amā.

5.215.s:
yasya svatejasā sūryaḥ proktastrailokyadīpakaḥ ..
tasminvasati yenenduramāvasyā tataḥ smṛtā .. 8 ..
5.215.d:
यस्य स्वतेजसा सूर्यः प्रोक्तस्त्रैलोक्यदीपकः ..
तस्मिन्वसति येनेन्दुरमावस्या ततः स्मृता .. 8 ..
5.215.m: Through its own splendor, the sun is called the illuminator of the three worlds; / because the moon dwells in that [ray], it is traditionally called the new moon (amāvasyā).

5.215.s:
akṣayā dharmakṛtye sā pitṛkṛtye viśeṣataḥ ..
agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapāstathā .. 9 ..
5.215.d:
अक्षया धर्मकृत्ये सा पितृकृत्ये विशेषतः ..
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषद आज्यपाः सोमपास्तथा .. 9 ..
5.215.m: That [day] brings inexhaustible merit in righteous deeds, especially in deeds for the ancestors. / The Agniṣvāttas, Barhiṣads, Ājyapas, and Somapas,

5.215.s:
raśmipā upahūtāśca tathaivāyaṃtunāḥ pare ..
tathā śrāddhabhujaścānye smṛtā nāndīmukhā nṛpa .. 6.216.10 ..
5.215.d:
रश्मिपा उपहूताश्च तथैवायंतुनाः परे ..
तथा श्राद्धभुजश्चान्ये स्मृता नान्दीमुखा नृप .. 6.216.10 ..
5.215.m: the Raśmipas, the Upahūtas, and likewise the Āyantunas beyond, / and the other eaters of the śrāddha, known as the Nāndīmukhas, O king—

5.215.s:
ete pitṛgaṇāḥ khyātā nava devasamudbhavāḥ ..
ādityā vasavo rudrā nāsatyāvaśvināvapi .. 11 ..
5.215.d:
एते पितृगणाः ख्याता नव देवसमुद्भवाः ..
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा नासत्यावश्विनावपि .. 11 ..
5.215.m: these nine hosts of ancestors are known to have originated from the gods; / as well as the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and the two Nāsatyas, the Aśvins.

5.215.s:
santarpayanti te caitānmuktvā nāndīmukhānpitṝn ..
brahmaṇā te samādiṣṭāḥ pitaro nṛpasattama .. 12 ..
5.215.d:
सन्तर्पयन्ति ते चैतान्मुक्त्वा नान्दीमुखान्पितॄन् ..
ब्रह्मणा ते समादिष्टाः पितरो नृपसत्तम .. 12 ..
5.215.m: And they satisfy these [ancestors], except for the Nāndīmukha ancestors. / These ancestors were ordained by Brahmā, O best of kings.

5.215.s: tānsaṃtarpya tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kurute padmasaṃbhavaḥ .. .. 13 ..
5.215.d: तान्संतर्प्य ततः सृष्टिं कुरुते पद्मसंभवः .. .. 13 ..
5.215.m: Having satisfied them, the lotus-born [Brahmā] then carries out creation.

5.215.s:
pitaro anye'pi martyā nivasanti triviṣṭape ..
dvividhāste pradṛśyaṃte sukhino'sukhinaḥ pare .. 14 ..
5.215.d:
पितरो अन्येऽपि मर्त्या निवसन्ति त्रिविष्टपे ..
द्विविधास्ते प्रदृश्यंते सुखिनोऽसुखिनः परे .. 14 ..
5.215.m: Other ancestors, mortals too, dwell in heaven; / they are seen to be of two kinds: some happy, others unhappy.

5.215.s:
yebhyaḥ śrāddhāni yacchaṃti martya loke svavaṃśajāḥ ..
te sarve tatra saṃhṛṣṭā devavanmuditāḥ sthitāḥ .. 15 ..
5.215.d:
येभ्यः श्राद्धानि यच्छंति मर्त्य लोके स्ववंशजाः ..
ते सर्वे तत्र संहृष्टा देववन्मुदिताः स्थिताः .. 15 ..
5.215.m: Those to whom their descendants in the mortal world offer śrāddhas / remain there entirely delighted, rejoicing like gods.

5.215.s:
yeṣāṃ yacchanti te naiva kiṃcitkiñcitsvavaṃśajāḥ ..
kṣutpipāsākulā ste ca dṛśyante bahuduḥkhitāḥ .. 16 ..
5.215.d:
येषां यच्छन्ति ते नैव किंचित्किञ्चित्स्ववंशजाः ..
क्षुत्पिपासाकुला स्ते च दृश्यन्ते बहुदुःखिताः .. 16 ..
5.215.m: Those to whom their descendants offer nothing at all / are seen to be deeply distressed, afflicted with hunger and thirst.

5.215.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya pitaraḥ surapūjitāḥ ..
agniṣvāttādayaḥ sarve tridaśendramupasthitāḥ .. 17 ..
5.215.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य पितरः सुरपूजिताः ..
अग्निष्वात्तादयः सर्वे त्रिदशेन्द्रमुपस्थिताः .. 17 ..
5.215.m: Now, at a certain time, the ancestors worshipped by the gods, / the Agniṣvāttas and all the others, approached the lord of the gods.

5.215.s:
bhaktyā dṛṣṭā mahārāja sahasrākṣeṇa pūjitāḥ ..
tathānyairvibudhaiḥ sarvaiḥ prasthitāḥ sve niketane .. 18 ..
5.215.d:
भक्त्या दृष्टा महाराज सहस्राक्षेण पूजिताः ..
तथान्यैर्विबुधैः सर्वैः प्रस्थिताः स्वे निकेतने .. 18 ..
5.215.m: Beheld with devotion, O great king, and worshipped by the thousand-eyed [Indra] / and by all the other gods, they departed for their own abode,

5.215.s:
pitṛlokaṃ mahārāja durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi ..
tāndṛṣṭvā prasthitānrājanpitaro martyasaṃbhavāḥ .. 19 ..
5.215.d:
पितृलोकं महाराज दुर्लभं त्रिदशैरपि ..
तान्दृष्ट्वा प्रस्थितान्राजन्पितरो मर्त्यसंभवाः .. 19 ..
5.215.m: the world of the ancestors, O great king, hard to attain even for the gods. / Seeing them departing, O king, the ancestors of mortal origin,

5.215.s:
kṣutpipāsārditā ye ca ta ūcurdainyamāśritāḥ ..
stutvā'tha sustavairdivyaiḥ pitṛsūktaiśca pārthiva .. .. 6.216.20 ..
5.215.d:
क्षुत्पिपासार्दिता ये च त ऊचुर्दैन्यमाश्रिताः ..
स्तुत्वाऽथ सुस्तवैर्दिव्यैः पितृसूक्तैश्च पार्थिव .. .. 6.216.20 ..
5.215.m: who were afflicted with hunger and thirst, resorted to wretchedness and spoke to them, / having praised [them] with divine eulogies and ancestral hymns, O king,

5.215.s:
vedoktairaparaiścaiva pitṛtuṣṭikaraiḥ paraiḥ ..
tataḥ procuśca saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pitarastānsurodbhavāḥ .. 21 ..
5.215.d:
वेदोक्तैरपरैश्चैव पितृतुष्टिकरैः परैः ..
ततः प्रोचुश्च संहृष्टाः पितरस्तान्सुरोद्भवाः .. 21 ..
5.215.m: and with other supreme Vedic verses that cause pleasure to the ancestors. / Then the delighted ancestors born of the gods said to them:

5.215.s:
prasannāḥ smo vayaṃ sarve yuṣmākaṃ śaṃsitavratāḥ ..
tasmādbrūta vayaṃ yena yacchāmo vo hṛdi sthitam .. 22 ..
5.215.d:
प्रसन्नाः स्मो वयं सर्वे युष्माकं शंसितव्रताः ..
तस्माद्ब्रूत वयं येन यच्छामो वो हृदि स्थितम् .. 22 ..
5.215.m: “We are all pleased with you, who have fulfilled your vows. / Therefore speak, so that we may grant what is in your hearts.”

5.215.s:
.. pitara ūcuḥ .. ..
vayaṃ hi pitaraḥ khyātā manuṣyāṇāmihāgatāḥ ..
svarge svakarmaṇā nityaṃ nivasāma suraiḥ saha .. 23 ..
5.215.d:
.. पितर ऊचुः .. ..
वयं हि पितरः ख्याता मनुष्याणामिहागताः ..
स्वर्गे स्वकर्मणा नित्यं निवसाम सुरैः सह .. 23 ..
5.215.m: The ancestors said: / “We are known as the ancestors of human beings who have come here; / we dwell continually in heaven with the gods on account of our own deeds,

5.215.s:
vimāneṣu vicitreṣu saṃsthitāḥ sarvatodiśam ..
vāṃchiteṣu ca lokeṣu yāmo dhvajapatākiṣu .. 24 ..
5.215.d:
विमानेषु विचित्रेषु संस्थिताः सर्वतोदिशम् ..
वांछितेषु च लोकेषु यामो ध्वजपताकिषु .. 24 ..
5.215.m: seated in diverse aerial chariots in every direction, / and we go to desired worlds adorned with flags and banners,

5.215.s:
haṃsabarhiṇa juṣṭeṣu saṃsevyeṣvapsarogaṇaiḥ ..
gandharvairgīyamānāśca stūyamānāśca guhyakaiḥ .. 25 ..
5.215.d:
हंसबर्हिण जुष्टेषु संसेव्येष्वप्सरोगणैः ..
गन्धर्वैर्गीयमानाश्च स्तूयमानाश्च गुह्यकैः .. 25 ..
5.215.m: frequented by swans and peacocks, served by troops of apsarases, / sung to by gandharvas, and praised by guhyakas.

5.215.s:
paraṃ santiṣṭhamānānāmasmākaṃ tridaśaiḥ saha ..
atyarthaṃ jāyate tīvrā kṣutpipāsā sudāruṇā .. 26 ..
5.215.d:
परं सन्तिष्ठमानानामस्माकं त्रिदशैः सह ..
अत्यर्थं जायते तीव्रा क्षुत्पिपासा सुदारुणा .. 26 ..
5.215.m: Yet, even as we abide alongside the gods, / an exceedingly intense, dreadful hunger and thirst arises [in us],

5.215.s:
yasyā manyāmahe citte vahnimadhyagatā vayam ..
bhakṣayāmaḥ kimetānhi pakṣiṇo vividhānapi ..
haṃsādīnmadhurālāpānkiṃ vā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇān .. 27 ..
5.215.d:
यस्या मन्यामहे चित्ते वह्निमध्यगता वयम् ..
भक्षयामः किमेतान्हि पक्षिणो विविधानपि ..
हंसादीन्मधुरालापान्किं वा चाप्सरसां गणान् .. 27 ..
5.215.m: from which we think in our minds that we are standing in the midst of fire: / ‘Shall we eat these various birds, / swans and the like of sweet speech, or the hosts of apsarases?’

5.215.s:
yadi kaścitkṣudhāviṣṭaḥ kañcidādāya pakṣiṇam ..
gupto gṛhṇāti bhakṣārthaṃ hantuṃ śakto'pi so'pi na .. 28 ..
5.215.d:
यदि कश्चित्क्षुधाविष्टः कञ्चिदादाय पक्षिणम् ..
गुप्तो गृह्णाति भक्षार्थं हन्तुं शक्तोऽपि सोऽपि न .. 28 ..
5.215.m: Even if someone, overcome with hunger, secretly seizes a bird / to eat it, he is not able to kill it.

5.215.s:
ajarāścāmarāścaiva svarge ye svargagāḥ khagāḥ ..
tathā manoramā vṛkṣā nandanādi vaneṣu ca .. 29 ..
5.215.d:
अजराश्चामराश्चैव स्वर्गे ये स्वर्गगाः खगाः ..
तथा मनोरमा वृक्षा नन्दनादि वनेषु च .. 29 ..
5.215.m: For the birds that move in heaven are free from old age and immortal, / and likewise the delightful trees in the Nandana grove and elsewhere,

5.215.s:
phalitā ye pradṛśyaṃte prāpyāṃścāpi manoramāḥ ..
tatphalāni vayaṃ sarve gṛhṇīmaḥ pitaro yadi .. 6.216.30 ..
5.215.d:
फलिता ये प्रदृश्यंते प्राप्यांश्चापि मनोरमाः ..
तत्फलानि वयं सर्वे गृह्णीमः पितरो यदि .. 6.216.30 ..
5.215.m: which are seen to be fruitful, accessible, and delightful— / if all of us ancestors try to take their fruits,

5.215.s:
na truṭaṃtyapi yatnena samākṛṣṭāni tānyapi ..
etallekhāpagātoyaṃ tṛṣārttā yadi yatnataḥ ..
prapibāmo na hasteṣu tacca toyaṃ punaḥ spṛśet .. 31 ..
5.215.d:
न त्रुटंत्यपि यत्नेन समाकृष्टानि तान्यपि ..
एतल्लेखापगातोयं तृषार्त्ता यदि यत्नतः ..
प्रपिबामो न हस्तेषु तच्च तोयं पुनः स्पृशेत् .. 31 ..
5.215.m: they do not break off, even when pulled with effort. / If, tormented by thirst, we try with effort to drink this water of the river of the gods, / that water does not even touch our hands.

5.215.s:
bhuṃjānaśca na ko'pyatra dṛśyate'tra pibannapi ..
tasmāttriviṣṭapāvāso hyasmākaṃ ghoradāruṇaḥ .. 32 ..
5.215.d:
भुंजानश्च न कोऽप्यत्र दृश्यतेऽत्र पिबन्नपि ..
तस्मात्त्रिविष्टपावासो ह्यस्माकं घोरदारुणः .. 32 ..
5.215.m: No one here is seen eating, nor is anyone seen drinking; / therefore our dwelling in heaven is terribly dreadful.

5.215.s:
ete suragaṇāḥ sarve ye cānye guhyakādayaḥ ..
dṛśyaṃte'tra vimānasthā sarve saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ .. 33 ..
5.215.d:
एते सुरगणाः सर्वे ये चान्ये गुह्यकादयः ..
दृश्यंतेऽत्र विमानस्था सर्वे संहृष्टमानसाः .. 33 ..
5.215.m: All these hosts of gods and others, such as the guhyakas, / are seen seated in aerial chariots, all with joyful minds,

5.215.s:
kṣutpipāsāparityaktā nānābhogasamāśrayāḥ ..
kadācicca vayaṃ sarve bhavāmastādṛśā iva .. 34 ..
5.215.d:
क्षुत्पिपासापरित्यक्ता नानाभोगसमाश्रयाः ..
कदाचिच्च वयं सर्वे भवामस्तादृशा इव .. 34 ..
5.215.m: free from hunger and thirst, enjoying various pleasures. / Sometimes all of us become like them,

5.215.s:
kṣutpipāsāparityaktāḥ satoṣaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ..
tatkiṃ kāraṇametadyatkṣutpi pāsā prajāyate .. 35 ..
5.215.d:
क्षुत्पिपासापरित्यक्ताः सतोषं परमं गताः ..
तत्किं कारणमेतद्यत्क्षुत्पि पासा प्रजायते .. 35 ..
5.215.m: free from hunger and thirst, having attained supreme contentment. / What is the reason for this, that hunger and thirst then arise?

5.215.s:
ākasmikī ca bādhā naḥ kadācinna praṇaśyati ..
tathā kuruta bhadraṃ vo yathā tuṣṭiḥ prajāyate .. 36 ..
5.215.d:
आकस्मिकी च बाधा नः कदाचिन्न प्रणश्यति ..
तथा कुरुत भद्रं वो यथा तुष्टिः प्रजायते .. 36 ..
5.215.m: And our sudden affliction never disappears. / Act in such a way—blessings to you—that satisfaction arises,

5.215.s:
śāśvatī no yathā'nyeṣāṃ devānāṃ svargavāsinām ..
yūyaṃ hi pitaro yasmāddevānāṃ bhāvitātmanām .. 37 ..
5.215.d:
शाश्वती नो यथाऽन्येषां देवानां स्वर्गवासिनाम् ..
यूयं हि पितरो यस्माद्देवानां भावितात्मनाम् .. 37 ..
5.215.m: eternal for us, just as for other gods dwelling in heaven. / For since you are the ancestors of the gods of purified soul,

5.215.s:
vayaṃ caiva manuṣyāṇāṃ tena vaḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. ..
.. pitara ūcuḥ .. ..
asmākamapi caivaiṣā kaṣṭāvasthā prajāyate .. 38 ..
5.215.d:
वयं चैव मनुष्याणां तेन वः शरणं गताः .. ..
.. पितर ऊचुः .. ..
अस्माकमपि चैवैषा कष्टावस्था प्रजायते .. 38 ..
5.215.m: and we are [the ancestors] of human beings, we have therefore taken refuge in you.” / The ancestors said: / “Even for us this difficult condition arises

5.215.s:
śakrādyā vibudhā vyagrāḥ śrāddhaṃ yacchaṃti no yadā ..
tataścāgatya tānsarve devānsaṃprārthayāmahe .. 39 ..
5.215.d:
शक्राद्या विबुधा व्यग्राः श्राद्धं यच्छंति नो यदा ..
ततश्चागत्य तान्सर्वे देवान्संप्रार्थयामहे .. 39 ..
5.215.m: when the gods, Śakra and others, being busy, do not offer us the śrāddha. / Then we go and petition all those gods;

5.215.s:
tatastṛptiṃ pragacchāmastairdevaistarpitā vayam ..
yuṣmākaṃ vaṃśajā ye ca prayacchaṃti samāhitāḥ .. 6.216.40 ..
5.215.d:
ततस्तृप्तिं प्रगच्छामस्तैर्देवैस्तर्पिता वयम् ..
युष्माकं वंशजा ये च प्रयच्छंति समाहिताः .. 6.216.40 ..
5.215.m: then we attain satisfaction, satisfied by those gods. / And those to whom your descendants offer with concentrated mind—

5.215.s:
kathaṃ na tṛptimāyātāste sarve taiḥ pratarpitāḥ ..
yatra pramādibhirvaṃśyairna tarpyaṃte kathaṃcana .. 41 ..
5.215.d:
कथं न तृप्तिमायातास्ते सर्वे तैः प्रतर्पिताः ..
यत्र प्रमादिभिर्वंश्यैर्न तर्प्यंते कथंचन .. 41 ..
5.215.m: how do they not attain satisfaction, being fully satisfied by them? / But where they are not satisfied in any way by careless descendants,

5.215.s:
kṣutpipāsākulāḥ sarve te tadā syurna saṃśayaḥ ..
kiṃ punarnarakasthā ye dharmarājaniveśane .. 42 ..
5.215.d:
क्षुत्पिपासाकुलाः सर्वे ते तदा स्युर्न संशयः ..
किं पुनर्नरकस्था ये धर्मराजनिवेशने .. 42 ..
5.215.m: they would then undoubtedly all be overcome by hunger and thirst. / What more can be said of those in hell, in the abode of the King of Dharma?

5.215.s:
etaddhi kāraṇaṃ proktaṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca kathaṃcana ..
kṣutpipāsodbhavaṃ raudraṃ yuṣmābhiryadudīritam .. 43 ..
5.215.d:
एतद्धि कारणं प्रोक्तं युष्माकं च कथंचन ..
क्षुत्पिपासोद्भवं रौद्रं युष्माभिर्यदुदीरितम् .. 43 ..
5.215.m: Indeed, this reason has somehow been stated for you / regarding the fierce arising of hunger and thirst which was mentioned by you.

5.215.s:
tadasmākaṃ vibhāgaṃ cedyūyaṃ yacchata sattamāḥ ..
sarve kavyasya dattasya tatkurmo vai hitaṃ śubham .. 44 ..
5.215.d:
तदस्माकं विभागं चेद्यूयं यच्छत सत्तमाः ..
सर्वे कव्यस्य दत्तस्य तत्कुर्मो वै हितं शुभम् .. 44 ..
5.215.m: Therefore, if you give a share to us, O best of beings, / from all the ancestral food that is given, we will certainly bring about your auspicious welfare,

5.215.s:
brahmāṇaṃ prārthayitvā ca svayaṃ gatvā tadaṃtikam..
bāḍhamityeva tairukte tata ādāya tānapi .. 45 ..
5.215.d:
ब्रह्माणं प्रार्थयित्वा च स्वयं गत्वा तदंतिकम्..
बाढमित्येव तैरुक्ते तत आदाय तानपि .. 45 ..
5.215.m: having petitioned Brahmā after going to his presence ourselves.” / When they said, “So be it,” then, taking them along,

5.215.s:
divyāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ prāptā vidheḥ sadanamuttamam ..
nāṃdīmukhānpuraskṛtya pitṝnyāṃstarpayedvidhiḥ .. 46 ..
5.215.d:
दिव्याः पितृगणाः प्राप्ता विधेः सदनमुत्तमम् ..
नांदीमुखान्पुरस्कृत्य पितॄन्यांस्तर्पयेद्विधिः .. 46 ..
5.215.m: the divine hosts of ancestors reached the supreme abode of Brahmā, / placing at their head the Nāndīmukha ancestors whom Brahmā satisfies

5.215.s:
sṛṣṭikāle tu saṃprāpte vṛddhikāmaḥ sureśvaraḥ ..
atha taiḥ saha te sarve stutvā taṃ kamalāsanam ..
praṇipatya sthitāḥ sarve pitaro vinayānvitāḥ .. 47 ..
5.215.d:
सृष्टिकाले तु संप्राप्ते वृद्धिकामः सुरेश्वरः ..
अथ तैः सह ते सर्वे स्तुत्वा तं कमलासनम् ..
प्रणिपत्य स्थिताः सर्वे पितरो विनयान्विताः .. 47 ..
5.215.m: when the time of creation arrives, the lord of gods desiring increase. / Then, having praised the lotus-seated one together with them, / having bowed down, all the ancestors stood humbly.

5.215.s:
pitṝṃstānvinayopetānpraṇipātapuraḥsarān ..
vidhiḥ provāca rājeṃdra sāṃtvayañślakṣṇayā girā .. 48 ..
5.215.d:
पितॄंस्तान्विनयोपेतान्प्रणिपातपुरःसरान् ..
विधिः प्रोवाच राजेंद्र सांत्वयञ्श्लक्ष्णया गिरा .. 48 ..
5.215.m: To those ancestors, full of humility, who had bowed down before him, / Brahmā spoke, O lord of kings, soothing them with a gentle voice.

5.215.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ pitaraḥ sarve samāyātā mamāṃtikam ..
devatānāṃ mayā sārdhaṃ saṃpūjyāḥ sarvadā sthitāḥ .. 49 ..
5.215.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
किमर्थं पितरः सर्वे समायाता ममांतिकम् ..
देवतानां मया सार्धं संपूज्याः सर्वदा स्थिताः .. 49 ..
5.215.m: Brahmā said: / “For what purpose have all you ancestors come into my presence? / You remain forever worthy of worship by the deities along with me.

5.215.s:
tathānye'pi ca dṛśyaṃte yuṣmābhiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ ..
ya ete mānavā kārāḥ svalpatejonvitāḥ sthitāḥ .. 6.216.50 ..
5.215.d:
तथान्येऽपि च दृश्यंते युष्माभिः सह संगताः ..
य एते मानवा काराः स्वल्पतेजोन्विताः स्थिताः .. 6.216.50 ..
5.215.m: Likewise, others too are seen gathered together with you, / who have human forms and possess little splendor.”

5.215.s:
.. pitara ūcuḥ .. ..
pitaro mānavā hyete svargaṃ prāptāḥ svakarmabhiḥ ..
devānāṃ madhyasaṃsthāśca pīḍyaṃte kṣutpipāsayā .. 51 ..
5.215.d:
.. पितर ऊचुः .. ..
पितरो मानवा ह्येते स्वर्गं प्राप्ताः स्वकर्मभिः ..
देवानां मध्यसंस्थाश्च पीड्यंते क्षुत्पिपासया .. 51 ..
5.215.m: The ancestors said: / “These are indeed human ancestors who attained heaven by their own deeds; / yet, staying in the midst of the gods, they are tormented by hunger and thirst.

5.215.s:
yadā yacchaṃti no vaṃśyāḥ kavyaṃ caiva pramādataḥ ..
tadā gacchaṃti no tṛptiṃ yānairyāṃti yathā surāḥ .. 52 ..
5.215.d:
यदा यच्छंति नो वंश्याः कव्यं चैव प्रमादतः ..
तदा गच्छंति नो तृप्तिं यानैर्यांति यथा सुराः .. 52 ..
5.215.m: When through negligence their descendants do not offer ancestral food, / then they do not attain satisfaction, whereas with vehicles they move about like the gods.”

5.215.s:
tadaitaiḥ prārthanā'smākaṃ kṛtā śāśvatatṛptaye ..
na ca śaktā vayaṃ dātuṃ tena tvāṃ samupasthitāḥ .. 53 ..
5.215.d:
तदैतैः प्रार्थनाऽस्माकं कृता शाश्वततृप्तये ..
न च शक्ता वयं दातुं तेन त्वां समुपस्थिताः .. 53 ..
5.215.m: Therefore, they made a request to us for eternal satisfaction, / and we are not able to grant it; hence we have approached you.

5.215.s:
yathā syurdevatā vyagrāstadā'smākamapi prabho. ..
kavyaṃ vinā bhavedeṣā daśā kaṣṭā sureśvara .. 54 ..
5.215.d:
यथा स्युर्देवता व्यग्रास्तदाऽस्माकमपि प्रभो. ..
कव्यं विना भवेदेषा दशा कष्टा सुरेश्वर .. 54 ..
5.215.m: Just as the gods might become distraught, O Lord, so for us as well / without ancestral food, this miserable state would occur, O lord of the gods.

5.215.s:
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ naḥ samemetaiḥ sureśvara ..
yathā syācchāśvatī tṛptiḥ svasthānasthāyināmapi.. .. 55 ..
5.215.d:
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं नः समेमेतैः सुरेश्वर ..
यथा स्याच्छाश्वती तृप्तिः स्वस्थानस्थायिनामपि.. .. 55 ..
5.215.m: Therefore grant us your grace together with these, O lord of the gods, / so that there may be eternal satisfaction even for those dwelling in their own realm.

5.215.s:
ete'smākaṃ pradāsyaṃti kavyaṃ yannijavaṃśajaiḥ ..
pradattaṃ tena saṃprāptā vayaṃ deva tvadantikam .. 56 ..
5.215.d:
एतेऽस्माकं प्रदास्यंति कव्यं यन्निजवंशजैः ..
प्रदत्तं तेन संप्राप्ता वयं देव त्वदन्तिकम् .. 56 ..
5.215.m: They will give us the ancestral offering which was offered by their descendants; / for that reason, O god, we have arrived in your presence.

5.215.s:
devānāṃ caiva yatkavyaṃ tannāsmākaṃ pratṛ ptaye ..
yataḥ kriyāvihīnaṃ tanna teṣāṃ vidyate kriyā .. 57 ..
5.215.d:
देवानां चैव यत्कव्यं तन्नास्माकं प्रतृ प्तये ..
यतः क्रियाविहीनं तन्न तेषां विद्यते क्रिया .. 57 ..
5.215.m: And whatever ancestral offering belongs to the gods, that is not for our satisfaction; / because it is devoid of ritual, [as] no ritual action exists for them.

5.215.s:
pitṝnuddiśya yatkavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradīyate ..
snātairdhautāṃbarairmartyaistadbhavettṛptidaṃ mahat .. .. 58 ..
5.215.d:
पितॄनुद्दिश्य यत्कव्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदीयते ..
स्नातैर्धौतांबरैर्मर्त्यैस्तद्भवेत्तृप्तिदं महत् .. .. 58 ..
5.215.m: The ancestral offering dedicated to the ancestors that is given to brahmins / by mortals who have bathed and washed their garments, that becomes greatly satisfying.

5.215.s:
pitṝṇāṃ sarvadeveśa ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ ..
na snātasyādhikāro'sti devānāṃ ca dvijātivat .. 59 ..
5.215.d:
पितॄणां सर्वदेवेश इत्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः ..
न स्नातस्याधिकारोऽस्ति देवानां च द्विजातिवत् .. 59 ..
5.215.m: O lord of all gods, this is the Vedic revelation concerning the ancestors: / there is no authority [in rites] for one who has not bathed, nor for the gods as there is for the twice-born.

5.215.s: pīyūṣamapi tairdattaṃ tena naḥ syānna tṛptaye .. 6.216.60 ..
5.215.d: पीयूषमपि तैर्दत्तं तेन नः स्यान्न तृप्तये .. 6.216.60 ..
5.215.m: Even nectar given by them would therefore not lead to our satisfaction.

5.215.s:
tasmānmānuṣadattairno yathā kavye prajāyate ..
svargasthānāṃ parā tṛptiḥ samametaistathā kuru .. 61 ..
5.215.d:
तस्मान्मानुषदत्तैर्नो यथा कव्ये प्रजायते ..
स्वर्गस्थानां परा तृप्तिः सममेतैस्तथा कुरु .. 61 ..
5.215.m: Therefore, arrange it together with these so that through ancestral offerings given by mortals, / supreme satisfaction will arise for us who dwell in heaven.

5.215.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā suciraṃ dhyātvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
tānuvāca tataḥ sarvānpitṝnpārthivasattama ..62..
5.215.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सुचिरं ध्यात्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ..
तानुवाच ततः सर्वान्पितॄन्पार्थिवसत्तम ..62..
5.215.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Hearing that and meditating for a long time, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / then spoke to all those ancestors, O best of kings.

5.215.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
asmiṃstretāyuge saṃjñā havyakavyasamudbhavā..
saṃprayātā yuge yugme kalau na prabhaviṣyati .. 63 ..
5.215.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
अस्मिंस्त्रेतायुगे संज्ञा हव्यकव्यसमुद्भवा..
संप्रयाता युगे युग्मे कलौ न प्रभविष्यति .. 63 ..
5.215.m: Brahmā said: / In this Tretāyuga, the ritual designation arising from oblations to gods and ancestors / has passed on; in the pair of yugas, in the Kali [age], it will not prevail.

5.215.s:
yathāyathā yugānāṃ ca hrāsa eṣa bhaviṣyati ..
tathātathā janā duṣṭā bhaviṣyaṃtyanyabhaktikāḥ .. .. 64 ..
5.215.d:
यथायथा युगानां च ह्रास एष भविष्यति ..
तथातथा जना दुष्टा भविष्यंत्यन्यभक्तिकाः .. .. 64 ..
5.215.m: In whatever manner this decline of the yugas will occur, / in that very manner people will become wicked and devoted to other [gods].

5.215.s:
na dāsyaṃti yathoktāni te kavyāni kathaṃcana ..
tataḥ kaṣṭatarā'vasthā pitṝṇāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati .. 65 ..
5.215.d:
न दास्यंति यथोक्तानि ते कव्यानि कथंचन ..
ततः कष्टतराऽवस्था पितॄणां संभविष्यति .. 65 ..
5.215.m: They will not give the prescribed ancestral offerings in any way; / therefore an even more miserable condition will befall the ancestors.

5.215.s:
tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi sukhopāyaṃ śarīriṇām ..
yena santarpitā yūyaṃ parāṃ tṛptimavāpsyatha .. 66 ..
5.215.d:
तस्मादहं करिष्यामि सुखोपायं शरीरिणाम् ..
येन सन्तर्पिता यूयं परां तृप्तिमवाप्स्यथ .. 66 ..
5.215.m: Therefore I will make an easy means for embodied beings / by which, you being propitiated, you will attain supreme satisfaction.

5.215.s:
pituḥ pitāmahasyaiva tatpituśca tataḥ param..
samuddeśena dattena brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prabhaktitaḥ .. 67 ..
5.215.d:
पितुः पितामहस्यैव तत्पितुश्च ततः परम्..
समुद्देशेन दत्तेन ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रभक्तितः .. 67 ..
5.215.m: When an offering is given with great devotion to brahmins / with dedication to the father, the grandfather, and beyond him to his father,

5.215.s:
sarveṣāṃ syātparā tṛptiryāvanmāṃ pitaro'dhunā ..
tathā mātāmahānāṃ ca pakṣe nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ .. 68 ..
5.215.d:
सर्वेषां स्यात्परा तृप्तिर्यावन्मां पितरोऽधुना ..
तथा मातामहानां च पक्षे नास्त्यत्र संशयः .. 68 ..
5.215.m: there will be supreme satisfaction for all of them up to me, O ancestors, now; / likewise, there is no doubt in this regard on the side of maternal grandfathers.

5.215.s:
tribhiḥ santarpitāste'pi tarpitāḥ syurmamāvadhi ..
yuṣmākaṃ tṛptaye yaśca sukhopāyo bhaviṣyati .. 69 ..
5.215.d:
त्रिभिः सन्तर्पितास्तेऽपि तर्पिताः स्युर्ममावधि ..
युष्माकं तृप्तये यश्च सुखोपायो भविष्यति .. 69 ..
5.215.m: Being propitiated through three [generations], they too would be propitiated right up to me. / And what the easy means for your satisfaction will be,

5.215.s:
taṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ mahābhāgā gadato mama sāṃpratam ..
pitṝnannena yenaiva samuddiśya dvijottamān.. 6.216.70 ..
5.215.d:
तं शृणुध्वं महाभागा गदतो मम सांप्रतम् ..
पितॄनन्नेन येनैव समुद्दिश्य द्विजोत्तमान्.. 6.216.70 ..
5.215.m: listen to that, O fortunate ones, as I now explain it: / with whatever food, dedicating it to the ancestors, [they will honor] the best of twice-born,

5.215.s:
tarpayiṣyaṃti tenaiva piṇḍāndāsyaṃti bhaktitaḥ ..
tannāmnā tena vastṛptiḥ śāśvatī saṃbhaviṣyati .. 71 ..
5.215.d:
तर्पयिष्यंति तेनैव पिण्डान्दास्यंति भक्तितः ..
तन्नाम्ना तेन वस्तृप्तिः शाश्वती संभविष्यति .. 71 ..
5.215.m: they will satisfy [them] with that very [food] and offer rice balls with devotion; / through their names, eternal satisfaction will arise for you by that.

5.215.s: tasmādgacchata santuṣṭāḥ svāni sthānāni pūrvajāḥ .. 72 ..
5.215.d: तस्माद्गच्छत सन्तुष्टाः स्वानि स्थानानि पूर्वजाः .. 72 ..
5.215.m: Therefore depart, contented, to your own realms, O forebears!

5.215.s:
tataste sahitāstaistu svāni sthānāni bhejire ..
vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāśairgatvā pārthivasattama .. 73 ..
5.215.d:
ततस्ते सहितास्तैस्तु स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे ..
विमानैः सूर्यसंकाशैर्गत्वा पार्थिवसत्तम .. 73 ..
5.215.m: Then, together with them, they returned to their own abodes, / traveling in aerial chariots resembling the sun, O best of kings.

5.215.s:
atha saṃgacchatā rājankālena mahatā tataḥ ..
taccāpi na daduḥ śrāddhaṃ martyāstripuruṣaṃ ca yat .. 74 ..
5.215.d:
अथ संगच्छता राजन्कालेन महता ततः ..
तच्चापि न ददुः श्राद्धं मर्त्यास्त्रिपुरुषं च यत् .. 74 ..
5.215.m: Then, O king, as a long time passed after that, / mortals did not offer even that śrāddha for three generations.

5.215.s:
nityaṃ pitṝnsamuddiśya bahavo'tra narādhipa ..
kavyabhāgānpunasteṣāṃ tathā pūrvaṃ yathā nṛpa .. 75 ..
5.215.d:
नित्यं पितॄन्समुद्दिश्य बहवोऽत्र नराधिप ..
कव्यभागान्पुनस्तेषां तथा पूर्वं यथा नृप .. 75 ..
5.215.m: O ruler of men, [neglecting] to regularly dedicate the portions of ancestral food / to the ancestors here, many [failed to do so] as before, O king.

5.215.s:
kṣutpipāsodbhavāpīḍā mahatī samajāyata ..
teṣāṃ ca daivikānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ nṛpasattama .. 76 ..
5.215.d:
क्षुत्पिपासोद्भवापीडा महती समजायत ..
तेषां च दैविकानां च पितॄणां नृपसत्तम .. 76 ..
5.215.m: A great affliction arising from hunger and thirst was born, / both for them and for the divine ancestors, O best of kings.

5.215.s:
sametyātha punaḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..
procuśca praṇipatyoccaiḥ sudīnāḥ prapitāmaham.. 77 ..
5.215.d:
समेत्याथ पुनः सर्वे ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः ..
प्रोचुश्च प्रणिपत्योच्चैः सुदीनाः प्रपितामहम्.. 77 ..
5.215.m: Assembling once more, they all went to Brahmā for refuge, / and bowing down, utterly wretched, they spoke aloud to the great-grandfather:

5.215.s:
bhagavanna prayacchaṃti nityaṃ no vaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ ..
śrāddhāni dauḥsthyamāpannāstena sīdāmahe vibho .. 78 ..
5.215.d:
भगवन्न प्रयच्छंति नित्यं नो वंशसंभवाः ..
श्राद्धानि दौःस्थ्यमापन्नास्तेन सीदामहे विभो .. 78 ..
5.215.m: "O Lord, those born in our lineage do not offer śrāddha rites regularly; / fallen into distress, therefore we are perishing, O almighty one.

5.215.s:
yathā pūrvaṃ tathā deva tadupāyaṃ pracintaya ..
kaṃcidyena daridrā vai prīṇayaṃti ca te pitṝn ..79..
5.215.d:
यथा पूर्वं तथा देव तदुपायं प्रचिन्तय ..
कंचिद्येन दरिद्रा वै प्रीणयंति च ते पितॄन् ..79..
5.215.m: O god, devise some means for this just as before, / by which even poor people may please the ancestors."

5.215.s:
bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tānāha prapitāmahaḥ ..
kṛpāviṣṭo mahārāja sarvānpitṛgaṇāṃstathā .. 6.216.80 ..
5.215.d:
भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तानाह प्रपितामहः ..
कृपाविष्टो महाराज सर्वान्पितृगणांस्तथा .. 6.216.80 ..
5.215.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Hearing those words of theirs, the great-grandfather, / filled with compassion, then spoke to all the hosts of ancestors, O great king:

5.215.s:
satyametanmahābhāgā dauḥsthyaṃ yāṃti dinedine ..
janā yathāyathā yāti yugaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ .. 81 ..
5.215.d:
सत्यमेतन्महाभागा दौःस्थ्यं यांति दिनेदिने ..
जना यथायथा याति युगं श्रेष्ठं च पृष्ठतः .. 81 ..
5.215.m: "This is true, O fortunate ones: people fall into distress day by day / as the foremost yuga recedes into the past.

5.215.s:
tathāpi ca kariṣyāmi yuṣmadarthamasaṃśayam ..
upāyaṃ laghu santṛptiryena vo'tra bhavi ṣyati .. 82 ..
5.215.d:
तथापि च करिष्यामि युष्मदर्थमसंशयम् ..
उपायं लघु सन्तृप्तिर्येन वोऽत्र भवि ष्यति .. 82 ..
5.215.m: Nevertheless, I will undoubtedly devise for your sake / an easy means by which there will be complete satisfaction for you here.

5.215.s:
amānāma rave raśmisahasrapramukhaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tasminvasati yenenduramāvāsyā tataḥ smṛtā .. 83 ..
5.215.d:
अमानाम रवे रश्मिसहस्रप्रमुखः स्थितः ..
तस्मिन्वसति येनेन्दुरमावास्या ततः स्मृता .. 83 ..
5.215.m: There is a chief among the thousand rays of the sun named Amā; / because the moon dwells in it, it is known as Amāvāsyā.

5.215.s:
tasminnahani ye śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya cātmanaḥ ..
kariṣyaṃti narā bhaktyā te bhaviṣyaṃti susthitāḥ .. 84 ..
5.215.d:
तस्मिन्नहनि ये श्राद्धं पितॄनुद्दिश्य चात्मनः ..
करिष्यंति नरा भक्त्या ते भविष्यंति सुस्थिताः .. 84 ..
5.215.m: On that day, those men who perform a śrāddha with devotion, / dedicating it to their own ancestors, will become prosperous,

5.215.s:
dhanadhānyasamopetā sarvaśatruvivarjitāḥ ..
apamṛtyuparityaktā mama vākyāda saṃśayam.. 85 ..
5.215.d:
धनधान्यसमोपेता सर्वशत्रुविवर्जिताः ..
अपमृत्युपरित्यक्ता मम वाक्याद संशयम्.. 85 ..
5.215.m: endowed with wealth and grain, freed from all enemies, / and spared from untimely death, without doubt, by my word."

5.215.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā babhūvurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
pitaraḥ kavyamāsādya prahaṣṭenāṃtarātmanā .. 86 ..
5.215.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बभूवुर्हृष्टमानसाः ..
पितरः कव्यमासाद्य प्रहष्टेनांतरात्मना .. 86 ..
5.215.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Having heard those words of his, with glad hearts / and rejoicing in their inner selves after receiving ancestral food, the ancestors

5.215.s:
yayuḥ svāni niketāni preṣitāḥ padmayoninā ..
amāvāsyādinaṃ prāpya śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ svavaṃśajaiḥ .. 87 ..
5.215.d:
ययुः स्वानि निकेतानि प्रेषिताः पद्मयोनिना ..
अमावास्यादिनं प्राप्य श्राद्धं दत्तं स्ववंशजैः .. 87 ..
5.215.m: went to their own abodes, dismissed by the lotus-born [Brahmā]. / When the day of Amāvāsyā arrived, the śrāddha was offered by the descendants of their lineages.

5.215.s:
saṃtṛptā māsamātraṃ ca tasthuḥ saṃtuṣṭamānasāḥ ..
gacchatā tvathakālena dauḥsthyaṃ prāpya narā bhuvi ..
darśe'sminnapi no śrāddhaṃ prāyaḥ kurvaṃti kecana ..88..
5.215.d:
संतृप्ता मासमात्रं च तस्थुः संतुष्टमानसाः ..
गच्छता त्वथकालेन दौःस्थ्यं प्राप्य नरा भुवि ..
दर्शेऽस्मिन्नपि नो श्राद्धं प्रायः कुर्वंति केचन ..88..
5.215.m: Satisfied for only a month, they remained with contented minds. / But as time passed, men on earth fell into misery, / and generally hardly anyone performed the śrāddha even on this new moon day.

5.215.s:
tataḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sarveṃ ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ..
kṣutpipāsākulā bhūyo brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ..89..
procuśca praṇipatyoccaiste sametāḥpitāmaham..
paramaṃ dainyamāsthāya bāṣpagadgadayā girā ..6.216.9...
5.215.d:
ततः पितृगणाः सर्वें ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः..
क्षुत्पिपासाकुला भूयो ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः..89..
प्रोचुश्च प्रणिपत्योच्चैस्ते समेताःपितामहम्..
परमं दैन्यमास्थाय बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा ..6.216.9...
5.215.m:
Then all the hosts of ancestors, both the divine and the human, / agitated by hunger and thirst, once again went to Brahmā for refuge.
Assembled together, bowing down, they spoke aloud to the grandfather, / having assumed extreme distress, with voices choked with tears:

5.215.s:
bhagavanniṃdukṣaye śrāddhaṃ proktaṃ māsaṃ tvayā vibho..
asmākaṃ prīṇanārthāya yatkariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..91..
5.215.d:
भगवन्निंदुक्षये श्राद्धं प्रोक्तं मासं त्वया विभो..
अस्माकं प्रीणनार्थाय यत्करिष्यंति मानवाः ..91..
5.215.m: "O Lord, a monthly śrāddha on the waning of the moon was proclaimed by you, O almighty one, / which mortals were to perform for our satisfaction.

5.215.s:
dauḥsthāttadapi no kuryuḥ prāyaśastu pitāmaha ..
tenāsmākaṃ parā pīḍā kṣutpipāsāsamudbhavā..92..
5.215.d:
दौःस्थात्तदपि नो कुर्युः प्रायशस्तु पितामह ..
तेनास्माकं परा पीडा क्षुत्पिपासासमुद्भवा..92..
5.215.m: Because of poverty, they generally do not perform even that, O grandfather; / because of that, supreme suffering born of hunger and thirst belongs to us.

5.215.s:
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ no yathā pūrvaṃ sureśvara..
tathāpi duḥsthatābhājastarpayiṣyaṃti no'dhunā..93..
5.215.d:
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं नो यथा पूर्वं सुरेश्वर..
तथापि दुःस्थताभाजस्तर्पयिष्यंति नोऽधुना..93..
5.215.m: Therefore grant us your grace as before, O lord of the gods, / so that even those beset by poverty will propitiate us now."

5.215.s:
..bhartṛyajña uvāca.. ..
atha brahmāpi saṃcintya tānuvāca kṛpānvitaḥ ..
yuṣmadarthaṃ mayopāyaściṃtitaḥ pitaro laghuḥ .. 94 ..
5.215.d:
..भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच.. ..
अथ ब्रह्मापि संचिन्त्य तानुवाच कृपान्वितः ..
युष्मदर्थं मयोपायश्चिंतितः पितरो लघुः .. 94 ..
5.215.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Then, having reflected, Brahmā also, filled with compassion, said to them: / "An easy means has been devised by me for your sake, O ancestors,

5.215.s:
yena tṛptiṃ parāṃ yūyaṃ gamiṣyatha pitrīśvarāḥ ..
amāvāsyodbhavaṃ śrāddhamalabdhvāpi ca vatsaram.. 95 ..
5.215.d:
येन तृप्तिं परां यूयं गमिष्यथ पित्रीश्वराः ..
अमावास्योद्भवं श्राद्धमलब्ध्वापि च वत्सरम्.. 95 ..
5.215.m: by which you will attain supreme satisfaction, O lords of the ancestors, / even without receiving a śrāddha arising on Amāvāsyā for a year.

5.215.s:
yathā mama prasādena tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ ..
āṣāḍhyāḥ paṃcame pakṣe kanyāsaṃsthe divākare .. 96 ..
5.215.d:
यथा मम प्रसादेन तच्छृणुध्वं समाहिताः ..
आषाढ्याः पंचमे पक्षे कन्यासंस्थे दिवाकरे .. 96 ..
5.215.m: Listen with focused minds to how, by my grace, [this shall be]: / In the fifth fortnight from the full moon of Āṣāḍha, when the sun is in Virgo,

5.215.s:
mṛtāhani punaryo vai śrāddhaṃ dāsyati mānavaḥ ..
tasya saṃvatsaraṃyāvatṛptāḥ syuḥ pitaro dhruvam .. 97 ..
5.215.d:
मृताहनि पुनर्यो वै श्राद्धं दास्यति मानवः ..
तस्य संवत्सरंयावतृप्ताः स्युः पितरो ध्रुवम् .. 97 ..
5.215.m: whatever man shall perform a śrāddha on the anniversary of death, / his ancestors shall surely be satisfied for an entire year.

5.215.s:
evaṃ jñātvā kariṣyaṃti pretapakṣe narā bhuvi ..
śrāddhaṃ yūyaṃ na saṃdeho bhaviṣyatha sutarpitāḥ .. 98 ..
5.215.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा करिष्यंति प्रेतपक्षे नरा भुवि ..
श्राद्धं यूयं न संदेहो भविष्यथ सुतर्पिताः .. 98 ..
5.215.m: Knowing this, men on earth will perform śrāddha / during the fortnight of the departed spirits; there is no doubt that you will be well satisfied.

5.215.s:
yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tena ekenāpi tu sattamāḥ ..
tasminnapi ca yaḥ śrāddhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ na pradāsyati.. 99 ..
śākenā'pi daridro'sāvaṃtyajatvamupeṣyati ..
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ bhojyaṃ sparśaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tathā .. 6.216.100 ..
ye kariṣyaṃti taiḥ sārdhaṃ te'pi pāpatamā narāḥ ..
na teṣāṃ saṃtatirvṛddhiṃ saṃprayāsyati karhicit ..11..
5.215.d:
यावत्संवत्सरं तेन एकेनापि तु सत्तमाः ..
तस्मिन्नपि च यः श्राद्धं युष्माकं न प्रदास्यति.. 99 ..
शाकेनाऽपि दरिद्रोऽसावंत्यजत्वमुपेष्यति ..
आसनं शयनं भोज्यं स्पर्शं संभाषणं तथा .. 6.216.100 ..
ये करिष्यंति तैः सार्धं तेऽपि पापतमा नराः ..
न तेषां संततिर्वृद्धिं संप्रयास्यति कर्हिचित् ..11..
5.215.m:
O best of beings, even by a single [offering] for a whole year. / But whoever does not offer a śrāddha to you even then, / even if with mere greens, being poor—he shall fall to the state of an outcaste. / Whoever shares a seat, bed, meal, touch, or conversation
with such people, those men too are the most sinful; / their lineage shall never prosper.

5.215.s:
na sukhaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca teṣāṃ bhāvi kathaṃcana ..
tasmādgacchata cāvyagrāḥ svasthānaṃ pitaro drutam ..102..
5.215.d:
न सुखं धनधान्यं च तेषां भावि कथंचन ..
तस्माद्गच्छत चाव्यग्राः स्वस्थानं पितरो द्रुतम् ..102..
5.215.m: No happiness, wealth, or grain will ever belong to them. / Therefore, O ancestors, go quickly to your own abode without anxiety.

5.215.s:
kalikāle'pi saṃprāpte dāruṇe nirdhene jane ..
varṣāṃte śrāddhamekaṃ hi prakariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..103..
5.215.d:
कलिकालेऽपि संप्राप्ते दारुणे निर्धेने जने ..
वर्षांते श्राद्धमेकं हि प्रकरिष्यंति मानवाः ..103..
5.215.m: Even when the harsh Kali age arrives and people are destitute, / men will indeed perform one śrāddha at the end of the year,

5.215.s: yenākhilaṃ bhavedvarṣaṃ yuṣmākaṃ prītiruttamā ..104..
5.215.d: येनाखिलं भवेद्वर्षं युष्माकं प्रीतिरुत्तमा ..104..
5.215.m: by which your supreme delight will last for the entire year.”

5.215.s:
.. .. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā pitaro hṛṣṭā jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ niketanam ..
varṣāṃte'pi samāsādya śrāddhaṃ na syurbubhukṣitāḥ .. 105 ..
5.215.d:
.. .. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पितरो हृष्टा जग्मुः स्वंस्वं निकेतनम् ..
वर्षांतेऽपि समासाद्य श्राद्धं न स्युर्बुभुक्षिताः .. 105 ..
5.215.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Hearing that, the ancestors rejoiced and went each to his own dwelling; / receiving the śrāddha even [just] at the end of the year, they would not be hungry.

5.215.s:
atha ye'tra durātmāno niḥśaṃkāḥ kṛpaṇātmakāḥ ..
kalinā mohitāḥ śrāddhaṃ vatsarāṃte'pi no daduḥ ..106..
5.215.d:
अथ येऽत्र दुरात्मानो निःशंकाः कृपणात्मकाः ..
कलिना मोहिताः श्राद्धं वत्सरांतेऽपि नो ददुः ..106..
5.215.m: Now, those wicked-minded, shameless, and miserly men in this world, / deluded by Kali, did not offer śrāddha even at the end of the year.

5.215.s:
teṣāṃ tu pitaro bhūyo divyaiḥpitṛbhiranvitāḥ ..
brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ procuste dīnamānasāḥ .. 107 ..
5.215.d:
तेषां तु पितरो भूयो दिव्यैःपितृभिरन्विताः ..
ब्रह्माणं शरणं जग्मुः प्रोचुस्ते दीनमानसाः .. 107 ..
5.215.m: Then their ancestors, accompanied by divine ancestors, / once again sought refuge with Brahmā, and with dejected minds they said:

5.215.s:
bhagavanvatsarāṃte'pi kanyāsaṃsthe divākare ..
nāsmākaṃ vaṃśajāḥ śrāddhaṃ prayacchaṃti durātmakāḥ..108..
5.215.d:
भगवन्वत्सरांतेऽपि कन्यासंस्थे दिवाकरे ..
नास्माकं वंशजाः श्राद्धं प्रयच्छंति दुरात्मकाः..108..
5.215.m: “O Lord, even at the end of the year when the sun is in Virgo, / our wicked-minded descendants do not offer us śrāddha.

5.215.s:
tena saṃpīḍitā deva kṣutpipāsā samākulāḥ ..
vayaṃ śaraṇamāpannāstatpratīkāramācara .. 109 ..
5.215.d:
तेन संपीडिता देव क्षुत्पिपासा समाकुलाः ..
वयं शरणमापन्नास्तत्प्रतीकारमाचर .. 109 ..
5.215.m: Afflicted by that, O god, and overcome with hunger and thirst, / we have come for refuge. Devise a remedy for that!

5.215.s:
yathā pūrvaṃ mahābhāga vadopāyaṃ laghūttamam..
ekāhikena śrāddhena yenāsmākaṃ hi śāśvatī ..
prītiḥ saṃjāyate deva tvatprasādātsureśvara .. 6.216.110 ..
5.215.d:
यथा पूर्वं महाभाग वदोपायं लघूत्तमम्..
एकाहिकेन श्राद्धेन येनास्माकं हि शाश्वती ..
प्रीतिः संजायते देव त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरेश्वर .. 6.216.110 ..
5.215.m: As before, O highly fortunate one, tell us an easy and superior means / whereby our eternal delight may arise through a single day's śrāddha, / O god, by your grace, O Lord of gods!

5.215.s: vaṃśakṣaye'pi saṃjāte hyasmākaṃ patanaṃ bhavet .. 111 .. ..
5.215.d: वंशक्षयेऽपि संजाते ह्यस्माकं पतनं भवेत् .. 111 .. ..
5.215.m: Indeed, if our lineage becomes extinct, our downfall would ensue.”

5.215.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā pitāmahaḥ ..
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭastataḥ provāca sādaram .. 112
5.215.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चिरं ध्यात्वा पितामहः ..
कृपया परयाविष्टस्ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् .. 112
5.215.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Hearing that speech of theirs and contemplating for a long time, the Grandfather, / filled with supreme compassion, then spoke respectfully:

5.215.s:
.. brahmovāca ..
anyo yuṣmatpratuṣṭyarthamupāyaściṃtito mayā ..
sa laghuryena vo'tyaṃtaṃ tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī ..113..
5.215.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच ..
अन्यो युष्मत्प्रतुष्ट्यर्थमुपायश्चिंतितो मया ..
स लघुर्येन वोऽत्यंतं तृप्तिर्भवति शाश्वती ..113..
5.215.m: Brahmā said: / “Another means has been devised by me for your satisfaction; / it is simple, whereby your satisfaction becomes exceedingly eternal.

5.215.s:
gayāśiraḥ samāsādya śrāddhaṃ dāsyaṃti ye'tra vaḥ ..
apyekaṃ tatprabhāvena divyāṃ gatimavāpsyatha .. 114 ..
5.215.d:
गयाशिरः समासाद्य श्राद्धं दास्यंति येऽत्र वः ..
अप्येकं तत्प्रभावेन दिव्यां गतिमवाप्स्यथ .. 114 ..
5.215.m: Those here who, having approached Gayāśiras, will offer a śrāddha to you, / even a single one—by its power you will attain a divine state.

5.215.s:
api pāpātmanaḥ puṃso brahmaghnasyāpi dehinaḥ ..
api rauravasaṃsthasya kumbhīpākagatasya ca ..115..
5.215.d:
अपि पापात्मनः पुंसो ब्रह्मघ्नस्यापि देहिनः ..
अपि रौरवसंस्थस्य कुम्भीपाकगतस्य च ..115..
5.215.m: Even for a sinful man, even for an embodied being who killed a brahmin, / even for one residing in Raurava or gone to Kumbhīpāka,

5.215.s:
pretabhāvagatasyāpi yasya śrāddhaṃ pradāsyati ..
gayāśirasi vaṃśasthastasya muktirbhaviṣyati .. 116 ..
5.215.d:
प्रेतभावगतस्यापि यस्य श्राद्धं प्रदास्यति ..
गयाशिरसि वंशस्थस्तस्य मुक्तिर्भविष्यति .. 116 ..
5.215.m: even for one who has entered the state of a departed spirit—for whomever a descendant / shall offer a śrāddha at Gayāśiras, liberation will be his.

5.215.s:
etanmama vacaḥ śrutvā sāṃprataṃ bhuvi mānavāḥ ..
niḥsvā api kariṣyaṃti śrādamekaṃ hi tatra ca ..
gayāśirasi suvyaktaṃ yuṣmākaṃ muktidāyakam .. 117 ..
5.215.d:
एतन्मम वचः श्रुत्वा सांप्रतं भुवि मानवाः ..
निःस्वा अपि करिष्यंति श्रादमेकं हि तत्र च ..
गयाशिरसि सुव्यक्तं युष्माकं मुक्तिदायकम् .. 117 ..
5.215.m: Hearing this word of mine, now men on earth, / even if destitute, will certainly perform one śrāddha there / at Gayāśiras, which clearly grants liberation to you.”

5.215.s:
bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā pitarastasya vacanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ..
anujñātāstatastena svāni sthānāni bhejire .. 118 ..
5.215.d:
भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पितरस्तस्य वचनं परमेष्ठिनः ..
अनुज्ञातास्ततस्तेन स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे .. 118 ..
5.215.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Hearing that speech of the Supreme Lord, the ancestors, / permitted by him, then departed to their own realms.

5.215.s:
tataḥprabhṛti śrāddhāni pravṛttāni dharātale ..
piṃḍadānasame tāni yāvadāpuruṣatrayam.. 119 ..
5.215.d:
ततःप्रभृति श्राद्धानि प्रवृत्तानि धरातले ..
पिंडदानसमे तानि यावदापुरुषत्रयम्.. 119 ..
5.215.m: From then on, the rites of śrāddha commenced on the earth's surface, / accompanied by the offering of rice-balls, spanning three generations of men.

5.215.s:
pūrvaṃ brahmāditaḥ kṛtvā ye kecitpuruṣā gatāḥ ..
paralokaṃ samuddiśya tānnarāñchaktito nṛpa .. 6.216.120 ..
5.215.d:
पूर्वं ब्रह्मादितः कृत्वा ये केचित्पुरुषा गताः ..
परलोकं समुद्दिश्य तान्नराञ्छक्तितो नृप .. 6.216.120 ..
5.215.m: Having formerly considered whatever men had departed, beginning with Brahmā, / intending [offerings] for those in the next world according to their capacity, O king,

5.215.s:
tatsaṃkhyānāṃ dvijeṃdrāṇāṃ dattavaṃto'pi vāṃchitam ..
adaivatyamidaṃ śrāddhaṃ daridrāṇāṃ sukhāvaham .. 121 ..
5.215.d:
तत्संख्यानां द्विजेंद्राणां दत्तवंतोऽपि वांछितम् ..
अदैवत्यमिदं श्राद्धं दरिद्राणां सुखावहम् .. 121 ..
5.215.m: and having given desired things to that same number of foremost brahmins— / this śrāddha without deity brings happiness to the poor.

5.215.s:
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ sutṛpti dam ..
tasmācchrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ puruṣeṇa vijānatā .. 122 ..
5.215.d:
पितॄणां देवतानां च मनुष्याणां सुतृप्ति दम् ..
तस्माच्छ्राद्धं प्रकर्तव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता .. 122 ..
5.215.m: It grants great satisfaction to ancestors, deities, and mortals. / Therefore, a wise man should perform śrāddha,

5.215.s:
pitṝṇāṃ vāṃchatā tṛptiṃ kāleṣveteṣu yatnataḥ..
gayāyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lokadvayamabhīpsatā .. 123 ..
5.215.d:
पितॄणां वांछता तृप्तिं कालेष्वेतेषु यत्नतः..
गयायां च विशेषेण लोकद्वयमभीप्सता .. 123 ..
5.215.m: desiring the satisfaction of ancestors, diligently at these times, / and especially at Gayā, if he desires both worlds.

5.215.s:
na dadāti naraḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ candrasaṃkṣaye ..
kṣutpipāsāparītāṃgāḥ pitarastasya duḥkhitāḥ .. .. 124 ..
5.215.d:
न ददाति नरः श्राद्धं पितॄणां चन्द्रसंक्षये ..
क्षुत्पिपासापरीतांगाः पितरस्तस्य दुःखिताः .. .. 124 ..
5.215.m: If a man does not offer śrāddha to the ancestors at the waning of the moon, / his distressed ancestors, their bodies overcome with hunger and thirst,

5.215.s:
pretapakṣaṃ pratīkṣaṃte guruvāṃchāsamanvitāḥ ..
karṣukā jaladaṃ yadvaddivānaktamataṃdritāḥ .. 125 ..
5.215.d:
प्रेतपक्षं प्रतीक्षंते गुरुवांछासमन्विताः ..
कर्षुका जलदं यद्वद्दिवानक्तमतंद्रिताः .. 125 ..
5.215.m: await the fortnight of the departed spirits with intense longing, / day and night, unwearied, just as plowmen await a raincloud.

5.215.s:
pretapakṣe vyatikrāṃte yāvatkanyāṃ gato raviḥ ..
tāvacchrāddhaṃ ca vāṃchaṃti dattaṃ svaiḥ pitaraḥ sutaiḥ .. 126 ..
5.215.d:
प्रेतपक्षे व्यतिक्रांते यावत्कन्यां गतो रविः ..
तावच्छ्राद्धं च वांछंति दत्तं स्वैः पितरः सुतैः .. 126 ..
5.215.m: When the fortnight of the departed spirits has passed, as long as the sun remains in Virgo, / so long the ancestors desire a śrāddha offered by their own sons.

5.215.s:
tatastulāgatepyeke sūrye vāṃchaṃti pārthiva ..
śrāddhaṃ svavaṃśajai rdattaṃ kṣutpipāsāsamākulāḥ .. 127 ..
5.215.d:
ततस्तुलागतेप्येके सूर्ये वांछंति पार्थिव ..
श्राद्धं स्ववंशजै र्दत्तं क्षुत्पिपासासमाकुलाः .. 127 ..
5.215.m: Even when the sun has entered Libra, O king, some [ancestors] desire / a śrāddha offered by their descendants, overcome as they are with hunger and thirst.

5.215.s:
tasminnapi vyatikrāṃte kāle cāṃliṃ gate ravau ..
nirāśāḥ pitaro dīnāstato yāṃti nijālayam .. 128 ..
5.215.d:
तस्मिन्नपि व्यतिक्रांते काले चांलिं गते रवौ ..
निराशाः पितरो दीनास्ततो यांति निजालयम् .. 128 ..
5.215.m: When even that time has passed and the sun has entered Scorpio, / the destitute ancestors, bereft of hope, depart from there to their own abode.

5.215.s:
māsadvayaṃ pratīkṣaṃte gṛhadvāraṃ samāśritāḥ ..
vāyubhūtāḥ pipāsārtāḥ kṣutkṣāmāḥ pitaro nṛṇām .. 129 ..
5.215.d:
मासद्वयं प्रतीक्षंते गृहद्वारं समाश्रिताः ..
वायुभूताः पिपासार्ताः क्षुत्क्षामाः पितरो नृणाम् .. 129 ..
5.215.m: For two months they wait, resorting to the doorways of houses, / having become spirits of wind, afflicted by thirst and emaciated by hunger, the ancestors of men,

5.215.s:
yāvatkanyāgataḥ sūryastulāsthaśca mahīpate..
tathā darśadine tadvadbrahmaṇo vacanānnṛpa .. 6.216.130 ..
5.215.d:
यावत्कन्यागतः सूर्यस्तुलास्थश्च महीपते..
तथा दर्शदिने तद्वद्ब्रह्मणो वचनान्नृप .. 6.216.130 ..
5.215.m: as long as the sun has entered Virgo and remains in Libra, O protector of the earth, / and likewise on the new-moon day, O king, according to the word of Brahmā.

5.215.s:
tasmācchrāddhaṃ sadā kāryaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimicchatā ..
tilodakaṃ viśeṣeṇa yathā brahmavaco nṛpa ..131..
5.215.d:
तस्माच्छ्राद्धं सदा कार्यं पितॄणां तृप्तिमिच्छता ..
तिलोदकं विशेषेण यथा ब्रह्मवचो नृप ..131..
5.215.m: Therefore, śrāddha should always be performed by one who desires the satisfaction of the ancestors, / especially [offering] water with sesame seeds, according to the word of Brahmā, O king.

5.215.s:
vittābhāve'pi darśāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ deyaṃ vipaścitā ..
tadabhāve ca kanyāyāṃ saṃsthite divasādhipe .. 132 ..
5.215.d:
वित्ताभावेऽपि दर्शायां श्राद्धं देयं विपश्चिता ..
तदभावे च कन्यायां संस्थिते दिवसाधिपे .. 132 ..
5.215.m: Even in the absence of wealth, a śrāddha should be given on the new-moon day by a wise person; / and in its absence, when the lord of the day is in Virgo;

5.215.s:
tadabhāve gayāyāṃ ca sakṛcchrāddhaṃ hi nirvapet ..
yena nityaṃ pradattasya śrāddhasya phalamaśnute .. 133 ..
5.215.d:
तदभावे गयायां च सकृच्छ्राद्धं हि निर्वपेत् ..
येन नित्यं प्रदत्तस्य श्राद्धस्य फलमश्नुते .. 133 ..
5.215.m: and in its absence, one should indeed offer a śrāddha once at Gayā, / whereby one enjoys the fruit of a śrāddha offered constantly.

5.215.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi narādhipa ..
yenaitatkriyate śrāddhaṃ janaiḥ pitṛ parāyaṇaiḥ .. 134 ..
5.215.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि नराधिप ..
येनैतत्क्रियते श्राद्धं जनैः पितृ परायणैः .. 134 ..
5.215.m: All this has been related to you as I was asked, O ruler of men, / by virtue of which this śrāddha is performed by people devoted to their ancestors,

5.215.s: amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa pretapakṣe ca pārthiva .. 135 ..
5.215.d: अमावास्यां विशेषेण प्रेतपक्षे च पार्थिव .. 135 ..
5.215.m: especially on the new-moon day and during the fortnight of the departed spirits, O king.

5.215.s:
yaścaitāṃ śṛṇuyātpuṇyāṃ śrāddhotpattiṃ paṭhecca vā ..
sa sarvadoṣanirmuktaḥ śrāddhadānaphalaṃ labhet .. 136 ..
5.215.d:
यश्चैतां शृणुयात्पुण्यां श्राद्धोत्पत्तिं पठेच्च वा ..
स सर्वदोषनिर्मुक्तः श्राद्धदानफलं लभेत् .. 136 ..
5.215.m: And whoever hears or recites this holy origin of the śrāddha, / freed from all faults, he shall obtain the fruit of performing a śrāddha.

5.215.s:
śrāddhakāle paṭhedyastu śrāddhotpattimimāṃ naraḥ ..
akṣayaṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ sarvacchidravivarjitam.. .. 137 ..
5.215.d:
श्राद्धकाले पठेद्यस्तु श्राद्धोत्पत्तिमिमां नरः ..
अक्षयं तद्भवेच्छ्राद्धं सर्वच्छिद्रविवर्जितम्.. .. 137 ..
5.215.m: Whatever man recites this origin of the śrāddha at the time of a śrāddha, / that śrāddha of his shall become inexhaustible and free from all defects.

5.215.s:
asaddravyeṇa vā cīrṇamanarhairbrāhmaṇairapi ..
abhuktaṃ kāmahīnaṃ vā mantrahīnamathāpi vā .. 138 ..
5.215.d:
असद्द्रव्येण वा चीर्णमनर्हैर्ब्राह्मणैरपि ..
अभुक्तं कामहीनं वा मन्त्रहीनमथापि वा .. 138 ..
5.215.m: Even if performed with improper materials, or by unworthy brahmins, / or uneaten, or lacking in desire, or even devoid of mantras.

5.215.s:
sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti kīrtanātpārthivottama.
asyāḥ śrāddhasamutpatteḥ kīrtanācchravaṇādapi .. 139 ..
5.215.d:
सर्वं संपूर्णतां याति कीर्तनात्पार्थिवोत्तम.
अस्याः श्राद्धसमुत्पत्तेः कीर्तनाच्छ्रवणादपि .. 139 ..
5.215.m: Everything becomes complete, O best of kings, by proclaiming / and even by listening to this origin of the śrāddha.

5.215.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭake śvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhotpattivarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 216 ..
5.215.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटके श्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे श्राद्धोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम षोडशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 216 ..
5.215.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixteenth chapter, entitled "Description of the Origin of the Śrāddha," in the rules of śrāddha within the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.216.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
vidhinā yena kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ munīśvara..
tamācakṣvā'dya kārtsnyena śraddhā me mahatī sthitā.. 1 ..
5.216.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
विधिना येन कर्तव्यं श्राद्धं सर्वं मुनीश्वर..
तमाचक्ष्वाऽद्य कार्त्स्न्येन श्रद्धा मे महती स्थिता.. 1 ..
5.216.m: Ānarta said: / By what rite is the whole śrāddha to be performed, O lord of sages? / Explain that to me today in its entirety; great faith has arisen in me.

5.216.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi śrāddhasya vidhimuttamam ..
pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭidaṃ nityaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 2 ..
5.216.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि श्राद्धस्य विधिमुत्तमम् ..
पितॄणां तुष्टिदं नित्यं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् .. 2 ..
5.216.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Listen, O king, I will explain the supreme rite of the śrāddha, / which grants constant satisfaction to the ancestors and bestows all desires upon men.

5.216.s:
svakarmopārjitairvittaiḥ śrāddhakāryāṇi cāharet ..
māyādibhirna cauryeṇa na cchalāptairna vaṃcanaiḥ..
svavṛttyopārjitairvittaiḥ śrāddhadravyaṃ samāharet..
supratigrahajairdravyairbrāhmaṇānāṃ viśiṣyate..4..
5.216.d:
स्वकर्मोपार्जितैर्वित्तैः श्राद्धकार्याणि चाहरेत् ..
मायादिभिर्न चौर्येण न च्छलाप्तैर्न वंचनैः..
स्ववृत्त्योपार्जितैर्वित्तैः श्राद्धद्रव्यं समाहरेत्..
सुप्रतिग्रहजैर्द्रव्यैर्ब्राह्मणानां विशिष्यते..4..
5.216.m: One should procure the items for the śrāddha with wealth earned by one's own labor, / not by deceit or other [wicked means], not by theft, not through fraud, and not by cheating. / One should gather the material for the śrāddha with wealth earned by one's own livelihood; / for brahmins, [wealth] derived from worthy gifts is superior.

5.216.s:
rakṣaṇāptairnarendrasya vaiśyasya kṣetra saṃbhavaiḥ..
śūdrasya paṇyalabdhaiśca śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ prayujyate..5..
5.216.d:
रक्षणाप्तैर्नरेन्द्रस्य वैश्यस्य क्षेत्र संभवैः..
शूद्रस्य पण्यलब्धैश्च श्राद्धं कर्तुं प्रयुज्यते..5..
5.216.m: For a king, it should be obtained through protection; for a vaiśya, from agriculture; / and for a śūdra, obtained through trade: [with such] it is enjoined to perform a śrāddha.

5.216.s:
evaṃ śuddhisamopete dravye prāpte gṛhāṃtikam..
pūrvedyuḥ sāyamāsādya śrāddhārhāṇāṃ dvijanmanām.. 6 ..
5.216.d:
एवं शुद्धिसमोपेते द्रव्ये प्राप्ते गृहांतिकम्..
पूर्वेद्युः सायमासाद्य श्राद्धार्हाणां द्विजन्मनाम्.. 6 ..
5.216.m: When wealth endowed with such purity has thus been brought near one's house, / having approached on the evening of the previous day the twice-born worthy of a śrāddha,

5.216.s:
gṛhaṃ gatvā śucirbhūtvā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ..
āmaṃtrayedyatīnpaścātsnātakānbrahmakarmiṇaḥ..7..
5.216.d:
गृहं गत्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा कामक्रोधविवर्जितः..
आमंत्रयेद्यतीन्पश्चात्स्नातकान्ब्रह्मकर्मिणः..7..
5.216.m: having gone to their house, purified and free from desire and anger, / he should invite ascetics, next snātakas, and performers of sacred rites;

5.216.s:
tadabhāve gṛhasthāṃśca
brahmajñānaparāyaṇān.. agnihotraparānviprānvedavidyāvicakṣaṇān..8..
5.216.d:
तदभावे गृहस्थांश्च
ब्रह्मज्ञानपरायणान्.. अग्निहोत्रपरान्विप्रान्वेदविद्याविचक्षणान्..8..
5.216.m: in their absence, householders devoted to the knowledge of Brahman, / brahmins devoted to the agnihotra, and those proficient in the learning of the Vedas;

5.216.s:
śrotriyāṃśca tathā vṛddhānṣaṭkarmaniratānsadā..
bahubhṛtyakuṭumbāṃśca daridrānsaṃyutānguṇaiḥ..9..
5.216.d:
श्रोत्रियांश्च तथा वृद्धान्षट्कर्मनिरतान्सदा..
बहुभृत्यकुटुम्बांश्च दरिद्रान्संयुतान्गुणैः..9..
5.216.m: and Vedic scholars, as well as elders, those always devoted to the six duties, / those having many servants and dependents, the poor who are endowed with good qualities,

5.216.s:
avyaṃgānroganirmuktāñjitāhārāṃstathā śucīn ..
ete syurbrāhmaṇā rājañchrāddhārhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 6.217.10 ..
5.216.d:
अव्यंगान्रोगनिर्मुक्ताञ्जिताहारांस्तथा शुचीन् ..
एते स्युर्ब्राह्मणा राजञ्छ्राद्धार्हाः परिकीर्तिताः .. 6.217.10 ..
5.216.m: those free from bodily defects, free from disease, of subdued diet, and pure. / These are the brahmins proclaimed worthy of a śrāddha, O king.

5.216.s:
anarhā ye ca nirdiṣṭāḥ śṛṇu tānapi vacmi te ..
hīnāṃgānadhikāṃgāṃśca sarvabhākṣannirākṛtīn .. 11 ..
5.216.d:
अनर्हा ये च निर्दिष्टाः शृणु तानपि वच्मि ते ..
हीनांगानधिकांगांश्च सर्वभाक्षन्निराकृतीन् .. 11 ..
5.216.m: Now hear also those who are designated unworthy; I shall tell them to you: / those with deficient limbs, those with extra limbs, omnivores, those who have neglected their sacred duties,

5.216.s:
śyāvadantānvṛthādantānvedavikrayakārakān ..
vedaviplavakānvāpi vedaśāstravivarjitān .. .. 12 ..
5.216.d:
श्यावदन्तान्वृथादन्तान्वेदविक्रयकारकान् ..
वेदविप्लवकान्वापि वेदशास्त्रविवर्जितान् .. .. 12 ..
5.216.m: those with black teeth, those with irregular teeth, those who sell the Veda, / those who corrupt the Veda, or those destitute of the Veda and the scriptures,

5.216.s:
kunakhānrogasaṃyuktāndvirnagnānparahiṃsakān..
janāpavādasaṃyuktānnāstikānṛtakānapi .. 13 ..
5.216.d:
कुनखान्रोगसंयुक्तान्द्विर्नग्नान्परहिंसकान्..
जनापवादसंयुक्तान्नास्तिकानृतकानपि .. 13 ..
5.216.m: those with deformed nails, those afflicted with disease, the twice-naked, those who harm others, / those burdened with public censure, atheists, and liars,

5.216.s:
vārdhuṣikānvikarmasthāñchaucācāravivarji tān..
atidīrghānkṛśānvāpi sthūlānapi ca lomaśān .. 14 ..
5.216.d:
वार्धुषिकान्विकर्मस्थाञ्छौचाचारविवर्जि तान्..
अतिदीर्घान्कृशान्वापि स्थूलानपि च लोमशान् .. 14 ..
5.216.m: usurers, those engaged in improper deeds, those devoid of purity and proper conduct, / those who are excessively tall, or emaciated, or obese, and the excessively hairy.

5.216.s:
nirlomānvarjayecchrāddhe ya icchetpitṛgauravam..
paradāraratā ye ca tathā yo vṛṣalī patiḥ .. 15 ..
5.216.d:
निर्लोमान्वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धे य इच्छेत्पितृगौरवम्..
परदाररता ये च तथा यो वृषली पतिः .. 15 ..
5.216.m: One who desires the honor of the ancestors should avoid at a śrāddha hairless men, / those who take pleasure in another's wife, and one who is the husband of a vṛṣalī.

5.216.s:
vaṃdhyā vai vṛṣalī proktā vṛṣalī ca mṛtaprajā ..
aparā vṛṣalī proktā kumārī yā rajasvalā .. 16 ..
5.216.d:
वंध्या वै वृषली प्रोक्ता वृषली च मृतप्रजा ..
अपरा वृषली प्रोक्ता कुमारी या रजस्वला .. 16 ..
5.216.m: A barren woman is indeed called a vṛṣalī, and a vṛṣalī is one whose offspring have died; / another declared to be a vṛṣalī is a maiden who has menstruated [unmarried].

5.216.s:
ṣaṇḍho malimluco dambhī rājapai śunyavṛttayaḥ ..
sagotrāyāśca saṃbhūtastathaikapravarāsutaḥ .. 17 ..
5.216.d:
षण्ढो मलिम्लुचो दम्भी राजपै शुन्यवृत्तयः ..
सगोत्रायाश्च संभूतस्तथैकप्रवरासुतः .. 17 ..
5.216.m: A eunuch, a thief, an impostor, those who earn a living by slandering the king, / one born of a woman of the same gotra, and the son of a woman sharing the same pravara,

5.216.s:
kaniṣṭhaḥ prākkṛtādhānaḥ kṛtodvāhaśca prāktu yaḥ ..
tathā prāgdīkṣito yaśca sa tyājyo gṛhasaṃyutaḥ .. 18 ..
5.216.d:
कनिष्ठः प्राक्कृताधानः कृतोद्वाहश्च प्राक्तु यः ..
तथा प्राग्दीक्षितो यश्च स त्याज्यो गृहसंयुतः .. 18 ..
5.216.m: a younger brother who has set up the sacred fires first, or who has married first, / and he who was consecrated before [his elder brother]: such a one along with his household is to be rejected;

5.216.s:
pitṛmātṛparityāgī tathāca gurutalpagaḥ ..
nirddoṣāṃ yastyajetpatnīṃ kṛtaghno yaśca karṣukaḥ .. 19 ..
5.216.d:
पितृमातृपरित्यागी तथाच गुरुतल्पगः ..
निर्द्दोषां यस्त्यजेत्पत्नीं कृतघ्नो यश्च कर्षुकः .. 19 ..
5.216.m: one who abandons father and mother, and likewise one who defiles his guru's bed, / one who abandons a faultless wife, an ungrateful man, and a cultivator of the soil,

5.216.s:
śilpajīvī pramādī ca paṇya jīvī kṛtāyudhaḥ ..
etānvivarjayecchrāddhe yeṣāṃ no jñāyate kulam .. 6.217.20 ..
5.216.d:
शिल्पजीवी प्रमादी च पण्य जीवी कृतायुधः ..
एतान्विवर्जयेच्छ्राद्धे येषां नो ज्ञायते कुलम् .. 6.217.20 ..
5.216.m: one who lives by a craft, a negligent man, one who lives by merchandise, one who bears arms— / these whose lineage is not known, one must avoid at a śrāddha.

5.216.s:
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi ye śastāḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi ..
ye brāhmaṇāḥ purā khyātāḥ pāpānāṃ paṃktipāvanāḥ .. 21 ..
5.216.d:
अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि ये शस्ताः श्राद्धकर्मणि ..
ये ब्राह्मणाः पुरा ख्याताः पापानां पंक्तिपावनाः .. 21 ..
5.216.m: Henceforth I shall speak of those who are commended in the śrāddha rite, / the brahmins who were renowned of old as sanctifiers of the row [of diners] for sins:

5.216.s:
triṇāciketastrimadhustrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṃgavit ..
yaśca vidyāvratasnāto dharmadroṇasya pāṭhakaḥ.. 22 ..
5.216.d:
त्रिणाचिकेतस्त्रिमधुस्त्रिसुपर्णः षडंगवित् ..
यश्च विद्याव्रतस्नातो धर्मद्रोणस्य पाठकः.. 22 ..
5.216.m: one who knows the Triṇāciketa, the Trimadhu, the Trisuparṇa, one who knows the six auxiliaries of the Veda, / one who has bathed upon completing both sacred study and vows, one who recites the Dharmadroṇa,

5.216.s:
purāṇajñastathā jñānī vijñeyo jyeṣṭhasāmavit ..
atharvaśiraso vettā kratugāmī sukarmakṛt .. 23 ..
sadyaḥprakṣālako yaśca śuklo dauhitra eva ca ..
jāmātā bhāgineyaśca paropakaraṇe rataḥ .. 22 ..
5.216.d:
पुराणज्ञस्तथा ज्ञानी विज्ञेयो ज्येष्ठसामवित् ..
अथर्वशिरसो वेत्ता क्रतुगामी सुकर्मकृत् .. 23 ..
सद्यःप्रक्षालको यश्च शुक्लो दौहित्र एव च ..
जामाता भागिनेयश्च परोपकरणे रतः .. 22 ..
5.216.m:
one who knows the Purāṇas, a wise man, one to be recognized as knowing the Jyeṣṭhasāman, / one who knows the Atharvaśiras, one who attends sacrifices, a doer of good deeds,
one who immediately washes [clean], a blameless man, a daughter's son, / a son-in-law, a sister's son, one devoted to helping others,

5.216.s:
mṛṣṭānnādo mṛṣṭavākyaḥ sadā japaparāyaṇaḥ ..
ete ? brāhmaṇā jñeyā niḥśeṣāḥ paṃktipāvanāḥ .. 25 ..
5.216.d:
मृष्टान्नादो मृष्टवाक्यः सदा जपपरायणः ..
एते ? ब्राह्मणा ज्ञेया निःशेषाः पंक्तिपावनाः .. 25 ..
5.216.m: an eater of sweet food, one whose speech is sweet, and one who is always devoted to recitation of mantras— / all these brahmins are to be recognized without exception as sanctifiers of the row.

5.216.s:
etairvimiśritāḥ sarve garhitā api ye dvijāḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ te'pi kurvaṃti tṛptiṃ bhuktvā kulodbhavāḥ .. 26..
5.216.d:
एतैर्विमिश्रिताः सर्वे गर्हिता अपि ये द्विजाः ..
पितॄणां तेऽपि कुर्वंति तृप्तिं भुक्त्वा कुलोद्भवाः .. 26..
5.216.m: Mingled with these, even all censured twice-born born of good families / bring satisfaction to the ancestors once they have dined.

5.216.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kulaṃ jñeyaṃ dbijanmanām ..
śīlaṃ paścādvayo nāma kanyādānaṃ tataḥ param .. 27 ..
5.216.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कुलं ज्ञेयं द्बिजन्मनाम् ..
शीलं पश्चाद्वयो नाम कन्यादानं ततः परम् .. 27 ..
5.216.m: Therefore, by every effort the lineage of the twice-born must be known, / then conduct, age, name, and after that the giving of a maiden.

5.216.s:
śrutaśīlavihīnāya dharmajñāyāpi mānavaḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ dadāti kanyāṃ ca yastenāgniṃ vinā hutam .. 28 ..
5.216.d:
श्रुतशीलविहीनाय धर्मज्ञायापि मानवः ..
श्राद्धं ददाति कन्यां च यस्तेनाग्निं विना हुतम् .. 28 ..
5.216.m: If a man gives a śrāddha or a maiden to one devoid of learning and good conduct, / even if he knows the law, it is as if he made an oblation without fire,

5.216.s:
ūṣare vāpi taṃ sasyaṃ tuṣāṇāṃ kaṇḍanaṃ kṛtam..
kulācārasamopetāṃstasmācchrāddhe niyojayet .. 29 ..
5.216.d:
ऊषरे वापि तं सस्यं तुषाणां कण्डनं कृतम्..
कुलाचारसमोपेतांस्तस्माच्छ्राद्धे नियोजयेत् .. 29 ..
5.216.m: or sowed grain in saline soil, or pounded empty husks. / Therefore, one should employ at a śrāddha those endowed with the conduct of their lineage,

5.216.s:
brāhmaṇānnṛpaśārdūla mandavidyādharānapi ..
evaṃ vijñāya tānviprāngṛhītvā caraṇau tataḥ .. 6.217.30 ..
5.216.d:
ब्राह्मणान्नृपशार्दूल मन्दविद्याधरानपि ..
एवं विज्ञाय तान्विप्रान्गृहीत्वा चरणौ ततः .. 6.217.30 ..
5.216.m: brahmins, O tiger among kings, even if possessing little learning. / Knowing those brahmins thus, and then taking hold of their feet,

5.216.s:
prayatnena tu savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu ..
yugmānatha yathāśaktyā namaskṛtya punaḥpunaḥ .. 31 ..
5.216.d:
प्रयत्नेन तु सव्येन पाणिना दक्षिणेन तु ..
युग्मानथ यथाशक्त्या नमस्कृत्य पुनःपुनः .. 31 ..
5.216.m: carefully with the left hand and with the right, / having bowed again and again to an even number [of them] according to one's ability,

5.216.s:
dakṣiṇaṃ jānvathālabhya mantramenamudīrayet ..
āgacchaṃtu mahābhāgā viśvedevā mahābalāḥ .. 32 ..
5.216.d:
दक्षिणं जान्वथालभ्य मन्त्रमेनमुदीरयेत् ..
आगच्छंतु महाभागा विश्वेदेवा महाबलाः .. 32 ..
5.216.m: and then touching the right knee, he should utter this mantra: / 'May the fortunate and exceedingly mighty Viśvedevas come,

5.216.s:
bhaktyāhūtā mayā caiva tvaṃ cāpi vratabhāgbhava ..
evaṃ yugmā nsamāmaṃtrya viśvedevakṛte dvijān .. 33 ..
5.216.d:
भक्त्याहूता मया चैव त्वं चापि व्रतभाग्भव ..
एवं युग्मा न्समामंत्र्य विश्वेदेवकृते द्विजान् .. 33 ..
5.216.m: summoned with devotion by me; and may you too be a participant in this observance.' / Having thus invited an even number of twice-born for the sake of the Viśvedevas,

5.216.s:
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitrarthaṃ cābhimaṃtrayet ..
brāhmaṇāṃstrīnyathāśaktyā ekaikasya pṛthakpṛthak .. 34 ..
5.216.d:
अपसव्यं ततः कृत्वा पित्रर्थं चाभिमंत्रयेत् ..
ब्राह्मणांस्त्रीन्यथाशक्त्या एकैकस्य पृथक्पृथक् .. 34 ..
5.216.m: then shifting the sacred thread to the right side, he should invite for the sake of the ancestors / three brahmins, according to his ability, separately for each one,

5.216.s:
ekaikaṃ vā trayāṇāṃ vā ekamevaṃ nimaṃtrayet ..
brāhmaṇānmātṛpakṣe ca eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 35 ..
5.216.d:
एकैकं वा त्रयाणां वा एकमेवं निमंत्रयेत् ..
ब्राह्मणान्मातृपक्षे च एष एव विधिः स्मृतः .. 35 ..
5.216.m: or one for each, or he may invite just one for the three. / On the mother's side also, this very rite is prescribed for the brahmins.

5.216.s:
tataḥ pādau parispṛṣṭvā dvijasyedamudīrayet ..
śraddhā pūtena manasā pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .. 36 ..
5.216.d:
ततः पादौ परिस्पृष्ट्वा द्विजस्येदमुदीरयेत् ..
श्रद्धा पूतेन मनसा पितृभक्तिपरायणः .. 36 ..
5.216.m: Then, touching the two feet of the twice-born, he should say this / with a mind purified by faith, devoted to honoring the ancestors:

5.216.s:
pitā me tava kāyesmiṃstathā caiva pitāmahaḥ ..
svapitrā sahito hyetu tvaṃ ca vrataparo bhava .. 37 ..
5.216.d:
पिता मे तव कायेस्मिंस्तथा चैव पितामहः ..
स्वपित्रा सहितो ह्येतु त्वं च व्रतपरो भव .. 37 ..
5.216.m: 'May my father, and likewise my grandfather, / along with his own father, truly enter this body of yours, and may you be devoted to the observance.'

5.216.s:
evaṃ pitṝnsamāhūya tathā mātāmahānatha ..
saṃmaṃtritāśca te viprāḥ saṃyamātmāna eva te .. 38 ..
5.216.d:
एवं पितॄन्समाहूय तथा मातामहानथ ..
संमंत्रिताश्च ते विप्राः संयमात्मान एव ते .. 38 ..
5.216.m: Having thus summoned the paternal ancestors and then the maternal grandfathers, / those invited brahmins, practicing self-restraint,

5.216.s:
yajamānaḥ śāṃtamanā brahmacaryasamanvitaḥ ..
tāṃ rātriṃ samatikramya prātarutthāya mānavaḥ .. 39 ..
5.216.d:
यजमानः शांतमना ब्रह्मचर्यसमन्वितः ..
तां रात्रिं समतिक्रम्य प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः .. 39 ..
5.216.m: and the sacrificer with a tranquil mind, observing celibacy, / having passed that night and arisen early in the morning,

5.216.s:
tadahni varjayetkopaṃ svādhyāyaṃ karma kutsitam ..
tailābhyaṃgaṃ śramaṃ yānaṃ vāhanaṃ cātha dūrataḥ .. 6.217.40 ..
5.216.d:
तदह्नि वर्जयेत्कोपं स्वाध्यायं कर्म कुत्सितम् ..
तैलाभ्यंगं श्रमं यानं वाहनं चाथ दूरतः .. 6.217.40 ..
5.216.m: should strictly avoid on that day anger, Vedic recitation, vile acts, / anointing with oil, exhaustion, travel, and riding a mount.

5.216.s:
tato madhyaṃ gate sūrye kāle kutapasaṃjñite ..
snātaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
santuṣṭāṃśca samāhūtāṃstānviprāñchrāddhamācaret .. 41 ..
5.216.d:
ततो मध्यं गते सूर्ये काले कुतपसंज्ञिते ..
स्नातः शुक्लांबरधरः सन्तर्प्य पितृदेवताः ..
सन्तुष्टांश्च समाहूतांस्तान्विप्राञ्छ्राद्धमाचरेत् .. 41 ..
5.216.m: Then, when the sun has reached the zenith, at the time called kutapa, / having bathed, wearing white garments, having gratified the ancestors and the gods, / and having invited those Brahmins who are contented, one should perform the śrāddha, 41

5.216.s:
vivikte gṛhamadhyasthe manojñe dakṣiṇāplave ..
na yatra jāyate dṛṣṭiḥ pāpānāṃ krūrakarmiṇām .. 42 ..
5.216.d:
विविक्ते गृहमध्यस्थे मनोज्ञे दक्षिणाप्लवे ..
न यत्र जायते दृष्टिः पापानां क्रूरकर्मिणाम् .. 42 ..
5.216.m: in a secluded, pleasant spot in the middle of the house, sloping toward the south, / where the gaze of sinful men of cruel deeds does not fall. 42

5.216.s:
yacchrāddhaṃ vīkṣate śvā vā nārī vā'tha rajasvalā ..
patito vā varāho vā tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 43 ..
5.216.d:
यच्छ्राद्धं वीक्षते श्वा वा नारी वाऽथ रजस्वला ..
पतितो वा वराहो वा तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 43 ..
5.216.m: A śrāddha that is looked upon by a dog, a menstruating woman, / an outcaste, or a boar, that śrāddha goes in vain. 43

5.216.s:
annaṃ paryuṣitaṃ yacca tailāktaṃ vā pradīyate ..
sakeśaṃ vā saniṃdyaṃ ca tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 44 ..
5.216.d:
अन्नं पर्युषितं यच्च तैलाक्तं वा प्रदीयते ..
सकेशं वा सनिंद्यं च तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 44 ..
5.216.m: And food that is stale, smeared with oil, / with hair, or contemptible, if given, that śrāddha goes in vain. 44

5.216.s:
vibhaktirahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā maunavivarjitam..
dakṣiṇārahitaṃ yacca tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 45 ..
5.216.d:
विभक्तिरहितं श्राद्धं तथा मौनविवर्जितम्..
दक्षिणारहितं यच्च तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 45 ..
5.216.m: A śrāddha lacking proper distribution, and devoid of silence, / and that which lacks a sacrificial fee, that śrāddha goes in vain. 45

5.216.s:
gharaṭṭolūkhalotthau ca yatra śabdau vyavasthitau ..
śūrpasya vā viśeṣeṇa tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 46 ..
5.216.d:
घरट्टोलूखलोत्थौ च यत्र शब्दौ व्यवस्थितौ ..
शूर्पस्य वा विशेषेण तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 46 ..
5.216.m: Where the sounds of the grindstone and the mortar are heard, / or especially that of a winnowing basket, that śrāddha goes in vain. 46

5.216.s:
yatra saṃskriyamāṇe ca kalahaḥ saṃprajāyate ..
paṃktibhedo viśeṣeṇa tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet ..47..
5.216.d:
यत्र संस्क्रियमाणे च कलहः संप्रजायते ..
पंक्तिभेदो विशेषेण तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् ..47..
5.216.m: Where a quarrel arises while it is being prepared, / and especially discrimination in the dining row, that śrāddha goes in vain. 47

5.216.s:
pūrvāhṇe kriyate yacca rātrau vā saṃdhyayorapi ..
paryākāśe tathā deśe tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajeta .. 48 ..
5.216.d:
पूर्वाह्णे क्रियते यच्च रात्रौ वा संध्ययोरपि ..
पर्याकाशे तथा देशे तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत .. 48 ..
5.216.m: That which is performed in the morning, at night, or during the two twilights, / or in an open space under the sky, that śrāddha goes in vain. 48

5.216.s:
brāhmaṇo yajamāno vā brahmacaryaṃ vinā yadi ..
bhuṃkte dadyācca yacchrāddhaṃ tadrājanvyarthatāṃ vrajet ..49..
5.216.d:
ब्राह्मणो यजमानो वा ब्रह्मचर्यं विना यदि ..
भुंक्ते दद्याच्च यच्छ्राद्धं तद्राजन्व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् ..49..
5.216.m: If a brahmin or the patron, without celibacy, / eats or offers a śrāddha, O king, that goes in vain. 49

5.216.s:
tuṣadhānyaṃ saniṣpāvaṃ yaccocchiṣṭaṃ ca dīyate ..
ardhabhuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet ..6.217.50..
5.216.d:
तुषधान्यं सनिष्पावं यच्चोच्छिष्टं च दीयते ..
अर्धभुक्तं घृतं क्षीरं तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् ..6.217.50..
5.216.m: Grain with husks, pulse, leftover food, / or half-consumed ghee and milk that is given, that śrāddha goes in vain. 50

5.216.s:
yeṣu kāleṣu yaddattaṃ śrāddhamakṣayatāṃ vrajet ..
tānahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa .. 51 ..
5.216.d:
येषु कालेषु यद्दत्तं श्राद्धमक्षयतां व्रजेत् ..
तानहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप .. 51 ..
5.216.m: At which times a śrāddha that is given becomes imperishable, / those I shall declare; listen with a focused mind, O king. 51

5.216.s:
manvādīrapi te vacmi tāḥ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa ..
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhā nityaṃ sarvapāpakṣayāvahāḥ .. 52 ..
5.216.d:
मन्वादीरपि ते वच्मि ताः शृणुष्व नराधिप ..
पितॄणां वल्लभा नित्यं सर्वपापक्षयावहाः .. 52 ..
5.216.m: I shall also tell you of the manvādi days; listen to them, O ruler of men: / they are ever dear to the ancestors and destroy all sins. 52

5.216.s:
yāsu toyamapi kṣmāyāṃ pradattaṃ tilamiśritam ..
pitṛbhyo'kṣayatāṃ yāti śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 53 ..
5.216.d:
यासु तोयमपि क्ष्मायां प्रदत्तं तिलमिश्रितम् ..
पितृभ्योऽक्षयतां याति श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 53 ..
5.216.m: On these days, even water mixed with sesame seeds poured upon the earth / for the ancestors with a mind purified by faith becomes inexhaustible. 53

5.216.s:
aśvayukchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārtikasya ca ..
tṛtīyāpi ca māghasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca .. 54 ..
5.216.d:
अश्वयुक्छुक्लनवमी द्वादशी कार्तिकस्य च ..
तृतीयापि च माघस्य तथा भाद्रपदस्य च .. 54 ..
5.216.m: The bright ninth of Āśvina, the twelfth of Kārttika, / the third of Māgha, and likewise [the third] of Bhādrapada, 54

5.216.s:
amāvāsyā tapasyasya pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā ..
tathā''ṣāḍhasya daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī .. 55 ..
5.216.d:
अमावास्या तपस्यस्य पौषस्यैकादशी तथा ..
तथा'ऽषाढस्य दशमी माघमासस्य सप्तमी .. 55 ..
5.216.m: the new moon of Tapasya, the eleventh of Pauṣa, / likewise the tenth of Āṣāḍha, the seventh of the month of Māgha, 55

5.216.s:
śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathā''ṣāḍhī va pūrṇimā ..
tathā kārtikamāsasya yā cānyā phālgunasya ca .. 56 ..
5.216.d:
श्रावणस्याष्टमी कृष्णा तथा'ऽषाढी व पूर्णिमा ..
तथा कार्तिकमासस्य या चान्या फाल्गुनस्य च .. 56 ..
5.216.m: the dark eighth of Śrāvaṇa, the full moon of Āṣāḍha, / likewise that of the month of Kārttika, and another of Phālguna, 56

5.216.s:
caitrasya jyeṣṭhamāsasya paṃcaitāḥ pūrṇimā nṛpa ..
manūnāmādayaḥ proktāstithayaste mayā nṛpa .. 57 ..
5.216.d:
चैत्रस्य ज्येष्ठमासस्य पंचैताः पूर्णिमा नृप ..
मनूनामादयः प्रोक्तास्तिथयस्ते मया नृप .. 57 ..
5.216.m: and those of Caitra and the month of Jyeṣṭha—these five full moons, O king: / these lunar days are declared by me to be the beginnings of the Manvantaras, O king. 57

5.216.s:
āsu toyamapi snātvā tila darbhavimiśritam ..
pitṝnuddiśya yo dadyātsa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 58 ..
5.216.d:
आसु तोयमपि स्नात्वा तिल दर्भविमिश्रितम् ..
पितॄनुद्दिश्य यो दद्यात्स याति परमां गतिम् .. 58 ..
5.216.m: Having bathed on these days, whoever offers even water mixed with sesame and darbha grass / designated for the ancestors goes to the supreme state. 58

5.216.s:
iha loke pare caiva pitṝṇāṃ ca prasādataḥ ..
kiṃ punarvividhairannai rasairvastraiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ .. 59 ..
5.216.d:
इह लोके परे चैव पितॄणां च प्रसादतः ..
किं पुनर्विविधैरन्नै रसैर्वस्त्रैः सदक्षिणैः .. 59 ..
5.216.m: In this world and in the next, by the favor of the ancestors— / what need then to speak of [offerings of] various foods, delicacies, clothes, and sacrificial fees? 59

5.216.s:
adhunā śṛṇu rājendra yugādyāḥ pitṛvallabhāḥ ..
yāsāṃ saṃkīrtanenāpi kṣīyate pāpasaṃcayaḥ .. 6.217.60 ..
5.216.d:
अधुना शृणु राजेन्द्र युगाद्याः पितृवल्लभाः ..
यासां संकीर्तनेनापि क्षीयते पापसंचयः .. 6.217.60 ..
5.216.m: Now listen, O best of kings, to the beginnings of the Yugas, dear to the ancestors, / by the mere praise of which the accumulation of sin is destroyed. 60

5.216.s:
navamī kārtike śuklā tṛtīyā mādhave sitā ..
amāvāsyā ca tapaso nabhasyasya trayodaśī .. 61 ..
5.216.d:
नवमी कार्तिके शुक्ला तृतीया माधवे सिता ..
अमावास्या च तपसो नभस्यस्य त्रयोदशी .. 61 ..
5.216.m: The bright ninth of Kārttika, the bright third of Mādhava, / the new moon of Tapas, and the thirteenth of Nabhasya: 61

5.216.s:
tretākṛtakalīnāṃ tu dvāparasyādayaḥ kramāt ..
snāne dāne jape home viśeṣātpitṛtarpaṇe .. 62 ..
5.216.d:
त्रेताकृतकलीनां तु द्वापरस्यादयः क्रमात् ..
स्नाने दाने जपे होमे विशेषात्पितृतर्पणे .. 62 ..
5.216.m: these are the beginnings of the Tretā, Kṛta, Kali, and Dvāpara [yugas] respectively. / In bathing, giving, recitation of mantras, oblation, and especially ancestral libation, 62

5.216.s:
kṛtasyākṣayakāriṇyaḥ sukṛtasya mahāphalāḥ ..
yadā syānmeṣago bhānustulāṃ vātha yadā vrajet .. 63 ..
5.216.d:
कृतस्याक्षयकारिण्यः सुकृतस्य महाफलाः ..
यदा स्यान्मेषगो भानुस्तुलां वाथ यदा व्रजेत् .. 63 ..
5.216.m: they render the performed meritorious deed inexhaustible and of great fruit. / When the sun enters Aries or when it goes to Libra, 63

5.216.s:
tadā syādviṣuvākhyastu kālaścākṣayakārakaḥ ..
makare karkaṭe caiva yadā bhānurvrajennṛpa .. 64 ..
5.216.d:
तदा स्याद्विषुवाख्यस्तु कालश्चाक्षयकारकः ..
मकरे कर्कटे चैव यदा भानुर्व्रजेन्नृप .. 64 ..
5.216.m: that time is called the equinox and produces inexhaustible merit. / When the sun goes to Capricorn and Cancer, O king, 64

5.216.s:
tadāyanābhidhānastu viṣuvo'tha viśiṣyate ..
raveḥ saṃkramaṇaṃ rāśau saṃkrāṃtiriti kathyate .. 65 ..
5.216.d:
तदायनाभिधानस्तु विषुवोऽथ विशिष्यते ..
रवेः संक्रमणं राशौ संक्रांतिरिति कथ्यते .. 65 ..
5.216.m: that is called the solstice; yet the equinox is distinguished. / The transit of the sun into a zodiac sign is spoken of as a saṃkrānti. 65

5.216.s:
snānadānajapaśrāddhahomādiṣu mahāphalāḥ ..
tretādyāḥ kramaśaḥ proktāḥ kālāḥ saṃkrāṃtipūrvakāḥ ..
naiteṣu vidyate vighnaṃ dattasyākṣayasaṃjñitāḥ .. 66 ..
5.216.d:
स्नानदानजपश्राद्धहोमादिषु महाफलाः ..
त्रेताद्याः क्रमशः प्रोक्ताः कालाः संक्रांतिपूर्वकाः ..
नैतेषु विद्यते विघ्नं दत्तस्याक्षयसंज्ञिताः .. 66 ..
5.216.m: Bearing great fruit in bathing, giving, recitation of mantras, śrāddha, oblation, and the like, / the times beginning with the Tretā and the saṃkrāntis have been described in order; / there is no obstacle in these, and what is given is termed imperishable. 66

5.216.s:
aśraddhayā'pi yaddattaṃ kupātrebhyo'pi mānavaiḥ ..
akāle'pi hi tatsarvaṃ sadyo hyakṣayatāṃ vrajet .. 67 ..
5.216.d:
अश्रद्धयाऽपि यद्दत्तं कुपात्रेभ्योऽपि मानवैः ..
अकालेऽपि हि तत्सर्वं सद्यो ह्यक्षयतां व्रजेत् .. 67 ..
5.216.m: Whatever is given by men, even without faith, even to unworthy recipients, / and even out of season, all of that immediately becomes truly imperishable. 67

5.216.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhārhapadārthabrāhmaṇakālanirṇaya varṇanaṃnāma saptadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 217 ..
5.216.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे श्राद्धार्हपदार्थब्राह्मणकालनिर्णय वर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 217 ..
5.216.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventeenth chapter, named 'The Description of the Ascertainment of Proper Materials, Brahmins, and Times for Śrāddha in the Rite of Śrāddha,' in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara-kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 217

5.217.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
etatsāmānyataḥ proktaṃ mayā śrāddhaṃ yathā naraiḥ ..
karttavyaṃ viprapūrvairyadvarṇaiḥ pārthivasattama .. 1 ..
5.217.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
एतत्सामान्यतः प्रोक्तं मया श्राद्धं यथा नरैः ..
कर्त्तव्यं विप्रपूर्वैर्यद्वर्णैः पार्थिवसत्तम .. 1 ..
5.217.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / This śrāddha has been described in general terms by me, as it should be performed / by men of the castes beginning with brahmins, O best of earthly kings. 1

5.217.s:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi svaśākhāyāḥ smṛtaṃ nṛpa ..
svadeśavarṇajātīyaṃ yathā syādatra nirvṛtiḥ .. 2 ..
5.217.d:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि स्वशाखायाः स्मृतं नृप ..
स्वदेशवर्णजातीयं यथा स्यादत्र निर्वृतिः .. 2 ..
5.217.m: Hereafter I shall speak of what is traditionally handed down for one's own branch [of the Veda], O king, / according to one's own country, caste, and lineage, so that satisfaction may arise in this matter. 2

5.217.s:
śrāddhe śraddhā yato mūlaṃ tena śrāddhaṃ prakīrtitam ..
tattasminkriyamāṇe tu na kiṃcidvyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 3 ..
5.217.d:
श्राद्धे श्रद्धा यतो मूलं तेन श्राद्धं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
तत्तस्मिन्क्रियमाणे तु न किंचिद्व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 3 ..
5.217.m: Because faith (śraddhā) is the root in a śrāddha, therefore it is called a śrāddha; / therefore, when that is performed, nothing goes in vain. 3

5.217.s:
aniṣṭamapi rājendra tasmācchrāddhaṃ samā caret ..
viprapādodakaṃ yattu bhūmau patati pārthiva .. 4 ..
5.217.d:
अनिष्टमपि राजेन्द्र तस्माच्छ्राद्धं समा चरेत् ..
विप्रपादोदकं यत्तु भूमौ पतति पार्थिव .. 4 ..
