5.217.m: Therefore, even if unexpected, O best of kings, one should perform a śrāddha. / The water from washing the brahmin's feet that falls on the ground, O king— 4

5.217.s:
jātā ye gotrajāḥ kecidaputrā maraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..
te yāṃti paramāṃ tṛptimamṛtena yathā surāḥ .. ..
viprapādodakaklinnā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī..
tāvatpuṣkarapātreṣu pibanti pitaro jalam..6..
5.217.d:
जाता ये गोत्रजाः केचिदपुत्रा मरणं गताः ..
ते यांति परमां तृप्तिममृतेन यथा सुराः .. ..
विप्रपादोदकक्लिन्ना यावत्तिष्ठति मेदिनी..
तावत्पुष्करपात्रेषु पिबन्ति पितरो जलम्..6..
5.217.m: those born of the family who have died sonless, / they attain supreme satisfaction, as gods do with ambrosia. / As long as the earth remains wet with the water from washing the brahmin's feet, / so long do the ancestors drink water from lotus-leaf cups. 6

5.217.s:
śrāddhe'tha kriyamāṇe tu yatkiṃcitpatati kṣitau..
puṣpagandhodakaṃ cānnamapi toyaṃ nareśvara..7..
5.217.d:
श्राद्धेऽथ क्रियमाणे तु यत्किंचित्पतति क्षितौ..
पुष्पगन्धोदकं चान्नमपि तोयं नरेश्वर..7..
5.217.m: And while the śrāddha is being performed, whatever falls upon the ground— / flowers, fragrant water, food, and also water, O lord of men— 7

5.217.s:
tena tṛptiṃ parāṃ yāṃti ye kṛmitvamupāgatāḥ..
kīṭatvaṃ vāpi tiryaktvaṃ vyālatvaṃ ca narādhipa..8..
5.217.d:
तेन तृप्तिं परां यांति ये कृमित्वमुपागताः..
कीटत्वं वापि तिर्यक्त्वं व्यालत्वं च नराधिप..8..
5.217.m: by that, those who have become worms, / insects, animals, or serpents, O ruler of men, attain supreme satisfaction. 8

5.217.s:
yaducchiṣṭaṃ kṣitau yāti pātraprakṣālanodbhavam..
tena tṛptiṃ parāṃ yāṃti ye pretatvamupāgatāḥ .. 9 ..
5.217.d:
यदुच्छिष्टं क्षितौ याति पात्रप्रक्षालनोद्भवम्..
तेन तृप्तिं परां यांति ये प्रेतत्वमुपागताः .. 9 ..
5.217.m: The leftover food that falls to the earth, arising from washing the vessels, / by that, those who have become ghosts attain supreme satisfaction. 9

5.217.s:
ye cāpamṛtyunā kecinmṛtyuṃ prāptāḥ svavaṃśajāḥ ..
asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ tyāgināṃ kulayoṣitām .. 6.218.10 ..
5.217.d:
ये चापमृत्युना केचिन्मृत्युं प्राप्ताः स्ववंशजाः ..
असंस्कृतप्रमीतानां त्यागिनां कुलयोषिताम् .. 6.218.10 ..
5.217.m: And those born in one's family who have met death through unnatural death, / those who died unpurified by rites, ascetics, and women of the lineage— 10

5.217.s:
ucchiṣṭabhāgadheyaṃ syāddarbheṣu vikiraśca yaḥ ..
vikireṇa pradattena te tṛptiṃ yāṃti cākhilāḥ .. .. 11 ..
5.217.d:
उच्छिष्टभागधेयं स्याद्दर्भेषु विकिरश्च यः ..
विकिरेण प्रदत्तेन ते तृप्तिं यांति चाखिलाः .. .. 11 ..
5.217.m: their share is the remnant and the scattered offering on the darbha grass; / by the scattered offering that is given, all of them attain satisfaction. 11

5.217.s:
yatkiṃcinmaṃtrahīnaṃ vā kālahīnamathāpi vā ..
vidhihīnaṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu tadbhavet .. 12 ..
5.217.d:
यत्किंचिन्मंत्रहीनं वा कालहीनमथापि वा ..
विधिहीनं च संपूर्णं दक्षिणायां तु तद्भवेत् .. 12 ..
5.217.m: Whatever is deficient in mantra, or deficient in proper time, / or deficient in ritual rule, becomes complete through the sacrificial fee. 12

5.217.s:
tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vipaścitā ..
ya icchecchāśvatīṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāmātmanaśca yaḥ .. 13 ..
5.217.d:
तस्मान्न दक्षिणाहीनं श्राद्धं कार्यं विपश्चिता ..
य इच्छेच्छाश्वतीं तृप्तिं पितॄणामात्मनश्च यः .. 13 ..
5.217.m: Therefore, a wise man should not perform a śrāddha devoid of a sacrificial fee, / if he desires everlasting satisfaction for his ancestors and for himself. 13

5.217.s:
dakṣiṇārahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ yathaivoṣaravarṣitam ..
yathā tamasi nṛtyaṃ ca gītaṃ vā badhirasya ca .. 14 ..
5.217.d:
दक्षिणारहितं श्राद्धं यथैवोषरवर्षितम् ..
यथा तमसि नृत्यं च गीतं वा बधिरस्य च .. 14 ..
5.217.m: A śrāddha devoid of dakṣiṇā is like rain falling on barren soil, / like dancing in the dark, or like a song for the deaf.

5.217.s:
śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca yuktvā ca śrāddhe niṣkāmatāṃ vrajet ..
na svādhyāyaḥ prakartavyo na grāmāṃtarakaṃ vrajet .. 15 ..
5.217.d:
श्राद्धं दत्त्वा च युक्त्वा च श्राद्धे निष्कामतां व्रजेत् ..
न स्वाध्यायः प्रकर्तव्यो न ग्रामांतरकं व्रजेत् .. 15 ..
5.217.m: Having offered a śrāddha and having engaged in it, one should attain desirelessness in the śrāddha; / no recitation of the Veda should be performed, nor should one travel to another village.

5.217.s:
śrāddhabhugramaṇītalpaṃ tadaharyo'dhigacchati ..
taṃ māsaṃ pitarastasya jāyaṃte vīryabhojinaḥ .. 16 ..
5.217.d:
श्राद्धभुग्रमणीतल्पं तदहर्योऽधिगच्छति ..
तं मासं पितरस्तस्य जायंते वीर्यभोजिनः .. 16 ..
5.217.m: He who, having eaten at a śrāddha, goes to a woman's bed on that day, / for that entire month his ancestors become eaters of semen.

5.217.s:
śrāddhabhukchrāddhadātā ca yaḥ sevayati maithunam ..
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatpitaraḥ śukrabhojinaḥ ..
prabhavaṃti na saṃdeha ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ .. 17 ..
5.217.d:
श्राद्धभुक्छ्राद्धदाता च यः सेवयति मैथुनम् ..
तस्य संवत्सरं यावत्पितरः शुक्रभोजिनः ..
प्रभवंति न संदेह इत्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः .. 17 ..
5.217.m: He who eats at a śrāddha and he who offers a śrāddha, whichever of them indulges in sexual intercourse, / his ancestors become eaters of semen for a whole year; / there is no doubt about this, for such is the Vedic revelation.

5.217.s:
śrāddhe bhuktvātha dattvā vā yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurutelpadhīḥ ..
svādhyāyaṃ pitarastasya yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa ..
vyarthaśrāddhaphalāḥ saṃtaḥ pīḍyaṃte kṣutpipāsayā .. 18 ..
5.217.d:
श्राद्धे भुक्त्वाथ दत्त्वा वा यः श्राद्धं कुरुतेल्पधीः ..
स्वाध्यायं पितरस्तस्य यावत्संवत्सरं नृप ..
व्यर्थश्राद्धफलाः संतः पीड्यंते क्षुत्पिपासया .. 18 ..
5.217.m: That foolish man who, having eaten or having offered [oblations] at a śrāddha, performs recitation of the Veda, / his ancestors, O king, for a whole year, / having their śrāddha-fruit rendered futile, are tormented by hunger and thirst.

5.217.s:
śrāddhe bhuktvā'tha dattvā vā yaḥ śrāddhaṃ mānavādhamaḥ ..
grāmātaraṃ prayātyatra tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 19 ..
5.217.d:
श्राद्धे भुक्त्वाऽथ दत्त्वा वा यः श्राद्धं मानवाधमः ..
ग्रामातरं प्रयात्यत्र तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 19 ..
5.217.m: Having eaten or having offered [oblations] at a śrāddha, whatever base man / travels to another village, in this matter that śrāddha goes in vain.

5.217.s:
brāhmaṇena na bhoktavyaṃ samāyāte nimaṃtraṇe ..
atha bhuṃkte ca yo mohātsa prayāti hyadhogatim .. 6.218.20 ..
5.217.d:
ब्राह्मणेन न भोक्तव्यं समायाते निमंत्रणे ..
अथ भुंक्ते च यो मोहात्स प्रयाति ह्यधोगतिम् .. 6.218.20 ..
5.217.m: A brahmin should not eat [elsewhere] when an invitation has arrived; / but if he eats through delusion, he indeed goes to a low state.

5.217.s:
yajamānena ca tathā na kāryaṃ bhojanaṃ param..
kurvaṃti ye narāḥ sarve te yāṃti narakaṃ dhruvam .. 21 ..
5.217.d:
यजमानेन च तथा न कार्यं भोजनं परम्..
कुर्वंति ये नराः सर्वे ते यांति नरकं ध्रुवम् .. 21 ..
5.217.m: Likewise, a second meal should not be taken by the patron of the sacrifice; / all those men who do so certainly go to hell.

5.217.s:
śrāddhe bhuktvā'tha dattvā vā śrāddhaṃ yo yuddhamācaret..
asaṃdigdhaṃ hi tacchrāddhaṃ sa mando vyarthataṃ nayet .. 22 ..
5.217.d:
श्राद्धे भुक्त्वाऽथ दत्त्वा वा श्राद्धं यो युद्धमाचरेत्..
असंदिग्धं हि तच्छ्राद्धं स मन्दो व्यर्थतं नयेत् .. 22 ..
5.217.m: Having eaten at a śrāddha or having offered a śrāddha, he who engages in fighting, / that foolish man undoubtedly leads that śrāddha to futility.

5.217.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena doṣānetānparityajet ..
śrāddhabhugyajamānaśca viśeṣeṇa mahīpate .. 23 ..
5.217.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन दोषानेतान्परित्यजेत् ..
श्राद्धभुग्यजमानश्च विशेषेण महीपते .. 23 ..
5.217.m: Therefore, with every effort, one should abandon these faults, / especially the eater at the śrāddha and the patron of the sacrifice, O lord of the earth.

5.217.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhaniyamavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 218 ..
5.217.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे श्राद्धनियमवर्णनंनामाष्टादशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 218 ..
5.217.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Rules of Śrāddha' in the Śrāddhakalpa of the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the sixth [part] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.218.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
kāmyāni te'dhunā vacmi śrāddhāni pṛthivīpate ..
yaiḥ kṛtaiḥ samavāpnoti martyo hṛdayasaṃsthitam ..1..
5.218.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
काम्यानि तेऽधुना वच्मि श्राद्धानि पृथिवीपते ..
यैः कृतैः समवाप्नोति मर्त्यो हृदयसंस्थितम् ..1..
5.218.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Now I shall tell you, O lord of the earth, of the optional śrāddhas, / by performing which a mortal obtains that which resides in his heart.

5.218.s:
yo nārīṃ vāṃchate kṣmāpa rūpāḍhyāṃ śīlamaṇḍanām ..
iha loke pare caiva tasyārhaṃ prathamaṃ dinam .. 2..
5.218.d:
यो नारीं वांछते क्ष्माप रूपाढ्यां शीलमण्डनाम् ..
इह लोके परे चैव तस्यार्हं प्रथमं दिनम् .. 2..
5.218.m: He who desires a woman rich in beauty and adorned with good conduct, / in this world and in the next, for him the first day is fit.

5.218.s:
śrāddhīyapretapakṣasya mukhyabhūtaṃ ca yannṛpa ..
ya icchetkanyakāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ suśīlāṃ rūpasaṃyu tām ..
dvitīyādivase tena śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ mahīpate .. 3 ..
5.218.d:
श्राद्धीयप्रेतपक्षस्य मुख्यभूतं च यन्नृप ..
य इच्छेत्कन्यकां श्रेष्ठां सुशीलां रूपसंयु ताम् ..
द्वितीयादिवसे तेन श्राद्धं कार्यं महीपते .. 3 ..
5.218.m: And that which is the primary [day] of the śrāddha fortnight of the ancestors, O king; / he who desires an excellent maiden endowed with good conduct and beauty, / by him a śrāddha should be performed on the second day, O lord of the earth.

5.218.s:
yo vāṃchati naro'śvāṃśca vāyuvegasamāñjave ..
tṛtīyādivase śrāddhaṃ tena kāryaṃ vipaścitā .. 4 ..
5.218.d:
यो वांछति नरोऽश्वांश्च वायुवेगसमाञ्जवे ..
तृतीयादिवसे श्राद्धं तेन कार्यं विपश्चिता .. 4 ..
5.218.m: The man who desires horses equal to the speed of the wind in swiftness, / by that wise man a śrāddha should be performed on the third day.

5.218.s:
yo vāṃchati paśūnmukhyānkupyākupyadhanāni ca ..
caturthyāṃ tena kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ pitṛpratuṣṭaye .. 5 ..
5.218.d:
यो वांछति पशून्मुख्यान्कुप्याकुप्यधनानि च ..
चतुर्थ्यां तेन कर्तव्यं श्राद्धं पितृप्रतुष्टये .. 5 ..
5.218.m: He who desires excellent cattle, and movable and immovable wealth, / should perform a śrāddha on the fourth [day] for the satisfaction of the ancestors.

5.218.s:
putrānvāṃchati yo'bhīṣṭānsuśīlānvaṃśamaṃḍanān ..
pañcamyāṃ tena kartavyaṃ sadā śrāddhaṃ narādhipa .. 6 ..
5.218.d:
पुत्रान्वांछति योऽभीष्टान्सुशीलान्वंशमंडनान् ..
पञ्चम्यां तेन कर्तव्यं सदा श्राद्धं नराधिप .. 6 ..
5.218.m: He who desires desirable sons, well-behaved and ornaments to the lineage, / should always perform a śrāddha on the fifth [day], O ruler of men.

5.218.s:
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ vaṃśajairdattaṃ paralokagato nṛpa ..
vāṃchate tena kartavyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śrāddhaṃ vipaścitā .. 7 ..
5.218.d:
यः श्राद्धं वंशजैर्दत्तं परलोकगतो नृप ..
वांछते तेन कर्तव्यं षष्ठ्यां श्राद्धं विपश्चिता .. 7 ..
5.218.m: O king, he who, gone to the other world, desires a śrāddha / offered by his descendants, by that wise man a śrāddha should be performed on the sixth [day].

5.218.s:
kṛṣisiddhiṃ ya iccheta graiṣmikīṃ śāradīmapi ..
saptamyāṃ yujyate tasya śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
5.218.d:
कृषिसिद्धिं य इच्छेत ग्रैष्मिकीं शारदीमपि ..
सप्तम्यां युज्यते तस्य श्राद्धं कर्तुं न संशयः .. 8 ..
5.218.m: He who desires success in agriculture, both of the summer and of the autumn, / it is suitable for him to perform a śrāddha on the seventh [day], without a doubt.

5.218.s:
ya icchetpaṇyasaṃsiddhiṃ vyavahārasamudbhavām ..
aṣṭamyāṃ yujyate śrāddhaṃ tasya kartuṃ narādhipa .. 9 ..
5.218.d:
य इच्छेत्पण्यसंसिद्धिं व्यवहारसमुद्भवाम् ..
अष्टम्यां युज्यते श्राद्धं तस्य कर्तुं नराधिप .. 9 ..
5.218.m: He who desires success in commodities arising from commerce, / it is suitable for him to perform a śrāddha on the eighth [day], O ruler of men.

5.218.s:
navamyāṃ śrāddhakṛnnānā catuṣpadagaṇāllam̐bhet ..
saubhāgyaṃ roganāśaṃ ca tathā vallabhasaṃgamam .. 6.219.10 ..
5.218.d:
नवम्यां श्राद्धकृन्नाना चतुष्पदगणाल्लम्̐भेत् ..
सौभाग्यं रोगनाशं च तथा वल्लभसंगमम् .. 6.219.10 ..
5.218.m: Performing a śrāddha on the ninth [day], one would obtain various herds of four-footed beasts, / good fortune, the destruction of disease, and union with the beloved.

5.218.s:
daśamīdivase śrāddhaṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ ..
tasya syādvāṃchitā siddhiḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā .. 11 ..
5.218.d:
दशमीदिवसे श्राद्धं यः करोति समाहितः ..
तस्य स्याद्वांछिता सिद्धिः सर्वकृत्येषु सर्वदा .. 11 ..
5.218.m: He who performs a śrāddha on the tenth day with focused mind, / his desired success would be attained in all undertakings at all times.

5.218.s:
ekādaśyāṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ śrāddhakartā labhennaraḥ ..
tathā bhūpaprasādaṃ ca yaccānyanmanasi sthitam .. 12 ..
5.218.d:
एकादश्यां धनं धान्यं श्राद्धकर्ता लभेन्नरः ..
तथा भूपप्रसादं च यच्चान्यन्मनसि स्थितम् .. 12 ..
5.218.m: On the eleventh [day], the performer of the śrāddha would obtain wealth and grain, / as well as the favor of the king, and whatever else is in his mind.

5.218.s:
yaḥ karoti ca dvādaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
putrāṃstu pravarāṃścaiva sa paśūnvāṃchitāllam̐bhet .. .. 13 ..
5.218.d:
यः करोति च द्वादश्यां श्राद्धं श्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
पुत्रांस्तु प्रवरांश्चैव स पशून्वांछिताल्लम्̐भेत् .. .. 13 ..
5.218.m: And he who performs a śrāddha on the twelfth [day], endowed with faith, / would obtain excellent sons and desired cattle.

5.218.s:
yo vāṃchati naro muktiṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha cātmanaḥ ..
asaṃtānaśca yastasya śrāddhe proktā trayodaśī .. 14 ..
5.218.d:
यो वांछति नरो मुक्तिं पितृभिः सह चात्मनः ..
असंतानश्च यस्तस्य श्राद्धे प्रोक्ता त्रयोदशी .. 14 ..
5.218.m: The man who desires liberation for himself together with his ancestors, / and who is without offspring, for his śrāddha the thirteenth [day] is prescribed.

5.218.s:
saṃtānakāmo yaḥ kuryāttasya vaṃśakṣayo bhavet ..
na saṃtānavivṛddhayai ca tasya proktā trayodaśī .. 15 ..
5.218.d:
संतानकामो यः कुर्यात्तस्य वंशक्षयो भवेत् ..
न संतानविवृद्धयै च तस्य प्रोक्ता त्रयोदशी .. 15 ..
5.218.m: He who desires offspring and performs it [then], his family lineage would perish; / the thirteenth [day] is not prescribed for him for the increase of offspring.

5.218.s:
śrāddhakarmaṇi rājeṃdra śrutireṣā purātanī ..
api naḥ sa kule bhūyādyo no dadyāttrayodaśīm .. 16 ..
5.218.d:
श्राद्धकर्मणि राजेंद्र श्रुतिरेषा पुरातनी ..
अपि नः स कुले भूयाद्यो नो दद्यात्त्रयोदशीम् .. 16 ..
5.218.m: In the rite of śrāddha, O king of kings, there is this ancient traditional saying: / 'May that [man] be born in our lineage who will offer to us on the thirteenth [day]

5.218.s:
pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca ..
maghātrayodaśīyoge pāyasena yajetpitṝn .. 17 ..
5.218.d:
पायसं मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां वर्षासु च मघासु च ..
मघात्रयोदशीयोगे पायसेन यजेत्पितॄन् .. 17 ..
5.218.m: milk-rice with honey and clarified butter during the rainy season and under the asterism Maghā.' / At the conjunction of Maghā and the thirteenth [day], he should worship the ancestors with milk-rice.

5.218.s:
pitarastasya necchaṃti tadvarṣaṃ śrāddhasatkriyām ..
puṇyātiśayabhītena piṃḍadānaṃ nirākṛtam .. 18 ..
5.218.d:
पितरस्तस्य नेच्छंति तद्वर्षं श्राद्धसत्क्रियाम् ..
पुण्यातिशयभीतेन पिंडदानं निराकृतम् .. 18 ..
5.218.m: His ancestors do not desire the hospitable rite of śrāddha for that year; / being afraid of excessive religious merit, the offering of rice-balls was rejected.

5.218.s:
śakreṇa taddine putramaraṇaṃ darśitaṃ bhayam ..
yeṣāṃ ca śastramṛtyuḥ syādapamṛtyurathāpi vā .. 19 ..
5.218.d:
शक्रेण तद्दिने पुत्रमरणं दर्शितं भयम् ..
येषां च शस्त्रमृत्युः स्यादपमृत्युरथापि वा .. 19 ..
5.218.m: On that day, the fear of a son's death was shown by Śakra. / And for those who have died by weapons, or suffered an unnatural death,

5.218.s:
upasargamṛtānāṃ ca viṣamṛtyumupeyuṣām ..
vahninā tu pradagdhānāṃ jalamṛtyu mupeyuṣām .. 6.219.20 ..
5.218.d:
उपसर्गमृतानां च विषमृत्युमुपेयुषाम् ..
वह्निना तु प्रदग्धानां जलमृत्यु मुपेयुषाम् .. 6.219.20 ..
5.218.m: and for those who died of a pestilence, those who met death by poison, / those burned by fire, those who met death by water,

5.218.s:
sarpavyālahatānāṃ ca śṛṃgairudbandhanairapi ..
ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa .. 21 ..
5.218.d:
सर्पव्यालहतानां च शृंगैरुद्बन्धनैरपि ..
एकोद्दिष्टं प्रकर्तव्यं चतुर्दश्यां नराधिप .. 21 ..
5.218.m: and those killed by snakes and wild beasts, by horns or by hanging, / an ekoddiṣṭa rite should be performed on the fourteenth [day], O ruler of men.

5.218.s: teṣāṃ tasminkṛte tṛptistatastatpakṣajā bhavet .. 22 ..
5.218.d: तेषां तस्मिन्कृते तृप्तिस्ततस्तत्पक्षजा भवेत् .. 22 ..
5.218.m: When that is performed, their satisfaction arising from that fortnight will take place.

5.218.s:
sarve kāmāḥ puraḥ proktā yuṣmākaṃ ye mayā nṛpa ..
amāvāsyādine śrāddhāttānāpnoti na saṃśa yaḥ .. 23 ..
5.218.d:
सर्वे कामाः पुरः प्रोक्ता युष्माकं ये मया नृप ..
अमावास्यादिने श्राद्धात्तानाप्नोति न संश यः .. 23 ..
5.218.m: All desires previously declared to you by me, O king, / one obtains from a śrāddha on the day of the new moon; of this there is no doubt.

5.218.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kāmyaśrāddhaphalaṃ nṛpa ..
yacchrutvā vāṃchitānkāmānsarvānāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 24 ..
5.218.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं काम्यश्राद्धफलं नृप ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा वांछितान्कामान्सर्वानाप्नोति मानवः .. 24 ..
5.218.m: This entire fruit of optional śrāddhas has been told to you, O king, / hearing which a mortal obtains all desired wishes.

5.218.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe kāmyaśrāddhavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśottaradviśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ .. 219 ..
5.218.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे काम्यश्राद्धवर्णनंनामैकोनविंशोत्तरद्विशततमो' ध्यायः .. 219 ..
5.218.m: Thus ends the two hundred and nineteenth chapter, named 'Description of Optional Śrāddhas' in the Śrāddhakalpa of the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the sixth [part] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.219.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
trayodaśyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe kasmādvaṃśakṣayo bhavet ..
etanme sarvamācakṣva vistarāttvaṃ mahā mune..
bhartṛyajña uvāca..
eṣā medhyatamā rājanyugādiḥ kalisaṃbhavā..
snāne dāne jape home śrāddhe jñeyā tathā'kṣayā .. 2 ..
5.219.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
त्रयोदश्यां कृते श्राद्धे कस्माद्वंशक्षयो भवेत् ..
एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरात्त्वं महा मुने..
भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच..
एषा मेध्यतमा राजन्युगादिः कलिसंभवा..
स्नाने दाने जपे होमे श्राद्धे ज्ञेया तथाऽक्षया .. 2 ..
5.219.m: Ānarta said: / If a śrāddha is performed on the thirteenth [day], why would the destruction of the lineage occur? / Tell me all this in detail, O great sage. / Bhartṛyajña said: / This [day] is the most pure, O king, the beginning of a yuga originating in the Kali age; / in bathing, giving, recitation, oblation in fire, and śrāddha, it is known to be inexhaustible.

5.219.s:
asyāṃ cettu gajacchāyā tithau rājanprajāyate ..
tadā'kṣayaṃ maghāyoge śrāddhaṃ saṃjāyate dhruvam..3..
5.219.d:
अस्यां चेत्तु गजच्छाया तिथौ राजन्प्रजायते ..
तदाऽक्षयं मघायोगे श्राद्धं संजायते ध्रुवम्..3..
5.219.m: If on this lunar day, O king, the Gajacchāyā conjunction occurs, / then, with the conjunction of Maghā, the śrāddha certainly becomes inexhaustible.

5.219.s:
yaḥ kṣīraṃ madhunā yuktaṃ tasminnahani yacchati ..
pitṝnuddiśya yo māṃsaṃ dadyādvādhrīṇasaṃ ca yaḥ .. 4 ..
5.219.d:
यः क्षीरं मधुना युक्तं तस्मिन्नहनि यच्छति ..
पितॄनुद्दिश्य यो मांसं दद्याद्वाध्रीणसं च यः .. 4 ..
5.219.m: He who offers milk mixed with honey on that day, / and who gives flesh to the ancestors, and who [gives] a vādhrapasa—

5.219.s:
vādhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī ..
triḥpibaṃtviṃdriyakṣīṇaṃ śvetaṃ vṛddhamajāpatim .. 5 ..
5.219.d:
वाध्रीणसस्य मांसेन तृप्तिर्द्वादशवार्षिकी ..
त्रिःपिबंत्विंद्रियक्षीणं श्वेतं वृद्धमजापतिम् .. 5 ..
5.219.m: Through the flesh of a vādhrapasa, satisfaction lasts for twelve years. / [One that] drinks three times, weak in faculties, white, an old goat,

5.219.s:
taṃ tu vādhrīṇasaṃ vidyātsarvayūthādhipaṃ tathā ..
khaḍgamāṃsaṃ ca vā dadyāttṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī ..
saṃjāyate na saṃdehasteṣāṃ vākyaṃ na me mṛṣā .. 6 ..
5.219.d:
तं तु वाध्रीणसं विद्यात्सर्वयूथाधिपं तथा ..
खड्गमांसं च वा दद्यात्तृप्तिर्द्वादशवार्षिकी ..
संजायते न संदेहस्तेषां वाक्यं न मे मृषा .. 6 ..
5.219.m: that one should be known as a vādhrapasa, and likewise the leader of the whole herd. / Or if one gives rhinoceros meat, satisfaction lasts for twelve years. / It occurs without doubt; their word is not false for me.

5.219.s:
āsīdrathaṃtare kalpe pūrvaṃ pārthivasattamaḥ..
sitāśvo nāma pāṃcāladeśīyaḥpitṛbhaktimān..7..
5.219.d:
आसीद्रथंतरे कल्पे पूर्वं पार्थिवसत्तमः..
सिताश्वो नाम पांचालदेशीयःपितृभक्तिमान्..7..
5.219.m: In the Rathaṃtara kalpa, there was formerly a best of kings / named Sitāśva, from the country of the Pañcālas, devoted to his ancestors.

5.219.s:
madhunā kālaśākena khaḍgamāṃsena kevalam ..
sa hi śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ kuru te pāyasena ca .. 8 ..
5.219.d:
मधुना कालशाकेन खड्गमांसेन केवलम् ..
स हि श्राद्धं त्रयोदश्यां कुरु ते पायसेन च .. 8 ..
5.219.m: With honey, black vegetables, and solely rhinoceros meat, / he performed the śrāddha on the thirteenth [lunar day], and with rice pudding,

5.219.s: somavaṃśaṃ samuddiśya śrāddhaṃ yacchati bhaktitaḥ ..9..
5.219.d: सोमवंशं समुद्दिश्य श्राद्धं यच्छति भक्तितः ..9..
5.219.m: he offered the śrāddha with devotion, dedicating it to the lunar dynasty.

5.219.s:
atha tairbāhmaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sa bhūyaḥ kautukānvitaiḥ ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya pṛṣṭo bhuktvā yathecchayā .. 6.220.10 ..
5.219.d:
अथ तैर्बाह्मणैः सर्वैः स भूयः कौतुकान्वितैः ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य पृष्टो भुक्त्वा यथेच्छया .. 6.220.10 ..
5.219.m: Then, having eaten to their content, after some time / he was questioned again by all those brahmins, filled with curiosity,

5.219.s:
śrāddhādanaṃtaraṃ rājandṛṣṭvā taṃ śraddhayā'nvitam ..
pādāvamarddanaparaṃ praṇipātapuraḥ saram ..11..
5.219.d:
श्राद्धादनंतरं राजन्दृष्ट्वा तं श्रद्धयाऽन्वितम् ..
पादावमर्द्दनपरं प्रणिपातपुरः सरम् ..11..
5.219.m: after the śrāddha, O King, seeing him filled with faith, / intent on massaging their feet after bowing down.

5.219.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ mahārāja pradātavyā'tha dakṣiṇā ..
brāhmaṇebhyastataḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ copatiṣṭhati .. 12 ..
sā tvayā kalpitā'smākaṃ vitīrṇādyāpi no nṛpa.
kupyākupyaṃ parityajya tāṃ dehi nṛpa mā ciram .. 13 ..
5.219.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
कृत्वा श्राद्धं महाराज प्रदातव्याऽथ दक्षिणा ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्ततः श्राद्धं पितॄणां चोपतिष्ठति .. 12 ..
सा त्वया कल्पिताऽस्माकं वितीर्णाद्यापि नो नृप.
कुप्याकुप्यं परित्यज्य तां देहि नृप मा चिरम् .. 13 ..
5.219.m:
The brahmins said:
Having performed a śrāddha, O great king, a sacrificial fee must be given / to the brahmins; from that, the śrāddha reaches the ancestors. / It was promised by you to us, but has not yet been bestowed, O king. / Setting aside whether it is valuable or base metal, give it, O king, without delay.

5.219.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā ca nṛpaḥ prāha saṃprahṛṣṭena cetasā ..
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi viprairadya na saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
5.219.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा च नृपः प्राह संप्रहृष्टेन चेतसा ..
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि विप्रैरद्य न संशयः .. 14 ..
5.219.m:
Bhartṛyajña said:
And having heard that, the king said with a delighted mind:
"I am blessed, I am favored by the brahmins today, without doubt.

5.219.s:
ye vāṃchaṃti mamābhīṣṭaṃ śrāddhe bhuktvā'tha paitṛke 1.
tasmādbrūta mahābhāgā yuṣmabhyaṃ kiṃ dadāmyaham .. 15 ..
5.219.d:
ये वांछंति ममाभीष्टं श्राद्धे भुक्त्वाऽथ पैतृके 1.
तस्माद्ब्रूत महाभागा युष्मभ्यं किं ददाम्यहम् .. 15 ..
5.219.m: You who desire my welfare after eating at the ancestral śrāddha— / therefore speak, O exalted ones, what shall I give to you?

5.219.s:
vara nnāgānmadonmattānbhadrajātisamudbhavān ..
kiṃ vā saptipradhānāṃśca manomārutaraṃhasaḥ .. 16 ..
5.219.d:
वर न्नागान्मदोन्मत्तान्भद्रजातिसमुद्भवान् ..
किं वा सप्तिप्रधानांश्च मनोमारुतरंहसः .. 16 ..
5.219.m: Shall it be excellent elephants rutted with pride, born of noble breed? / Or the finest horses, swift as thought and wind?

5.219.s:
kiṃ vā sthānāni citrāṇi grāmāṇi nagarāṇi ca ..
pitṝnuddiśya yatkiṃcinnādeyaṃ vidyate yataḥ .. 17 ..
5.219.d:
किं वा स्थानानि चित्राणि ग्रामाणि नगराणि च ..
पितॄनुद्दिश्य यत्किंचिन्नादेयं विद्यते यतः .. 17 ..
5.219.m: Or varied estates, villages, and towns? / For when dedicated to the ancestors, there is nothing that should not be given."

5.219.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
nāsmākaṃ vājibhiḥ kāryaṃ na ratnairna ca hastibhiḥ ..
na deśairgrāmamukhyairvā nānyenāpi ca kenacit .. 18 ..
5.219.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
नास्माकं वाजिभिः कार्यं न रत्नैर्न च हस्तिभिः ..
न देशैर्ग्राममुख्यैर्वा नान्येनापि च केनचित् .. 18 ..
5.219.m:
The brahmins said:
"We have no need of horses, nor jewels, nor elephants, / nor countries, nor head villages, nor anything else whatsoever.

5.219.s:
yadarthena mahārāja pṛṣṭosmābhiryato bhavān ..
tasmānno dakṣiṇāṃ dehi saṃdehaghnāṃ tapottama .. 19 ..
5.219.d:
यदर्थेन महाराज पृष्टोस्माभिर्यतो भवान् ..
तस्मान्नो दक्षिणां देहि संदेहघ्नां तपोत्तम .. 19 ..
5.219.m: Because of the matter for which you were questioned by us, O great king, / therefore give us the sacrificial fee that destroys doubt, O best of ascetics,

5.219.s: yāṃ pṛcchāmo vayaṃ sarve kautūhalasamāhitāḥ .. 6.220.20 ..
5.219.d: यां पृच्छामो वयं सर्वे कौतूहलसमाहिताः .. 6.220.20 ..
5.219.m: which we all ask, gathered together in curiosity."

5.219.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
upadeśādhikāro'sti brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ..
dātuṃ naiva grahītuṃ ca nī cajātyasya vaidikāḥ .. 21 ..
5.219.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
उपदेशाधिकारोऽस्ति ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् ..
दातुं नैव ग्रहीतुं च नी चजात्यस्य वैदिकाः .. 21 ..
5.219.m:
The king said:
"High-souled brahmins have the authority to instruct, / to give it, not to receive it; O Vedic scholars, [I am] of a lower caste.

5.219.s:
so'haṃ rājā na sarvajño yo yacchāmi dvijottamāḥ ..
upadeśaṃ hi yuṣmabhyaṃ sarvajñebhyo vicakṣaṇāḥ .. 22 ..
5.219.d:
सोऽहं राजा न सर्वज्ञो यो यच्छामि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
उपदेशं हि युष्मभ्यं सर्वज्ञेभ्यो विचक्षणाः .. 22 ..
5.219.m: I am a king, not omniscient, who would give / instruction to you who are omniscient, O best of the twice-born, O discerning ones!"

5.219.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
guruśiṣyasamuttho'yamupadeśo mahīpate ..
prārthayāmo vayaṃ kiṃcinmā bhayaṃ tvaṃ samāviśa .. 23 ..
5.219.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
गुरुशिष्यसमुत्थोऽयमुपदेशो महीपते ..
प्रार्थयामो वयं किंचिन्मा भयं त्वं समाविश .. 23 ..
5.219.m:
The brahmins said:
"Such instruction arises between guru and disciple, O lord of the earth. / We are requesting something; do not give way to fear.

5.219.s:
vayaṃ ca praśnamekaṃ hi pṛcchāmo yadi bhūpate ..
brūṣe kautukayuktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām .. 24 ..
5.219.d:
वयं च प्रश्नमेकं हि पृच्छामो यदि भूपते ..
ब्रूषे कौतुकयुक्तानां सर्वेषां च द्विजन्मनाम् .. 24 ..
5.219.m: Indeed, we ask only one question, if, O ruler of the earth, / you will tell all the twice-born who are filled with curiosity.

5.219.s:
tasmādvada mahābhāga yadi jānāsi tattvataḥ ..
na cedguhyatamaṃ kiṃcitpṛcchāmastvāṃ kutūhalāt .. 25 ..
5.219.d:
तस्माद्वद महाभाग यदि जानासि तत्त्वतः ..
न चेद्गुह्यतमं किंचित्पृच्छामस्त्वां कुतूहलात् .. 25 ..
5.219.m: Therefore speak, O fortunate one, if you know in truth. / If it is not a deep secret, we ask you out of curiosity."

5.219.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
yadi vaḥ saṃśayo viprā yuṣmatpraśnamasaṃśayam ..
kathayiṣyābhi cedguhyaṃ tadvaddhvaṃ gapla? jvarāḥ .. 26 ..
5.219.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
यदि वः संशयो विप्रा युष्मत्प्रश्नमसंशयम् ..
कथयिष्याभि चेद्गुह्यं तद्वद्ध्वं गप्ल? ज्वराः .. 26 ..
5.219.m:
The king said:
"If you have a doubt, O brahmins, your question [will be answered] without doubt; / if it is a secret, I will tell it; be free from agitation."

5.219.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
anneṣu ca vicitreṣu lehyeṣu vividheṣu ca ..
amṛteṣveṣu sarveṣu tathā peyeṣu pārthiva .. .. 27 ..
5.219.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
अन्नेषु च विचित्रेषु लेह्येषु विविधेषु च ..
अमृतेष्वेषु सर्वेषु तथा पेयेषु पार्थिव .. .. 27 ..
5.219.m:
The brahmins said:
"While there are diverse foods and various dishes to be licked, / all these nectars and likewise drinks, O king,

5.219.s:
tasmādadya dine brūhi madhu yacchasi garhitam ..
vartate ca yathā'bhakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 28 ..
5.219.d:
तस्मादद्य दिने ब्रूहि मधु यच्छसि गर्हितम् ..
वर्तते च यथाऽभक्ष्यं ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः .. 28 ..
5.219.m: tell us why on this day you give despised honey, / which is considered inedible, especially for brahmins?

5.219.s:
tathā vicitra māseṣu saṃsthiteṣu narādhipa ..
khaṅgamāṃsaṃ nirāsvādaṃ kasmādyacchasi kevalam .. 29 ..
5.219.d:
तथा विचित्र मासेषु संस्थितेषु नराधिप ..
खङ्गमांसं निरास्वादं कस्माद्यच्छसि केवलम् .. 29 ..
5.219.m: Likewise, while varied meats are available, O ruler of men, / why do you give only tasteless rhinoceros meat?

5.219.s:
saṃti śākāni rājendra pāvanīyāni sarvaśaḥ ..
suṣṭhu svādu karāṇyatra vyañjanārthaṃ mahīpate .. 6.220.30 ..
5.219.d:
संति शाकानि राजेन्द्र पावनीयानि सर्वशः ..
सुष्ठु स्वादु कराण्यत्र व्यञ्जनार्थं महीपते .. 6.220.30 ..
5.219.m: There are vegetables, O best of kings, purifying in every way, / extremely delicious for making condiments here, O lord of the earth.

5.219.s:
kālaśākaṃ sakaṭukaṃ mukhā''dhijanakaṃ mahat ..
kasmādyacchasi cāsmākaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ..
na śrāddhe pratiṣedhaśca prakartavyaḥ kathaṃcana .. 31 ..
5.219.d:
कालशाकं सकटुकं मुखा'ऽधिजनकं महत् ..
कस्माद्यच्छसि चास्माकं भक्त्या परमया युतः ..
न श्राद्धे प्रतिषेधश्च प्रकर्तव्यः कथंचन .. 31 ..
5.219.m: Why do you give us, with supreme devotion, / black vegetables, pungent and causing great distress to the mouth? / Yet at a śrāddha, no prohibition should be made in any way,

5.219.s:
na ca tyājyaṃ samucchiṣṭaṃ tena bhuṃjāmahe tataḥ ..
tadatra kāraṇenaiva guruṇā bhāvyameva hi ..
yena tvaṃ yacchasi prāya etatsiddhirbhavetsthitā .. 32 ..
5.219.d:
न च त्याज्यं समुच्छिष्टं तेन भुंजामहे ततः ..
तदत्र कारणेनैव गुरुणा भाव्यमेव हि ..
येन त्वं यच्छसि प्राय एतत्सिद्धिर्भवेत्स्थिता .. 32 ..
5.219.m: nor should food left over be abandoned; therefore we eat it. / There must surely be an important reason here / by which you mostly give this, and its accomplishment remains assured.

5.219.s:
tasmātkathaya naḥ sarvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ ..
niḥsvāditaṃ yathā dadyādīdṛkchrāddhe vigarhitam .. 33 ..
5.219.d:
तस्मात्कथय नः सर्वं परं कौतूहलं हि नः ..
निःस्वादितं यथा दद्यादीदृक्छ्राद्धे विगर्हितम् .. 33 ..
5.219.m: Therefore tell us everything, for our curiosity is great, / why one would give such tasteless, condemned food in a śrāddha,

5.219.s: yathā tvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla śraddhayā saṃprayacchasi .. 34 ..
5.219.d: यथा त्वं नृपशार्दूल श्रद्धया संप्रयच्छसि .. 34 ..
5.219.m: just as you, O tiger among kings, offer it with faith."

5.219.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ..
sa vailakṣyasmitaṃ prāha salajjaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ .. 35 ..
5.219.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् ..
स वैलक्ष्यस्मितं प्राह सलज्जं पृथिवीपतिः .. 35 ..
5.219.m: Having heard those words of the high-souled brahmins, / the lord of the earth, smiling bashfully, said with embarrassment:

5.219.s:
guhyametanmahābhāgā asmākaṃ yadi saṃsthitam ..
avācyamapi vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ .. 36 ..
5.219.d:
गुह्यमेतन्महाभागा अस्माकं यदि संस्थितम् ..
अवाच्यमपि वक्ष्यामि शृणुध्वं सुसमाहिताः .. 36 ..
5.219.m: "Though this secret of ours is preserved, O fortunate ones, / even though it should not be spoken, I will tell it; listen with concentrated minds.

5.219.s:
ahamāsaṃ purā pāpo lubdhakaścānya janmani ..
nihaṃtā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ tathā bhakṣayitā punaḥ .. 37 ..
5.219.d:
अहमासं पुरा पापो लुब्धकश्चान्य जन्मनि ..
निहंता सर्वजंतूनां तथा भक्षयिता पुनः .. 37 ..
5.219.m: Formerly, in another birth, I was an evil hunter, / a slayer of all creatures and also a devourer [of them].

5.219.s:
paryaṭāmi tadāraṇye dhanuṣā mṛgayārataḥ ..
siṃho vyāghro gajendro vā śarabho vā dvijo ttamāḥ .. 38 ..
5.219.d:
पर्यटामि तदारण्ये धनुषा मृगयारतः ..
सिंहो व्याघ्रो गजेन्द्रो वा शरभो वा द्विजो त्तमाः .. 38 ..
5.219.m: I wandered then in the forest with a bow, devoted to the hunt. / A lion, a tiger, a lordly elephant, or a śarabha, O best of the twice-born—

5.219.s:
madbāṇagocaraṃ prāpto na jīvatyapi karhicit ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhramamāṇo mahītale .. 39 ..
5.219.d:
मद्बाणगोचरं प्राप्तो न जीवत्यपि कर्हिचित् ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य भ्रममाणो महीतले .. 39 ..
5.219.m: none that came into range of my arrow ever remained alive. / Then, at a certain time, roaming over the surface of the earth,

5.219.s:
saṃprāpto'haṃ mahābhāgā agni veśasya sanmuneḥ ..
āśrame samanuprāpto niśīthe kṣutpipāsitaḥ .. 6.220.40 ..
5.219.d:
संप्राप्तोऽहं महाभागा अग्नि वेशस्य सन्मुनेः ..
आश्रमे समनुप्राप्तो निशीथे क्षुत्पिपासितः .. 6.220.40 ..
5.219.m: I arrived, O fortunate ones, at the hermitage of the good sage Agniveśa; / I arrived at midnight, hungry and thirsty.

5.219.s:
tāvattatra saśiṣyāṇāṃ śrāddhakarmavidhiṃ vadan..
saṃsthito veṣṭitaḥ śiṣyaiḥ samantāddvijasattamāḥ .. 41 ..
5.219.d:
तावत्तत्र सशिष्याणां श्राद्धकर्मविधिं वदन्..
संस्थितो वेष्टितः शिष्यैः समन्ताद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 41 ..
5.219.m: At that moment, expounding the rules of the śrāddha rite to his disciples, / he sat surrounded on all sides by his pupils, O best of the twice-born.

5.219.s:
.. agniveśa uvāca .. ..
ṛkṣe pitrye yadā candro haṃsaścāpi kare vrajet ..
trayodaśī tu sā cchāyā vijñeyā kuñjarodbhavā .. 42 ..
5.219.d:
.. अग्निवेश उवाच .. ..
ऋक्षे पित्र्ये यदा चन्द्रो हंसश्चापि करे व्रजेत् ..
त्रयोदशी तु सा च्छाया विज्ञेया कुञ्जरोद्भवा .. 42 ..
5.219.m:
Agniveśa said:
'When the moon is in the ancestral asterism (Maghā) and the sun is in Hasta, / that thirteenth [tithi] is to be known as the elephant's shadow (gajacchāyā).

5.219.s:
pitrye yadāsthitaścendurhaṃsaścāpi kare sthitaḥ ..
tithirvaiśravaṇī yā ca sā cchāyā kuñjarasya ca .. 43 ..
5.219.d:
पित्र्ये यदास्थितश्चेन्दुर्हंसश्चापि करे स्थितः ..
तिथिर्वैश्रवणी या च सा च्छाया कुञ्जरस्य च .. 43 ..
5.219.m: When the moon stands in the ancestral asterism and the sun stands in Hasta, / and the tithi belongs to Kubera, that too is the shadow of an elephant.

5.219.s:
saiṃhikeyo yadā caṃdraṃ grasate parvasaṃdhiṣu ..
hasticchāyā tu sā jñeyā tasyāṃ śrāddhaṃ samācaret .. 44 ..
5.219.d:
सैंहिकेयो यदा चंद्रं ग्रसते पर्वसंधिषु ..
हस्तिच्छाया तु सा ज्ञेया तस्यां श्राद्धं समाचरेत् .. 44 ..
5.219.m: When the son of Siṃhikā (Rāhu) swallows the moon at the conjunction of parvan days, / that should be known as the elephant's shadow; on that, one should perform a śrāddha.'

5.219.s:
tasyāṃ yaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ jalairapi prabhaktitaḥ ..
yāvaddvādaśa varṣāṇi pitarastasya tarpitāḥ .. 45 ..
5.219.d:
तस्यां यः कुरुते श्राद्धं जलैरपि प्रभक्तितः ..
यावद्द्वादश वर्षाणि पितरस्तस्य तर्पिताः .. 45 ..
5.219.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha on it, even with just waters, full of devotion, / his ancestors remain satisfied for up to twelve years.

5.219.s:
vanaspatigate some yā cchāyā pūrvatomukhī ..
gajacchāyā tu sā jñeyā pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam .. 46 ..
5.219.d:
वनस्पतिगते सोमे या च्छाया पूर्वतोमुखी ..
गजच्छाया तु सा ज्ञेया पितॄणां दत्तमक्षयम् .. 46 ..
5.219.m: When the moon is in an arboreal constellation, that shadow facing the east / should be known as Gajacchāyā; what is given to the ancestors [then] is inexhaustible.

5.219.s:
sā bhavecca na sandehaḥ puṇyadā paitṛkī tithiḥ ..
tasyāṃ śrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhṛtāśca ye .. 47 ..
5.219.d:
सा भवेच्च न सन्देहः पुण्यदा पैतृकी तिथिः ..
तस्यां श्राद्धं प्रकर्तव्यं संभाराः संभृताश्च ये .. 47 ..
5.219.m: There is no doubt that this ancestral lunar day brings merit; / on it, śrāddha should be performed, and whatever provisions have been gathered,

5.219.s:
prabhāte tu na sandehaḥ pitṝṇāṃ paritṛptaye ..
śākaistathaiṃgudairbilvairbadaraiścirbhaṭairapi .. 48. ..
yadannaṃ puruṣo'śnāti tadannāstasya devatāḥ ..
bāḍhamityeva te procya gatāḥ svaṃsvaṃ niketanam .. 49 ..
5.219.d:
प्रभाते तु न सन्देहः पितॄणां परितृप्तये ..
शाकैस्तथैंगुदैर्बिल्वैर्बदरैश्चिर्भटैरपि .. 48. ..
यदन्नं पुरुषोऽश्नाति तदन्नास्तस्य देवताः ..
बाढमित्येव ते प्रोच्य गताः स्वंस्वं निकेतनम् .. 49 ..
5.219.m: in the morning, without doubt, for the full satisfaction of the ancestors, / with vegetables, and likewise with iṅguda, bilva, badara, and cirbhaṭa fruits. / Whatever food a man eats, of that food are his deities.” / Saying “So be it,” they departed, each to his own dwelling,

5.219.s:
sarve śiṣyā mahābhāgāḥ nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ ..
agniveśyo'pi suṣvāpa samāmantrya dvijottamān.. 6.220.50 ..
5.219.d:
सर्वे शिष्या महाभागाः नारायणपुरोगमाः ..
अग्निवेश्योऽपि सुष्वाप समामन्त्र्य द्विजोत्तमान्.. 6.220.50 ..
5.219.m: all the fortunate disciples, headed by Nārāyaṇa. / Agniveśya too, having bidden farewell to the best of the twice-born, went to sleep.

5.219.s:
tena saṃkathyamānaṃ ca rātrau tacca śrutaṃ mayā ..
ahaṃ cāpi kariṣyāmi prātaḥ śrāddhamasaṃśayam .. 51 ..
5.219.d:
तेन संकथ्यमानं च रात्रौ तच्च श्रुतं मया ..
अहं चापि करिष्यामि प्रातः श्राद्धमसंशयम् .. 51 ..
5.219.m: And that which was spoken by him at night was heard by me: / “I too will surely perform a śrāddha in the morning.

5.219.s:
nihatya khaḍgamādāya tasya māṃsaṃ supuṣkalam ..
tathā madhu samādāya kālaśākaṃ viśeṣataḥ .. .. 52 ..
5.219.d:
निहत्य खड्गमादाय तस्य मांसं सुपुष्कलम् ..
तथा मधु समादाय कालशाकं विशेषतः .. .. 52 ..
5.219.m: Having slain a rhinoceros and taken its abundant flesh, / and likewise having gathered honey, especially kālaśāka,

5.219.s: svajātīyebhya ādāya tarpayiṣyāmi tānpitṝn .. 53 ..
5.219.d: स्वजातीयेभ्य आदाय तर्पयिष्यामि तान्पितॄन् .. 53 ..
5.219.m: having taken [it] from members of my own caste, I will satisfy those ancestors.”

5.219.s:
evaṃ niścitya manasā prasupto'haṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale ..54..
5.219.d:
एवं निश्चित्य मनसा प्रसुप्तोऽहं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ततः प्रभाते विमले प्रोद्गते रविमण्डले ..54..
5.219.m: Having resolved thus in mind, O best of the twice-born, I went to sleep. / Then in the clear morning, when the disc of the sun had risen,

5.219.s:
madhujālāni bhūrīṇi gṛhītāni mayā tataḥ ..
kālaśākaṃ tathā labdhaṃ svecchayā dvijasattamāḥ ..55..
5.219.d:
मधुजालानि भूरीणि गृहीतानि मया ततः ..
कालशाकं तथा लब्धं स्वेच्छया द्विजसत्तमाः ..55..
5.219.m: many honeycombs were then gathered by me; / likewise, kālaśāka was obtained at will, O best of the twice-born.

5.219.s:
tataḥ sarvaṃ samādāya śrapitaṃ tatkṣaṇānmayā ..
snātvā ca nijavargāṇāṃ pitṝnuddiśya cātmanaḥ ..
pradattaṃ lubdhakānāṃ ca bhaktipūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 56 ..
5.219.d:
ततः सर्वं समादाय श्रपितं तत्क्षणान्मया ..
स्नात्वा च निजवर्गाणां पितॄनुद्दिश्य चात्मनः ..
प्रदत्तं लुब्धकानां च भक्तिपूर्वं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 56 ..
5.219.m: Then, having taken it all, it was instantly cooked by me; / and having bathed, intending it for my own ancestral group, / it was offered to the hunters with devotion, O best of the twice-born.

5.219.s:
evaṃ mayā purā dattaṃ pitṝ nuddiśya tānnijān ..
nānyatkiṃcinmayā dattaṃ kadācitkasyacidvijāḥ .. 57 ..
5.219.d:
एवं मया पुरा दत्तं पितॄ नुद्दिश्य तान्निजान् ..
नान्यत्किंचिन्मया दत्तं कदाचित्कस्यचिद्विजाः .. 57 ..
5.219.m: Thus it was given by me formerly, intended for those ancestors of my own; / nothing else was ever given by me to anyone, O twice-born.

5.219.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā mṛtyuṃ prāpto'smyahaṃ dvijāḥ ..
taddānasya prabhāvena pārthivīṃ yonimāśritaḥ .. 58 ..
5.219.d:
ततः कालेन महता मृत्युं प्राप्तोऽस्म्यहं द्विजाः ..
तद्दानस्य प्रभावेन पार्थिवीं योनिमाश्रितः .. 58 ..
5.219.m: Then, in the course of a long time, I met with death, O twice-born; / by the power of that gift, I entered an earthly womb.

5.219.s:
evaṃ jātismaratvaṃ ca sañjātaṃ me dvijottamāḥ ..
te ca me tarpitāstena khaḍgamāṃsena mākṣikaiḥ ..59 ..
5.219.d:
एवं जातिस्मरत्वं च सञ्जातं मे द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ते च मे तर्पितास्तेन खड्गमांसेन माक्षिकैः ..59 ..
5.219.m: Thus the recollection of previous births arose in me, O best of the twice-born; / and they were satisfied by me with that rhinoceros flesh and honey.

5.219.s:
saṃprāptāḥ paramāṃ prītiṃ tato dvāśavārṣikīm ..
etasmātkāraṇācchrāddhaṃ prakaromi dvijottamāḥ .. 6.220.60 ..
5.219.d:
संप्राप्ताः परमां प्रीतिं ततो द्वाशवार्षिकीम् ..
एतस्मात्कारणाच्छ्राद्धं प्रकरोमि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 6.220.60 ..
5.219.m: Consequently, they obtained supreme delight lasting for twelve years. / For this reason, O best of the twice-born, I perform the śrāddha

5.219.s:
khaḍgamāṃsena madhunā kālaśākena bhūriśaḥ ..
vidhihīnaṃ dvijairhīnaṃ tiladarbhairvivarjitam .. 61 ..
5.219.d:
खड्गमांसेन मधुना कालशाकेन भूरिशः ..
विधिहीनं द्विजैर्हीनं तिलदर्भैर्विवर्जितम् .. 61 ..
5.219.m: with rhinoceros flesh, with honey, and with plentiful kālaśāka. / Devoid of ritual rules, devoid of twice-born, destitute of sesame and darbha grass,

5.219.s:
mayā tadvihitaṃ śrāddhaṃ tasyaitatphalamāgatam ..
sāṃprataṃ vidhinā samyagbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ .. 62 ..
5.219.d:
मया तद्विहितं श्राद्धं तस्यैतत्फलमागतम् ..
सांप्रतं विधिना सम्यग्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः .. 62 ..
5.219.m: that śrāddha was performed by me; this was the fruit that accrued from it. / Now, properly according to the rule, with brahmins who have crossed to the end of the Vedas

5.219.s:
upaviṣṭaiḥ karomyeva yacchrāddhaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
darbhaistilaiḥ samopetaṃ mantravacca dvijottamāḥ .. 63 ..
5.219.d:
उपविष्टैः करोम्येव यच्छ्राद्धं श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
दर्भैस्तिलैः समोपेतं मन्त्रवच्च द्विजोत्तमाः .. 63 ..
5.219.m: seated [here], I perform the śrāddha endowed with faith, / furnished with darbha grass and sesame, and accompanied by mantras, O best of the twice-born.

5.219.s:
no jānāmi phalaṃ kiṃ vā sāṃprataṃ ca bhaviṣyati ..
tasmādevaṃ parijñāya yūyaṃ caiva dvijottamāḥ .. 64 ..
5.219.d:
नो जानामि फलं किं वा सांप्रतं च भविष्यति ..
तस्मादेवं परिज्ञाय यूयं चैव द्विजोत्तमाः .. 64 ..
5.219.m: I do not know what further fruit will come to pass now. / Therefore, knowing this thus, you too, O best of the twice-born,

5.219.s:
saṃtarpayadhvaṃ ca pitṝnnijāngajadine sthite ..
chāyāyāṃ caiva jātāyāṃ kuñjarasya dvijottamāḥ ..65..
5.219.d:
संतर्पयध्वं च पितॄन्निजान्गजदिने स्थिते ..
छायायां चैव जातायां कुञ्जरस्य द्विजोत्तमाः ..65..
5.219.m: should satisfy your own ancestors when the elephant-day arrives, / and when the shadow of the elephant has arisen, O best of the twice-born,

5.219.s:
yena saṃjāyate tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ dvādaśābdikī ..
yuṣmākaṃ ca gatiḥ śreṣṭhā yathā jātā mamādhunā .. 66 ..
5.219.d:
येन संजायते तृप्तिः पितॄणां द्वादशाब्दिकी ..
युष्माकं च गतिः श्रेष्ठा यथा जाता ममाधुना .. 66 ..
5.219.m: by which the twelve-year satisfaction of the ancestors is produced, / and an exalted state [shall be] yours, just as has arisen for me now.”

5.219.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve te brāhmaṇottamāḥ ..
saṃtuṣṭāḥ sādhuvādāṃśca dadustasya mahīpateḥ .. 67 ..
5.219.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे ते ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ..
संतुष्टाः साधुवादांश्च ददुस्तस्य महीपतेः .. 67 ..
5.219.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Hearing that speech of his, all those best of brahmins / were pleased and gave praises to that king.

5.219.s:
tataḥprabhṛti cakruste śrāddhāni dvijasattamāḥ ..
trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyasya kṛṣṇāyāṃ bhaktitatparāḥ .. 68 ..
5.219.d:
ततःप्रभृति चक्रुस्ते श्राद्धानि द्विजसत्तमाः ..
त्रयोदश्यां नभस्यस्य कृष्णायां भक्तितत्पराः .. 68 ..
5.219.m: From that time forth, those best of the twice-born performed śrāddhas, / intent on devotion, on the thirteenth day of the dark fortnight of the month of Nabhasya.

5.219.s:
madhunā kālaśākena khaḍgamāṃsena tarpitāḥ ..
prāpnuvaṃti parāṃ siddhiṃ vimānavaramāsthitāḥ .. 69 ..
5.219.d:
मधुना कालशाकेन खड्गमांसेन तर्पिताः ..
प्राप्नुवंति परां सिद्धिं विमानवरमास्थिताः .. 69 ..
5.219.m: Satisfied with honey, with kālaśāka, and with rhinoceros flesh, / mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot, they attain supreme perfection.

5.219.s:
spardhaṃte sahitā daivaiḥ pitaraśca viśeṣataḥ ..
vaṃśajena pradattasya prabhāvātsurasattamāḥ .. 6.220.70 ..
5.219.d:
स्पर्धंते सहिता दैवैः पितरश्च विशेषतः ..
वंशजेन प्रदत्तस्य प्रभावात्सुरसत्तमाः .. 6.220.70 ..
5.219.m: The ancestors especially rival the gods / by the power of what is offered by their descendant, O best of gods.

5.219.s:
śrāddhārthaṃ saṃparijñāya mantraṃ cakruḥ parasparam ..
ādityā vasavo rudrā nāsatyāvapi pārthiva .. 71 ..
yathā na bhavati śrāddhaṃ tasminnahani bhūtale ..
yatprabhāvādvayaṃ sarve mānuṣaiḥ śrāddhamāśritaiḥ ..
na yāmo'bhibhavasthānaṃ tasmācchapsyāmahe ca tān .. 72 .1
5.219.d:
श्राद्धार्थं संपरिज्ञाय मन्त्रं चक्रुः परस्परम् ..
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा नासत्यावपि पार्थिव .. 71 ..
यथा न भवति श्राद्धं तस्मिन्नहनि भूतले ..
यत्प्रभावाद्वयं सर्वे मानुषैः श्राद्धमाश्रितैः ..
न यामोऽभिभवस्थानं तस्माच्छप्स्यामहे च तान् .. 72 .1
5.219.m:
Having realized the purpose of the śrāddha, they held counsel with one another— / the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and the two Nāsatyas, O king:
“So that no śrāddha takes place on that day upon the surface of the earth, / by the power of which we all may not fall into defeat by mortals / who have resorted to the śrāddha, therefore we shall curse them:

5.219.s:
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ kariṣyati ..
kanyāsaṃsthe sahasrāṃśau tasya syādvaṃśasaṃkṣayaḥ ..73..
5.219.d:
अद्यप्रभृति यः श्राद्धं त्रयोदश्यां करिष्यति ..
कन्यासंस्थे सहस्रांशौ तस्य स्याद्वंशसंक्षयः ..73..
5.219.m: ‘From this day forth, whoever performs a śrāddha on the thirteenth lunar day / when the thousand-rayed sun stands in Virgo, his lineage shall be destroyed!’”

5.219.s: iti śāpena devānāṃ nirdagdheyaṃ mahātithiḥ .. 74 ..
5.219.d: इति शापेन देवानां निर्दग्धेयं महातिथिः .. 74 ..
5.219.m: Thus, by the curse of the gods, this great lunar day was scorched.

5.219.s:
tataḥprabhṛti naitasyā kriyate śrāddhamuttamam ..
yaḥ pramādena kurute tasya syādvaṃśa saṃkṣayaḥ .. 76 ..
yena bhītā na kurvaṃti cchāyāyāṃ kuñjarasya ca ..
viśeṣeṇa gajacchāye tatra piṇḍo'yamāhṛtaḥ .. 73 ..
5.219.d:
ततःप्रभृति नैतस्या क्रियते श्राद्धमुत्तमम् ..
यः प्रमादेन कुरुते तस्य स्याद्वंश संक्षयः .. 76 ..
येन भीता न कुर्वंति च्छायायां कुञ्जरस्य च ..
विशेषेण गजच्छाये तत्र पिण्डोऽयमाहृतः .. 73 ..
5.219.m:
From then on, the highest śrāddha is not performed on it; / whoever performs it out of negligence, his lineage will be destroyed.
Frightened by which, they do not perform it in the shadow of an elephant; / especially in the Gajacchāyā, this ancestral ball of rice is avoided there.

5.219.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe gajacchāyāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatyuttaradviśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 220 ..
5.219.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे गजच्छायामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम विंशत्युत्तरद्विशत तमोऽध्यायः .. 220 ..
5.219.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twentieth chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Gajacchāyā" in the Śrāddhakalpa of the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.220.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
etasmātkāraṇātkaścittasminnahani pārthiva ..
dadāti naiva ca śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya karhicit ..
vaṃśacchedabhayādrājansatyametanmayoditam .. 1 ..
5.220.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
एतस्मात्कारणात्कश्चित्तस्मिन्नहनि पार्थिव ..
ददाति नैव च श्राद्धं पितॄनुद्दिश्य कर्हिचित् ..
वंशच्छेदभयाद्राजन्सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 1 ..
5.220.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / For this reason, O king, on that day / no one ever offers a śrāddha intended for the ancestors, / out of fear of the destruction of their lineage, O king; this is the truth spoken by me.

5.220.s:
śrāddhaṃ vināpi dātavyaṃ taddine madhunā saha ..
pāyasaṃ brāhmaṇāgryebhyaḥ saghṛtaṃ tṛptikāraṇāt .. 2 ..
5.220.d:
श्राद्धं विनापि दातव्यं तद्दिने मधुना सह ..
पायसं ब्राह्मणाग्र्येभ्यः सघृतं तृप्तिकारणात् .. 2 ..
5.220.m: Even without a śrāddha, on that day milk-rice cooked with honey / and with clarified butter should be given to the foremost of brahmins for the sake of satisfaction.

5.220.s:
khaḍgamāṃsaṃ kālaśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vādhrīṇasodbhavam ..
pradeyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaśca tatsamaṃtādudāhṛtam .. 3 ..
5.220.d:
खड्गमांसं कालशाकं मांसं वाध्रीणसोद्भवम् ..
प्रदेयं ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च तत्समंतादुदाहृतम् .. 3 ..
5.220.m: Rhinoceros flesh, kālaśāka, or meat coming from a vādhrīṇasa / should be given to the brahmins; it has been universally declared thus.

5.220.s:
triḥpibaśceṃdriyakṣīṇaḥ sarvayūthānugastathā ..
eṣa vādhrīṇasaḥ proktaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaḥ sadā .. 4 ..
5.220.d:
त्रिःपिबश्चेंद्रियक्षीणः सर्वयूथानुगस्तथा ..
एष वाध्रीणसः प्रोक्तः पितॄणां तृप्तिदः सदा .. 4 ..
5.220.m: One that drinks thrice, whose senses are decayed, and who follows the whole herd— / such is declared to be a vādhrīṇasa, always bestowing satisfaction upon the ancestors.

5.220.s:
tasyābhāve'pi dātavyaṃ kṣīraudanamanuttamam ..
tasminnahani viprebhyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭaye nṛpa .. 5 ..
5.220.d:
तस्याभावेऽपि दातव्यं क्षीरौदनमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्मिन्नहनि विप्रेभ्यः पितॄणां तुष्टये नृप .. 5 ..
5.220.m: In the absence of that, unexcelled milk-rice should be given / to the priests on that day for the gratification of the ancestors, O king.

5.220.s:
tasyābhāve'pi dātavyaṃ jalaṃ tilavimiśritam..
sadarbhaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca hiraṇyaśakalānvitam .. 6 ..
5.220.d:
तस्याभावेऽपि दातव्यं जलं तिलविमिश्रितम्..
सदर्भं सहिरण्यं च हिरण्यशकलान्वितम् .. 6 ..
5.220.m: Even in the absence of that, water mixed with sesame seeds should be given, / with darbha grass, with gold, and accompanied by fragments of gold.

5.220.s:
yacchreyo jāyate puṃsaḥ pakṣaśrāddhena pārthiva ..
kṛtena tatphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tasminnahani pārthiva .. 7 ..
5.220.d:
यच्छ्रेयो जायते पुंसः पक्षश्राद्धेन पार्थिव ..
कृतेन तत्फलं कृत्स्नं तस्मिन्नहनि पार्थिव .. 7 ..
5.220.m: Whatever benefit accrues to a man by the fortnight-śrāddha, O king, / all that entire fruit [is attained] when it is performed on that day, O king,

5.220.s:
pitṝnuddiśya cā''jyena madhunā pāyasena ca ..
kālaśākena madhunā khaḍgamāṃsena vā nṛpa .. 8 ..
5.220.d:
पितॄनुद्दिश्य चा'ऽज्येन मधुना पायसेन च ..
कालशाकेन मधुना खड्गमांसेन वा नृप .. 8 ..
5.220.m: intended for the ancestors, with clarified butter, with honey, and with milk-rice, / or with kālaśāka, with honey, and with rhinoceros flesh, O king.

5.220.s:
śrāddhaṃ vināpi dattena śrutireṣā purātanī ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pitryarkṣye samupasthite ..
trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyasya hastage dinanāyake .. 9 ..
5.220.d:
श्राद्धं विनापि दत्तेन श्रुतिरेषा पुरातनी ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पित्र्यर्क्ष्ये समुपस्थिते ..
त्रयोदश्यां नभस्यस्य हस्तगे दिननायके .. 9 ..
5.220.m: This is an ancient Vedic text: even without a [full] śrāddha, when [water] is given, / therefore with every effort, when the ancestral constellation has arrived, / on the thirteenth day of the month of Nabhasya, when the lord of day is in Hasta,

5.220.s:
daridreṇāpi dātavyaṃ hiraṇyaśakalānvitam ..
toyaṃ tilairyutaṃ rājanpitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭimicchatā .. 6.221.10 .. ..
5.220.d:
दरिद्रेणापि दातव्यं हिरण्यशकलान्वितम् ..
तोयं तिलैर्युतं राजन्पितॄणां तुष्टिमिच्छता .. 6.221.10 .. ..
5.220.m: even a poor man should offer water joined with sesamum seeds / and accompanied by small pieces of gold, O king, if he desires the satisfaction of the ancestors. // 6.221.10

5.220.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
māṃsaṃ vigarhitaṃ vipra yataḥ śāstre nigadyate ..
tasmāttatkriyate kena śrāddhaṃ kīrtaya me'khilam .. 11 ..
5.220.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
मांसं विगर्हितं विप्र यतः शास्त्रे निगद्यते ..
तस्मात्तत्क्रियते केन श्राद्धं कीर्तय मेऽखिलम् .. 11 ..
5.220.m: Ānarta said: / Since meat is condemned in scripture, O brahmin, / on what account then is it used in a śrāddha? Tell me all this. // 11

5.220.s:
svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayati nirdayaḥ ..
sa nūnaṃ narakaṃ yāti proktametanmaharṣibhiḥ .. 12 ..
5.220.d:
स्वमांसं परमांसेन यो वर्धयति निर्दयः ..
स नूनं नरकं याति प्रोक्तमेतन्महर्षिभिः .. 12 ..
5.220.m: The merciless one who increases his own flesh with the flesh of another / surely goes to hell: this has been declared by the great seers. // 12

5.220.s:
tvaṃ ca tasya prabhāvaṃ me prajalpasi dvijo ttama ..
viśeṣācchrāddhakṛtye ca tadevaṃ mama saṃśayaḥ .. 13 ..
5.220.d:
त्वं च तस्य प्रभावं मे प्रजल्पसि द्विजो त्तम ..
विशेषाच्छ्राद्धकृत्ये च तदेवं मम संशयः .. 13 ..
5.220.m: And you proclaim its power to me, O best of the twice-born, / especially in the rite of śrāddha; therefore this is my doubt. // 13

5.220.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāga māṃsaṃ sadbhirvigarhitam ..
śrāddhe prayujyate yasmāttatte'haṃ vacmi kāraṇam .. 14 ..
5.220.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभाग मांसं सद्भिर्विगर्हितम् ..
श्राद्धे प्रयुज्यते यस्मात्तत्तेऽहं वच्मि कारणम् .. 14 ..
5.220.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / This is true, O fortunate one: meat is condemned by the virtuous. / Why it is employed in a śrāddha, that reason I shall tell you. // 14

5.220.s:
yadā cāraṃbhitā sṛṣṭirbrahmaṇā lokakāriṇā ..
saṃpūjya ca pitṝndevānnāṃdīmukhapuraḥsarān..
tadā khaḍgaḥ samutpannaḥ pūrvaṃ vādhrīṇasaśca yaḥ .. 15 ..
5.220.d:
यदा चारंभिता सृष्टिर्ब्रह्मणा लोककारिणा ..
संपूज्य च पितॄन्देवान्नांदीमुखपुरःसरान्..
तदा खड्गः समुत्पन्नः पूर्वं वाध्रीणसश्च यः .. 15 ..
5.220.m: When creation was begun by Brahmā, the maker of the worlds, / having worshiped the ancestors and the gods preceded by the Nāndīmukhas, / then the rhinoceros was brought forth first, and also the vādhrīṇasa. // 15

5.220.s:
tato ye pitaro divyā ye ca mānuṣasambhavāḥ ..
jagṛhuste tataḥ sarve balibhūtamivātmanaḥ .. 16 ..
5.220.d:
ततो ये पितरो दिव्या ये च मानुषसम्भवाः ..
जगृहुस्ते ततः सर्वे बलिभूतमिवात्मनः .. 16 ..
5.220.m: Then those ancestors who are divine and those born of human origin, / they all seized them then as their own offering. // 16

5.220.s:
tānuvāca tato brahmā etau tu pitaro mayā ..
yuṣmabhyaṃ kalpitau samyagbalibhūtau pragṛhyatām .. 17 ..
5.220.d:
तानुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा एतौ तु पितरो मया ..
युष्मभ्यं कल्पितौ सम्यग्बलिभूतौ प्रगृह्यताम् .. 17 ..
5.220.m: Then Brahmā said to them: 'These two, O ancestors, / have been properly appointed by me as an offering for you; accept them! // 17

5.220.s:
etābhyāṃ paramā prītiryuṣmabhyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ..
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ parametau naro bhuvi .. 18 ..
5.220.d:
एताभ्यां परमा प्रीतिर्युष्मभ्यं संभविष्यति ..
मम वाक्यादसंदिग्धं परमेतौ नरो भुवि .. 18 ..
5.220.m: From these two, supreme gratification will arise for you. / By my word, beyond doubt, a man on earth [who offers] these two // 18

5.220.s:
naiva saṃprāpsyate pāpaṃ yuṣmadarthaṃhanannapi ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 19 ..
5.220.d:
नैव संप्राप्स्यते पापं युष्मदर्थंहनन्नपि ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता .. 19 ..
5.220.m: will not incur sin at all, even though killing for your sake. / Therefore, with every effort, it must be given by one who desires prosperity. // 19

5.220.s:
khaḍgavādhrīṇasodbhūtaṃ māṃsaṃ śrāddhe sutṛptidam ..
tau cāpi paramau divyau svargaṃ lokaṃ gamiṣyataḥ .. 6.221.20 ..
5.220.d:
खड्गवाध्रीणसोद्भूतं मांसं श्राद्धे सुतृप्तिदम् ..
तौ चापि परमौ दिव्यौ स्वर्गं लोकं गमिष्यतः .. 6.221.20 ..
5.220.m: The meat derived from the rhinoceros and the vādhrīṇasa gives great satisfaction in a śrāddha, / and those two supreme divine beings shall go to the heavenly world. // 6.221.20

5.220.s:
śrāddhadasya paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati sudurlabham ..
pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā tṛptirbhaveddvādaśavārṣikī .. 21 ..
5.220.d:
श्राद्धदस्य परं श्रेयो भविष्यति सुदुर्लभम् ..
पितॄणां चाक्षया तृप्तिर्भवेद्द्वादशवार्षिकी .. 21 ..
5.220.m: The giver of the śrāddha will obtain supreme, rare benefit, / and the satisfaction of the ancestors will be inexhaustible for twelve years. // 21

5.220.s:
etasmātkāraṇācchastaṃ māṃsamābhyāṃ narādhipa ..
tasminnahani nānyatra viniyogo'sya kīrtitaḥ .. 22 ..
5.220.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाच्छस्तं मांसमाभ्यां नराधिप ..
तस्मिन्नहनि नान्यत्र विनियोगोऽस्य कीर्तितः .. 22 ..
5.220.m: For this reason, the meat from these two is praised, O ruler of men; / its employment is stated for that day, and not anywhere else.' // 22

5.220.s:
.. rohitāśva uvāca .. ..
aprāptakhaḍgamāṃsasya tathā vādhrīṇasasya ca ..
kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavedvipra pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikā rakam .. 23 ..
5.220.d:
.. रोहिताश्व उवाच .. ..
अप्राप्तखड्गमांसस्य तथा वाध्रीणसस्य च ..
कथं श्राद्धं भवेद्विप्र पितॄणां तृप्तिका रकम् .. 23 ..
5.220.m: Rohitāśva said: / For one who has not obtained rhinoceros meat or that of a vādhrīṇasa, / how can there be a śrāddha that brings satisfaction to the ancestors, O brahmin? // 23

5.220.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
madhunā saha dātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ pitṛtuṣṭaye ..
tena vai vārṣikī tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ copajāyate .. 24 ..
5.220.d:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
मधुना सह दातव्यं पायसं पितृतुष्टये ..
तेन वै वार्षिकी तृप्तिः पितॄणां चोपजायते .. 24 ..
5.220.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Milk-rice should be given together with honey for the gratification of the ancestors; / indeed, through that, satisfaction for a year is produced for the ancestors. // 24

5.220.s:
ājaṃ ca piśitaṃ rājañchiśumārasamudbhavam..
māṃsaṃ pratuṣṭaye proktaṃ vatsaraṃ māsavarjitam .. 25 ..
5.220.d:
आजं च पिशितं राजञ्छिशुमारसमुद्भवम्..
मांसं प्रतुष्टये प्रोक्तं वत्सरं मासवर्जितम् .. 25 ..
5.220.m: Goat meat, O king, and meat derived from a dolphin / are proclaimed to bring satisfaction for a year minus one month. // 25

5.220.s:
tadabhāve varāhasya daśamāsapratuṣṭidam ..
māṃsaṃ proktaṃ mahārāja pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 26 ..
5.220.d:
तदभावे वराहस्य दशमासप्रतुष्टिदम् ..
मांसं प्रोक्तं महाराज पितॄणां नात्र संशयः .. 26 ..
5.220.m: In its absence, the meat of a wild boar gives satisfaction for ten months / to the ancestors, O great king; there is no doubt in this. // 26

5.220.s:
āraṇyamahiṣotthena tṛptiḥ syānnavamāsikī ..
ruroścaivāṣṭamāsotthā eṇasya saptamāsikā .. 27 ..
5.220.d:
आरण्यमहिषोत्थेन तृप्तिः स्यान्नवमासिकी ..
रुरोश्चैवाष्टमासोत्था एणस्य सप्तमासिका .. 27 ..
5.220.m: From [the meat] of a wild buffalo there would be satisfaction for nine months, / and that from a ruru deer lasts eight months, and from a blackbuck seven months. // 27

5.220.s:
śambarormāsaṣaṭkaṃ ca śaśakasya tu pañcakam ..
catvāraḥ śallakasyoktāstrayo vā taittirasya ca .. 28 ..
5.220.d:
शम्बरोर्मासषट्कं च शशकस्य तु पञ्चकम् ..
चत्वारः शल्लकस्योक्तास्त्रयो वा तैत्तिरस्य च .. 28 ..
5.220.m: From an elk, six months; and from a hare, five; / four are declared from a porcupine, or three from a partridge; // 28

5.220.s:
māsadvayaṃ ca matsyasya māsamekaṃ kapiñjale ..
nānyeṣāṃ yojayenmāṃsaṃ pitṛkārye kathaṃcana .. 29 ..
5.220.d:
मासद्वयं च मत्स्यस्य मासमेकं कपिञ्जले ..
नान्येषां योजयेन्मांसं पितृकार्ये कथंचन .. 29 ..
5.220.m: and two months from fish; one month in the case of a kapiñjala bird. / One should not employ the meat of others in ancestral rites in any way. // 29

5.220.s: eteṣāmeva māṃsāni pāvanāni nṛpottama .. 6.221.30 ..
5.220.d: एतेषामेव मांसानि पावनानि नृपोत्तम .. 6.221.30 ..
5.220.m: Only the meats of these are purifying, O best of kings. // 6.221.30

5.220.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
kasmādete pavitrāḥ syuryeṣāṃ māṃsaṃ pracoditam ..
śrāddhe ca tanmamācakṣva yathāvaddvijasattama .. 31 ..
5.220.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
कस्मादेते पवित्राः स्युर्येषां मांसं प्रचोदितम् ..
श्राद्धे च तन्ममाचक्ष्व यथावद्द्विजसत्तम .. 31 ..
5.220.m: Ānarta said: / Why should these, whose meat is prescribed / in a śrāddha, be pure? Explain that to me properly, O best of the twice-born. // 31

5.220.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
sṛṣṭiṃ prakurvatā tena paśavo lokakāriṇā ..
khaḍgavādhrīṇasādīnāṃ paścātsṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā .. 32 ..
5.220.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
सृष्टिं प्रकुर्वता तेन पशवो लोककारिणा ..
खड्गवाध्रीणसादीनां पश्चात्सृष्टाः स्वयंभुवा .. 32 ..
5.220.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / As he was making creation, the animals were created / after the rhinoceros, the vādhrīṇasa, and the rest, by that self-manifest maker of the worlds. // 32

5.220.s:
ekādaśapramāṇena tataścānye nṛpottama ..
ajaśca prathamaṃ sṛṣṭaḥ sa tathā medhyatāṃ gataḥ .. 33 ..
5.220.d:
एकादशप्रमाणेन ततश्चान्ये नृपोत्तम ..
अजश्च प्रथमं सृष्टः स तथा मेध्यतां गतः .. 33 ..
5.220.m: Then others [were created], O best of kings, according to a measure of eleven; / and the goat was created first, and thus it attained sacrificial fitness. // 33

5.220.s:
tathaite prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ paśavo'tra narādhipa ..
sasyāni sṛjatā tena tilāḥ pūrvaṃ ca nirmitāḥ .. 34 ..
5.220.d:
तथैते प्रथमं सृष्टाः पशवोऽत्र नराधिप ..
सस्यानि सृजता तेन तिलाः पूर्वं च निर्मिताः .. 34 ..
5.220.m: Thus these animals were created first here, O ruler of men. / As he was creating crops, sesamum seeds were fashioned first. // 34

5.220.s:
śrāddhārthaṃ vrīhayaḥ sṛṣṭā vanyeṣu ca priyaṃgavaḥ..
godhūmāśca yavāścaiva māṣā mudrāśca vai nṛpa [. 35 ..
5.220.d:
श्राद्धार्थं व्रीहयः सृष्टा वन्येषु च प्रियंगवः..
गोधूमाश्च यवाश्चैव माषा मुद्राश्च वै नृप [. 35 ..
5.220.m: Rice was created for the sake of śrāddha, and priyaṅgu among wild grains, / and wheat, and barley, and black gram, and mung beans, O king; // 35

5.220.s:
nīvārāścāpi śyāmākāḥ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam ..
tṛptiṃ māṃsena vāñchaṃti māṃsaṃ māṃsena varjitam .. 36 ..
5.220.d:
नीवाराश्चापि श्यामाकाः प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाक्रमम् ..
तृप्तिं मांसेन वाञ्छंति मांसं मांसेन वर्जितम् .. 36 ..
5.220.m: and wild rice and millet; I will explain them in order. / They desire satisfaction through meat, [yet] meat is devoid of meat. // 36

5.220.s:
puṣpajātyo yadā sṛṣṭāstadā prākchatapatrikā ..
sṛṣṭā tena ca mukhyā sā śrāddhakarmaṇi sarvadā .. 37 ..
5.220.d:
पुष्पजात्यो यदा सृष्टास्तदा प्राक्छतपत्रिका ..
सृष्टा तेन च मुख्या सा श्राद्धकर्मणि सर्वदा .. 37 ..
5.220.m: When species of flowers were created, the rose was created / first by him, and it is principal in the śrāddha rite at all times. // 37

5.220.s:
dhātūni sṛjatā tena rūpyaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ..
tena tadvihitaṃ śrāddhe dakṣiṇāyāṃ pratṛptaye..38..
5.220.d:
धातूनि सृजता तेन रूप्यं सृष्टं स्वयंभुवा ..
तेन तद्विहितं श्राद्धे दक्षिणायां प्रतृप्तये..38..
5.220.m: As he was creating metals, silver was created by the self-manifest [creator]; / therefore it was ordained in the śrāddha as the priestly fee for complete satisfaction. // 38

5.220.s:
rājateṣu ca pātreṣu yaddvijebhyaḥ pradīyate..
pitṛbhyastasya naivā'nto yugānte'pi prajāyate .. 39 ..
5.220.d:
राजतेषु च पात्रेषु यद्द्विजेभ्यः प्रदीयते..
पितृभ्यस्तस्य नैवाऽन्तो युगान्तेऽपि प्रजायते .. 39 ..
5.220.m: And whatever is given to brahmins in silver vessels, / for the ancestors, the end of that does not occur even at the end of an age. // 39

5.220.s:
abhāve rūpyapātrāṇāṃ nāmāpi parikīrtayet ..
tuṣyaṃti pitaro rājankīrtanādapi vai yataḥ .. 6.221.40 ..
5.220.d:
अभावे रूप्यपात्राणां नामापि परिकीर्तयेत् ..
तुष्यंति पितरो राजन्कीर्तनादपि वै यतः .. 6.221.40 ..
5.220.m: In the absence of silver vessels, one should even utter the name [of silver], / since the ancestors are pleased, O king, even by the mere uttering. // 6.221.40

5.220.s:
rasāṃśca sṛjatā tena madhu sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ..
tena tacchasyate śrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭidāyakam .. 41 ..
5.220.d:
रसांश्च सृजता तेन मधु सृष्टं स्वयंभुवा ..
तेन तच्छस्यते श्राद्धे पितॄणां तुष्टिदायकम् .. 41 ..
5.220.m: And as he was creating tastes, honey was created by the self-manifest [creator]; / therefore it is praised in a śrāddha as bestowing satisfaction on the ancestors. // 41

5.220.s:
yacchrāddhaṃ madhunā hīnaṃ tadrasaiḥ sakalairapi ..
miṣṭānnairapi saṃyuktaṃ tatpitṝṇāṃ na tṛptaye .. 42 ..
5.220.d:
यच्छ्राद्धं मधुना हीनं तद्रसैः सकलैरपि ..
मिष्टान्नैरपि संयुक्तं तत्पितॄणां न तृप्तये .. 42 ..
5.220.m: The śrāddha that is devoid of honey, even if endowed with all flavors / and with sweet foods, does not bring satisfaction to the ancestors. // 42

5.220.s:
aṇumātramapi śrāddhe yadi na syāddhi mākṣikam ..
nāmāpi kīrtayettasya pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭaye yataḥ .. 43 ..
5.220.d:
अणुमात्रमपि श्राद्धे यदि न स्याद्धि माक्षिकम् ..
नामापि कीर्तयेत्तस्य पितॄणां तुष्टये यतः .. 43 ..
5.220.m: If there should not be even a tiny drop of honey in the śrāddha, / one should even utter its name, since that is for the satisfaction of the ancestors. // 43

5.220.s:
śākāni sṛjatā tena brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinau ..
kālaśākaṃ puraḥ sṛṣṭaṃ tena tattṛptidāyakam .. 44 ..
5.220.d:
शाकानि सृजता तेन ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिनौ ..
कालशाकं पुरः सृष्टं तेन तत्तृप्तिदायकम् .. 44 ..
5.220.m: As he was creating vegetables, by that Brahmā, the supreme lord, / kālaśāka was created first; therefore it bestows satisfaction. // 44

5.220.s:
kālaṃ hi sṛjatā tena kutapaḥ prāgvinirmitaḥ ..
tasmātkutapa kāle ca śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā ..
ya icchecchāśvatīṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāmātmanaḥ sukham .. 45 ..
5.220.d:
कालं हि सृजता तेन कुतपः प्राग्विनिर्मितः ..
तस्मात्कुतप काले च श्राद्धं कार्यं विजानता ..
य इच्छेच्छाश्वतीं तृप्तिं पितॄणामात्मनः सुखम् .. 45 ..
5.220.m: Creating time, kutapa was fashioned by him first; / therefore, at the time of kutapa a śrāddha should be performed by a discerning person / who desires perpetual satisfaction for the ancestors and happiness for himself. // 45

5.220.s:
vīrudhaḥ sṛjatā tena vidhinā nṛpasattama ..
darbhāstu prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhāstena te smṛtāḥ .. 46 ..
5.220.d:
वीरुधः सृजता तेन विधिना नृपसत्तम ..
दर्भास्तु प्रथमं सृष्टाः श्राद्धार्हास्तेन ते स्मृताः .. 46 ..
5.220.m: As he was creating plants, by that creator, O best of kings, / darbha grass was created first; therefore it is remembered as fit for a śrāddha. // 46

5.220.s:
śrāddhārhānbrāhmaṇāṃstena sṛjatā padmayoninā ..
dauhitrāḥ prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhāstena te smṛtāḥ .. ..47 ..
5.220.d:
श्राद्धार्हान्ब्राह्मणांस्तेन सृजता पद्मयोनिना ..
दौहित्राः प्रथमं सृष्टाः श्राद्धार्हास्तेन ते स्मृताः .. ..47 ..
5.220.m: As he was creating brahmins worthy of a śrāddha, by that lotus-born [creator] / daughters' sons were created first; therefore they are remembered as fit for a śrāddha. // 47

5.220.s:
api śaucaparityaktaṃ hīnāṃgādhikameva vā ..
dauhitraṃ yojayecchrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye .. 48 ..
5.220.d:
अपि शौचपरित्यक्तं हीनांगाधिकमेव वा ..
दौहित्रं योजयेच्छ्राद्धे पितॄणां परितुष्टये .. 48 ..
5.220.m: Even if devoid of purity, or having deficient or redundant limbs, / a daughter's son should be employed in a śrāddha for the complete satisfaction of the ancestors. // 48

5.220.s:
paśūnvisṛjatā tena pūrvaṃ gāvo vinirmitāḥ..
tena tāsāṃ payaḥ śastaṃ śrāddhe sarpirviśeṣataḥ .. 49 ..
5.220.d:
पशून्विसृजता तेन पूर्वं गावो विनिर्मिताः..
तेन तासां पयः शस्तं श्राद्धे सर्पिर्विशेषतः .. 49 ..
5.220.m: As he was bringing forth animals, cows were fashioned by him first; / therefore their milk is praised in a śrāddha, especially clarified butter. // 49

5.220.s: tasmācchrāddhe ghṛtaṃ śastaṃ pradattaṃ pitṛtuṣṭaye .. 6.221.50 ..
5.220.d: तस्माच्छ्राद्धे घृतं शस्तं प्रदत्तं पितृतुष्टये .. 6.221.50 ..
5.220.m: Therefore, clarified butter offered in a śrāddha is praised for the satisfaction of the ancestors. // 6.221.50

5.220.s:
prajāśca sṛjatā tena pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā dvijottamāḥ ..
tasmātpraśastāste śrāddhe pitṛtṛptikarāḥ sadā .. 51 ..
5.220.d:
प्रजाश्च सृजता तेन पूर्वं दृष्टा द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तस्मात्प्रशस्तास्ते श्राद्धे पितृतृप्तिकराः सदा .. 51 ..
5.220.m: And creating creatures, he first beheld the best of the twice-born. / Therefore, they are commended at a śrāddha, ever satisfying the ancestors.

5.220.s:
devāṃśca sṛjatā tena viśvedevāḥ kṛtāḥ puraḥ ..
tena te prathamaṃ pūjyāḥ pravṛtte śrāddhakarmaṇi .. 52 ..
5.220.d:
देवांश्च सृजता तेन विश्वेदेवाः कृताः पुरः ..
तेन ते प्रथमं पूज्याः प्रवृत्ते श्राद्धकर्मणि .. 52 ..
5.220.m: And creating the gods, he first brought forth the Viśvedevas. / Therefore, they are to be worshiped first when the rite of śrāddha begins.

5.220.s:
te rakṣaṃti tataḥ śrāddhaṃ yathāvatparitarpitāḥ ..
chidrāṇi nāśayaṃti sma śrāddhe pūrvaṃ prapūjitāḥ .. 53 ..
5.220.d:
ते रक्षंति ततः श्राद्धं यथावत्परितर्पिताः ..
छिद्राणि नाशयंति स्म श्राद्धे पूर्वं प्रपूजिताः .. 53 ..
5.220.m: Then, properly gratified, they protect the śrāddha; / worshiped beforehand at a śrāddha, they destroy defects.

5.220.s:
etairmukhyatamaiḥ sṛptaiḥ phūrā śrāddhaṃ vinirmitam ..
svayaṃ pitāmahenaiva tato devā vinirmitāḥ .. 54 ..
5.220.d:
एतैर्मुख्यतमैः सृप्तैः फूरा श्राद्धं विनिर्मितम् ..
स्वयं पितामहेनैव ततो देवा विनिर्मिताः .. 54 ..
5.220.m: With these foremost beings created long ago, the śrāddha was instituted / by the Grandfather himself; then the gods were created.

5.220.s: tena te sarvalokeṣu gatāḥ khyātiṃ purā nṛpa .. 55 ..
5.220.d: तेन ते सर्वलोकेषु गताः ख्यातिं पुरा नृप .. 55 ..
5.220.m: Therefore, O king, they attained renown in all the worlds in ancient times.

5.220.s:
etacchrādsya satratvaṃ mayā te parikīrtitam ..
pitṝṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ dattasyākṣayakārakam .. 56 ..
5.220.d:
एतच्छ्राद्स्य सत्रत्वं मया ते परिकीर्तितम् ..
पितॄणां परमं गुह्यं दत्तस्याक्षयकारकम् .. 56 ..
5.220.m: This essential nature of the śrāddha has been proclaimed to you by me, / the supreme secret of the ancestors, rendering what is given imperishable.

5.220.s:
yaścaitatkīrtayecchrāddhe kriyamāṇe nṛpottama ..
viprāṇāṃ bhokttukāmānāṃ tacchrāddhaṃ tvakṣayaṃ bhavet ..57..
5.220.d:
यश्चैतत्कीर्तयेच्छ्राद्धे क्रियमाणे नृपोत्तम ..
विप्राणां भोक्त्तुकामानां तच्छ्राद्धं त्वक्षयं भवेत् ..57..
5.220.m: And whoever recites this while a śrāddha is being performed, O best of kings, / before the brahmins who wish to eat, that śrāddha of his becomes imperishable.

5.220.s:
yaścaitackṛṇuyādrājansamyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
vihitasya bhavetpuṇyaṃ yacchrāddhasya tadāpnuyāt ..58..
5.220.d:
यश्चैतच्कृणुयाद्राजन्सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
विहितस्य भवेत्पुण्यं यच्छ्राद्धस्य तदाप्नुयात् ..58..
5.220.m: And whoever hears this, O king, endowed with complete faith, / obtains the merit that comes from a properly performed śrāddha.

5.220.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakerakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe sṛṣṭyutpattikālikabrahmotsṛṣṭaśrāddhārhavastuparigaṇanavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 221 ..
5.220.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे सृष्ट्युत्पत्तिकालिकब्रह्मोत्सृष्टश्राद्धार्हवस्तुपरिगणनवर्णनं नामैकविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 221 ..
5.220.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-first chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Enumeration of Articles Fit for a Śrāddha Created by Brahmā at the Time of the Beginning of Creation,' in the Śrāddhakalpa of the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra-māhātmya, in the sixth book, the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, the great Purāṇa in eighty-one thousand verses.

5.221.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
yeṣāṃ ca śastramṛtyuḥ syādapamṛtyurathāpi vā ..
upasargānmṛtānāṃ ca viṣamṛtyumupeyuṣām .. 1 ..
5.221.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
येषां च शस्त्रमृत्युः स्यादपमृत्युरथापि वा ..
उपसर्गान्मृतानां च विषमृत्युमुपेयुषाम् .. 1 ..
5.221.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / For those who meet death by a weapon, or even accidental death, / and for those who died of disease, or met death by poison,

5.221.s:
vahninā ca pradagdhānāṃ jalamṛtyumupeyuṣām ..
sarpavyāghrahatānāṃ ca śṛṃgairudbandhanairapi .. 2 ..
5.221.d:
वह्निना च प्रदग्धानां जलमृत्युमुपेयुषाम् ..
सर्पव्याघ्रहतानां च शृंगैरुद्बन्धनैरपि .. 2 ..
5.221.m: and for those burnt by fire, or who met death in water, / and for those killed by snakes, tigers, horns, or even hanging,

5.221.s:
śrāddhaṃ teṣāṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa ..
teṣāṃ tasminkṛte tṛptistatastatpakṣajā bhavet .. 3 ..
5.221.d:
श्राद्धं तेषां प्रकर्तव्यं चतुर्दश्यां नराधिप ..
तेषां तस्मिन्कृते तृप्तिस्ततस्तत्पक्षजा भवेत् .. 3 ..
5.221.m: for them a śrāddha must be performed on the fourteenth day, O ruler of men. / When it is performed on that [day], their satisfaction derived from that fortnight arises.

5.221.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
kasmācchastrahatānāṃ ca proktā śrāddhe caturdaśī ..
nānyeṣāṃ divase tatra saṃśayo'yaṃ vadasva me .. 4 ..
5.221.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
कस्माच्छस्त्रहतानां च प्रोक्ता श्राद्धे चतुर्दशी ..
नान्येषां दिवसे तत्र संशयोऽयं वदस्व मे .. 4 ..
5.221.m: Ānarta said: / Why is the fourteenth [tithi] prescribed for the śrāddha of those killed by weapons, / and not on the day of others? Tell me about this doubt.

5.221.s:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ na śaṃsaṃti sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ param ..
kasmāttatra prakartavyaṃ vadaitanmama vista rāt .. 5..
5.221.d:
एकोद्दिष्टं न शंसंति सपिण्डीकरणं परम् ..
कस्मात्तत्र प्रकर्तव्यं वदैतन्मम विस्त रात् .. 5..
5.221.m: They do not praise the ekoddiṣṭa [rite], but rather the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa. / Why must it be performed there? Tell me this in detail.

5.221.s:
kasmānna pārvaṇaṃ tatra kriyate divase sthite ..
pretapakṣe viśeṣeṇa kṛte śrāddhe'khile'pi ca .. 6 ..
5.221.d:
कस्मान्न पार्वणं तत्र क्रियते दिवसे स्थिते ..
प्रेतपक्षे विशेषेण कृते श्राद्धेऽखिलेऽपि च .. 6 ..
5.221.m: Why is the pārvaṇa [rite] not performed when that day arrives, / especially in the fortnight of the departed spirits, even if the entire śrāddha is performed?

5.221.s:
.. bhartṛyajñauvāca.. ..
bṛhatkalpe purā rājanhiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ ..
babhūva balavāñchūraḥ sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ .. 7 ..
5.221.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञौवाच.. ..
बृहत्कल्पे पुरा राजन्हिरण्याक्षो महासुरः ..
बभूव बलवाञ्छूरः सर्वदेवभयंकरः .. 7 ..
5.221.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / In the Bṛhatkalpa of old, O king, there was a great asura named Hiraṇyākṣa, / mighty, heroic, terrifying to all the gods.

5.221.s:
brahmā pratoṣitastena vidhāya vividhaṃ tapaḥ ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa nabhasye māsi saṃsthite .. 8 ..
5.221.d:
ब्रह्मा प्रतोषितस्तेन विधाय विविधं तपः ..
कृष्णपक्षे विशेषेण नभस्ये मासि संस्थिते .. 8 ..
5.221.m: Brahmā was pleased by him through performing various austerities, / especially in the dark fortnight when the month of Nabhasya arrived.

5.221.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
parituṣṭosmi te vatsa prārthayasva yathepsitam ..
adeyamapi dāsyāmi tasmātprārthaya mā ciram ..9 .. ..
5.221.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोस्मि ते वत्स प्रार्थयस्व यथेप्सितम् ..
अदेयमपि दास्यामि तस्मात्प्रार्थय मा चिरम् ..9 .. ..
5.221.m: Brahmā said: / I am pleased with you, child; ask whatever you wish. / I shall grant even what should not be given; therefore, ask without delay.

5.221.s:
.. hiraṇyākṣa uvāca .. ..
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ ..
bubhukṣitāḥ prayācaṃte māṃ nityaṃ padmasaṃbhava .. 6.222.10 ..
5.221.d:
.. हिरण्याक्ष उवाच .. ..
भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचाश्च राक्षसा दैत्यदानवाः ..
बुभुक्षिताः प्रयाचंते मां नित्यं पद्मसंभव .. 6.222.10 ..
5.221.m: Hiraṇyākṣa said: / Bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, rākṣasas, daityas, and dānavas, / starving, constantly beg of me, O lotus-born one.

5.221.s:
pretapakṣe kṛte śrāddhe kanyāsaṃsthe divākare ..
ekasminnahani prāyastṛptiḥ syādvarṣasaṃbhavā .. 11 ..
5.221.d:
प्रेतपक्षे कृते श्राद्धे कन्यासंस्थे दिवाकरे ..
एकस्मिन्नहनि प्रायस्तृप्तिः स्याद्वर्षसंभवा .. 11 ..
5.221.m: When a śrāddha is performed in the fortnight of the departed spirits, when the sun is in Virgo, / on a single day there should generally be satisfaction lasting for a year.

5.221.s:
tattvamadya dinaṃ dehi tebhyaḥ kamalasambhava ..
tena tṛptiṃ gatāḥ sarve sthāsyaṃtyabdaṃ pitāmaha .. 12 ..
5.221.d:
तत्त्वमद्य दिनं देहि तेभ्यः कमलसम्भव ..
तेन तृप्तिं गताः सर्वे स्थास्यंत्यब्दं पितामह .. 12 ..
5.221.m: Therefore, grant that day to them today, O lotus-born one; / by that, all of them, having attained satisfaction, will remain [content] for a year, O Grandfather.

5.221.s:
.. śrībrahmovāca .. ..
yaḥ kaścinmānavaḥ śrāddhaṃ svapitṛbhyaḥ pradāsyati ..
pretapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nabhasye mā si saṃsthite..13..
5.221.d:
.. श्रीब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
यः कश्चिन्मानवः श्राद्धं स्वपितृभ्यः प्रदास्यति ..
प्रेतपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां नभस्ये मा सि संस्थिते..13..
5.221.m: The glorious Brahmā said: / Whatever man offers a śrāddha to his own ancestors / on the fourteenth day in the fortnight of the departed spirits, when the month of Nabhasya arrives,

5.221.s:
pretānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca bhūtādīnāṃ bhaviṣyati..
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ ye cānye kīrtitāstvayā..14..
5.221.d:
प्रेतानां राक्षसानां च भूतादीनां भविष्यति..
मम वाक्यादसंदिग्धं ये चान्ये कीर्तितास्त्वया..14..
5.221.m: it shall undoubtedly belong to the pretas, rākṣasas, bhūtas, and others, / and to those others mentioned by you, by my word.

5.221.s:
durmṛtyunā mṛtā ye ca saṃgrāmeṣu hatāśca ye ..
ekoddiṣṭe sutairdatte teṣāṃ tṛptirbhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
5.221.d:
दुर्मृत्युना मृता ये च संग्रामेषु हताश्च ये ..
एकोद्दिष्टे सुतैर्दत्ते तेषां तृप्तिर्भविष्यति .. 15 ..
5.221.m: And those who died an untimely death, and those killed in battles, / when an ekoddiṣṭa is offered by their sons, their satisfaction will take place.

5.221.s:
evamuktvā tato brahmā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
hiraṇyākṣo'pi saṃhṛṣṭaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ yayau .. 16 ..
5.221.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो ब्रह्मा ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
हिरण्याक्षोऽपि संहृष्टः स्वमेव भवनं ययौ .. 16 ..
5.221.m: Having spoken thus, Brahmā then vanished from sight; / and Hiraṇyākṣa, delighted, went to his own abode.

5.221.s:
yacca śastrahatānāṃ ca tasminnahani dīyate ..
ekoddiṣṭaṃ naraiḥ śrāddhaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi kāraṇam.. 17 ..
5.221.d:
यच्च शस्त्रहतानां च तस्मिन्नहनि दीयते ..
एकोद्दिष्टं नरैः श्राद्धं तत्ते वक्ष्यामि कारणम्.. 17 ..
5.221.m: And why the ekoddiṣṭa śrāddha is offered by men on that day / for those killed by weapons—I shall tell you that reason.

5.221.s:
saṃkhye śastrahatā ye ca nirvikalpena cetasā ..
yudhyamānā na te martye jāyate manujāḥ punaḥ .. 18 ..
5.221.d:
संख्ये शस्त्रहता ये च निर्विकल्पेन चेतसा ..
युध्यमाना न ते मर्त्ये जायते मनुजाः पुनः .. 18 ..
5.221.m: Those who are killed by weapons in battle with an unhesitating mind / while fighting—those men are not born again in the mortal world.

5.221.s:
parāṅmukhāśca hanyaṃte palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ ..
te bhavaṃti narāḥ pretā etadāha pitāmahaḥ ..19..
5.221.d:
पराङ्मुखाश्च हन्यंते पलायनपरायणाः ..
ते भवंति नराः प्रेता एतदाह पितामहः ..19..
5.221.m: But those who are killed with their backs turned, intent on fleeing, / those men become pretas: this the Grandfather said.

5.221.s:
sammukhā api ye dainyaṃ hanyamānā vadaṃti ca ..
paścāttāpaṃ ca vā kuryuḥ prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ..6.222.20..
5.221.d:
सम्मुखा अपि ये दैन्यं हन्यमाना वदंति च ..
पश्चात्तापं च वा कुर्युः प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृताः..6.222.20..
5.221.m: Even those facing [the enemy] who utter miserable words while being struck, / or who feel remorse when shattered by blows,

5.221.s:
te'pi pretā bhavantīha manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt..
kadāciccittacalanaṃ śūrāṇāmapi jāyate .. 21 ..
5.221.d:
तेऽपि प्रेता भवन्तीह मनुः स्वायंभुवोऽब्रवीत्..
कदाचिच्चित्तचलनं शूराणामपि जायते .. 21 ..
5.221.m: they too become pretas here: so said Svāyambhuva Manu. / For wavering of the mind sometimes occurs even to heroes.

5.221.s:
teṣāṃ bhrāṃtyā dine tatra śrāddhaṃ deyaṃ nijaiḥ sutaiḥ ..
apamṛtyumṛtānāṃ ca sarveṣāmapi dehinām .. 22 ..
5.221.d:
तेषां भ्रांत्या दिने तत्र श्राद्धं देयं निजैः सुतैः ..
अपमृत्युमृतानां च सर्वेषामपि देहिनाम् .. 22 ..
5.221.m: Out of uncertainty regarding them, a śrāddha must be offered on that day by their own sons, / and also for all embodied beings who died an untimely death.

5.221.s:
pretatvaṃ jāyate yasmāttasmācchrāddhasya taddinam ..
śrāddhārhaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha viśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam .. 23 ..
5.221.d:
प्रेतत्वं जायते यस्मात्तस्माच्छ्राद्धस्य तद्दिनम् ..
श्राद्धार्हं पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ विशेषेण प्रकीर्तितम् .. 23 ..
5.221.m: Since the state of a preta arises [for them], therefore that day of śrāddha / is proclaimed, O best of kings, as especially fit for a śrāddha.

5.221.s:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakartavyaṃ yasmāttatra dine naraiḥ ..
sapiṃḍīkaraṇādūrdhvaṃ tatte vakṣyābhi kāraṇam .. 24 ..
5.221.d:
एकोद्दिष्टं प्रकर्तव्यं यस्मात्तत्र दिने नरैः ..
सपिंडीकरणादूर्ध्वं तत्ते वक्ष्याभि कारणम् .. 24 ..
5.221.m: Why an ekoddiṣṭa must be performed by men on that day / even after the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa—I shall tell you that reason.

5.221.s:
yadi pretatvamāpannaḥ kadācitsvapitā bhavet .
tṛptyarthaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra dine nṛpa ..25..
5.221.d:
यदि प्रेतत्वमापन्नः कदाचित्स्वपिता भवेत् .
तृप्त्यर्थं तस्य कर्तव्यं श्राद्धं तत्र दिने नृप ..25..
5.221.m: If one's own father has somehow fallen into the state of a preta, / for the sake of his satisfaction a śrāddha must be performed on that day, O king.

5.221.s:
pitāmahādyāstatrāhni śrāddhaṃ nārhaṃti kutracit ..
atha cedbhrāṃtito dadyāddhiyate(?) rākṣasaistu tat .. 26 ..
5.221.d:
पितामहाद्यास्तत्राह्नि श्राद्धं नार्हंति कुत्रचित् ..
अथ चेद्भ्रांतितो दद्याद्धियते(?) राक्षसैस्तु तत् .. 26 ..
5.221.m: The paternal grandfathers and others are never entitled to a śrāddha on that day; / if one gives out of delusion, it is seized by the rākṣasas,

5.221.s:
brahmaṇo vacanādrājanbhūtapretaiśca dānavaiḥ ..
