tenaikoddiṣṭamevātra kartavyaṃ na tu pārvaṇam .. 27 ..
5.221.d:
ब्रह्मणो वचनाद्राजन्भूतप्रेतैश्च दानवैः ..
तेनैकोद्दिष्टमेवात्र कर्तव्यं न तु पार्वणम् .. 27 ..
5.221.m: and by the bhūtas, pretas, and dānavas, by Brahmā's word, O king. / Therefore, only an ekoddiṣṭa must be performed here, and not a pārvaṇa.

5.221.s:
pitṛpakṣe caturdaśyāṃ kanyāsaṃsthe divākare ..
pitāmaho na gṛhṇāti pitrā tena samaṃ tadā .. 28 ..
5.221.d:
पितृपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां कन्यासंस्थे दिवाकरे ..
पितामहो न गृह्णाति पित्रा तेन समं तदा .. 28 ..
5.221.m: On the fourteenth day of the ancestors' fortnight, when the sun is in Virgo, / the grandfather does not receive [the offering] together with that father at that time,

5.221.s: na ca tasya pitā rājaṃstathaiva prapitāmahaḥ .. 29 ..
5.221.d: न च तस्य पिता राजंस्तथैव प्रपितामहः .. 29 ..
5.221.m: nor his father, O king, and likewise the great-grandfather.

5.221.s:
etasmātkāraṇādrājanpārvaṇaṃ na vidhīyate ..
tasminnahani saṃprāpte vyarthaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavedyataḥ .. 6.222.30 ..
5.221.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्राजन्पार्वणं न विधीयते ..
तस्मिन्नहनि संप्राप्ते व्यर्थं श्राद्धं भवेद्यतः .. 6.222.30 ..
5.221.m: For this reason, O king, a pārvaṇa [śrāddha] is not prescribed; / for when that day arrives, [such a] śrāddha would become futile.

5.221.s:
nānyasthānodbhavairvipraiḥ śrāddhakarmavratāni ca ..
nāgaro nāgaraiḥ kuryādanyathā tadvṛthā bhavet .. 31 ..
5.221.d:
नान्यस्थानोद्भवैर्विप्रैः श्राद्धकर्मव्रतानि च ..
नागरो नागरैः कुर्यादन्यथा तद्वृथा भवेत् .. 31 ..
5.221.m: Not with brahmins originating from another place should śrāddha rites and vows / be performed by a Nāgara [brahmin], but with Nāgaras; otherwise, it would become futile.

5.221.s:
anyasthānodbhavairviprairyacchrāddhaṃ kriyate dhruvam ..
saṃpūrṇaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti nāgarāṇāṃ kriyāparaiḥ .. 32 ..
5.221.d:
अन्यस्थानोद्भवैर्विप्रैर्यच्छ्राद्धं क्रियते ध्रुवम् ..
संपूर्णं व्यर्थतां याति नागराणां क्रियापरैः .. 32 ..
5.221.m: The śrāddha that is performed by those devoted to rites among Nāgaras / with brahmins originating from another place certainly goes entirely in vain.

5.221.s:
athācāraparibhraṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhā eva nāgarāḥ ..
valīvardasamāno'pi jñātīyo yadi labhyate ..
kimanyairbahubhirviprairvedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ .. 33 ..
5.221.d:
अथाचारपरिभ्रष्टाः श्राद्धार्हा एव नागराः ..
वलीवर्दसमानोऽपि ज्ञातीयो यदि लभ्यते ..
किमन्यैर्बहुभिर्विप्रैर्वेदवेदांगपारगैः .. 33 ..
5.221.m: Even if fallen from good conduct, Nāgara [brahmins] are fit for the śrāddha. / If a fellow kinsman is found, even if he is like an ox, / what need is there for many other brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas?

5.221.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddha kalpe caturdaśīśastrahataśrāddhanirṇayavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 222 ..
5.221.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्ध कल्पे चतुर्दशीशस्त्रहतश्राद्धनिर्णयवर्णनंनाम द्वाविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 222 ..
5.221.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-second chapter, titled "Description of the Determination of Śrāddha on the Fourteenth [Day] for Those Slain by Weapons, in the Ritual of Śrāddha," in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.222.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
śrāddhārhairbrāhmaṇaiḥ kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ darśe tu pārvaṇam..
viparītaṃ na kartavyaṃ śrāddhamekaṃ kathaṃcana .. 1 ..
5.222.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
श्राद्धार्हैर्ब्राह्मणैः कार्यं श्राद्धं दर्शे तु पार्वणम्..
विपरीतं न कर्तव्यं श्राद्धमेकं कथंचन .. 1 ..
5.222.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / The śrāddha on the new moon, the pārvaṇa, must be performed with brahmins who are worthy of śrāddha. / Under no circumstances should a contrary, single śrāddha be performed.

5.222.s:
jārajātāpaviddhādyairyo naraḥ śrāddhamācaret ..
brāhmaṇaistu na saṃdehastacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 2 ..
5.222.d:
जारजातापविद्धाद्यैर्यो नरः श्राद्धमाचरेत् ..
ब्राह्मणैस्तु न संदेहस्तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 2 ..
5.222.m: The man who performs a śrāddha through brahmins / who are born of adultery, abandoned, and the like—without doubt, that śrāddha becomes useless.

5.222.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
bhayaṃ me sumahajjātamatra yatparikīrtitam ..
jārajātāpaviddhaistu yacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet .. 3 ..
5.222.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
भयं मे सुमहज्जातमत्र यत्परिकीर्तितम् ..
जारजातापविद्धैस्तु यच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् .. 3 ..
5.222.m: Ānarta said: / A very great fear has arisen in me regarding what was stated here: / that a śrāddha performed through those born of adultery or abandoned becomes useless.

5.222.s:
manunā dvādaśa proktāḥ kila putrā mahāmate ..
aputrāṇāṃ ca putratvaṃ ye kurvaṃti sadaiva hi .. 4 ..
5.222.d:
मनुना द्वादश प्रोक्ताः किल पुत्रा महामते ..
अपुत्राणां च पुत्रत्वं ये कुर्वंति सदैव हि .. 4 ..
5.222.m: Twelve sons were indeed declared by Manu, O great-minded one, / who always serve as sons for those without sons:

5.222.s:
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścaiva krayakrītaśca pālitaḥ ..
pratipannaḥ sahoḍhaśca kānīnaścāpi sattama..5..
5.222.d:
औरसः क्षेत्रजश्चैव क्रयक्रीतश्च पालितः ..
प्रतिपन्नः सहोढश्च कानीनश्चापि सत्तम..5..
5.222.m: the son of the body, the son of the wife, the bought son, and the foster son, / the accepted son, the son taken with the pregnant bride, and the son of an unmarried girl, O best of men;
likewise the other two, the kuṇḍa and the golaka, are also proclaimed as sons;

5.222.s:
śiṣyaśca rakṣito mṛtyostathāśvattho vanāṃtigaḥ ..
kimete naiva kathitā yattvamevaṃ prajalpasi .. 7 ..
5.222.d:
शिष्यश्च रक्षितो मृत्योस्तथाश्वत्थो वनांतिगः ..
किमेते नैव कथिता यत्त्वमेवं प्रजल्पसि .. 7 ..
5.222.m: the pupil, the one saved from death, and likewise the aśvattha tree grown in the forest. / Were these not mentioned [by him], that you speak in such a manner?

5.222.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāga sarve te dharmataḥ sutāḥ ..
paraṃ yugatraye proktā na kalau kaluṣāpahāḥ .. .. 8 ..
5.222.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभाग सर्वे ते धर्मतः सुताः ..
परं युगत्रये प्रोक्ता न कलौ कलुषापहाः .. .. 8 ..
5.222.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / This is true, O highly fortunate one: they are all sons according to righteousness, / but they were declared for the three [earlier] ages, not as destroyers of sins in the Kali age.

5.222.s:
tadarthaṃ teṣu santānaṃ tāvanmātraṃ yugeyuge ..
sattvāḍhyānāṃ ca lokānāṃ na kalau cālpamedhasām .. 9 ..
5.222.d:
तदर्थं तेषु सन्तानं तावन्मात्रं युगेयुगे ..
सत्त्वाढ्यानां च लोकानां न कलौ चाल्पमेधसाम् .. 9 ..
5.222.m: For that reason, lineage through them was limited to that extent in each age / for men rich in fortitude, and not in the Kali age for those of little intellect.

5.222.s:
kalāveva samākhyāto vyavahāraḥ prapā tadaḥ ..
alpasattvā yato lokāstena caiṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 6.223.10 ..
5.222.d:
कलावेव समाख्यातो व्यवहारः प्रपा तदः ..
अल्पसत्त्वा यतो लोकास्तेन चैष विधिः स्मृतः .. 6.223.10 ..
5.222.m: In the Kali age alone, conduct was declared to be a source of downfall. / Because people are of weak fortitude, this rule was remembered [for them].

5.222.s:
atra yaḥ saṃkaraṃ kuryādyonestasya phalaṃ śṛṇu ..
brāhmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇātputro brahmaghnaḥ saṃprajāyate .. 11 ..
5.222.d:
अत्र यः संकरं कुर्याद्योनेस्तस्य फलं शृणु ..
ब्राह्मण्यां ब्राह्मणात्पुत्रो ब्रह्मघ्नः संप्रजायते .. 11 ..
5.222.m: Hear the fruit of him who causes confusion of birth here: / from a brahmin woman by a brahmin, a son who is a killer of brahmins is born;
he is the lowest of all low men, who is known as a vāraḍa;

5.222.s:
kṣatriyācca tathā sūto vaiśyānmāgadha eva ca ..
śūdrāttathāṃtyajaḥ proktastenaite varjitāḥ sutāḥ .. 13 ..
5.222.d:
क्षत्रियाच्च तथा सूतो वैश्यान्मागध एव च ..
शूद्रात्तथांत्यजः प्रोक्तस्तेनैते वर्जिताः सुताः .. 13 ..
5.222.m: by a kṣatriya, a sūta; from a vaiśya, a māgadha; / and from a śūdra, an outcaste is declared; therefore these sons are avoided.

5.222.s:
eteṣāmapi nirdiṣṭāḥ sapta rājansuputrakāḥ ..
paṃca vaṃśavināśāya pūrveṣāṃ pātanāya ca .. 14 ..
5.222.d:
एतेषामपि निर्दिष्टाः सप्त राजन्सुपुत्रकाः ..
पंच वंशविनाशाय पूर्वेषां पातनाय च .. 14 ..
5.222.m: Even among these, O king, seven are indicated as good sons; / five lead to the destruction of the lineage and to the downfall of ancestors.

5.222.s:
aurasaḥ pratipannaśca krītaḥ pālita eva ca ..
śiṣyaśca dattajīvaśca tathāśvatthaśca saptamaḥ .. 15 ..
5.222.d:
औरसः प्रतिपन्नश्च क्रीतः पालित एव च ..
शिष्यश्च दत्तजीवश्च तथाश्वत्थश्च सप्तमः .. 15 ..
5.222.m: The son of the body, the accepted son, the bought, and the foster son, / the pupil, the one whose life was saved, and the aśvattha tree as the seventh:

5.222.s:
puṃnāmno narakādghorādrakṣaṃti ca sadā hi te ..
patantaṃ puruṣaṃ tatra tena te śobhanāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 16 ..
5.222.d:
पुंनाम्नो नरकाद्घोराद्रक्षंति च सदा हि ते ..
पतन्तं पुरुषं तत्र तेन ते शोभनाः स्मृताः .. 16 ..
5.222.m: these indeed always protect a man falling into the terrible hell / named Put; therefore they are remembered as auspicious.

5.222.s:
kṣetrajaśca sahoḍhaśca kānīnaḥ kuṇḍagolakau ..
paṃcaite pātayaṃtisma pitṝnsvargagatānapi .. 17 ..
5.222.d:
क्षेत्रजश्च सहोढश्च कानीनः कुण्डगोलकौ ..
पंचैते पातयंतिस्म पितॄन्स्वर्गगतानपि .. 17 ..
5.222.m: The son of the wife, the son taken with the pregnant bride, the son of an unmarried girl, and the kuṇḍa and golaka— / these five cause even ancestors gone to heaven to fall.

5.222.s:
etasmātkāraṇācchrāddhaṃ jārajātasya tadvṛthā .. 18 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhārhānarhabrāhmaṇādivarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 223 . ..
5.222.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाच्छ्राद्धं जारजातस्य तद्वृथा .. 18 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे श्राद्धार्हानर्हब्राह्मणादिवर्णनंनाम त्रयोविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 223 . ..
5.222.m:
For this reason, the śrāddha of one born of an adulterous union is in vain.
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-third chapter, titled "Description of Brahmins Worthy and Unworthy of Śrāddha and Others, in the Ritual of Śrāddha," in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.223.s:
.. ānartauvāca .. ..
śrutā mayā mahābhāga śrāddhārhā brāhmaṇāśca ye ..
ye ca tyājyāstathā putrā bahavaścaiva suvrata .. 1 ..
5.223.d:
.. आनर्तौवाच .. ..
श्रुता मया महाभाग श्राद्धार्हा ब्राह्मणाश्च ये ..
ये च त्याज्यास्तथा पुत्रा बहवश्चैव सुव्रत .. 1 ..
5.223.m: Ānarta said: / I have heard, O highly fortunate one, of the brahmins who are worthy of śrāddha, / and of the many sons who are to be rejected, O you of noble vows.

5.223.s:
sāṃprataṃ kathayā'smākaṃ mantrapūrvaśca yo vidhiḥ ..
gṛhasthena sadā kāryaḥ pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye .. 2 ..
5.223.d:
सांप्रतं कथयाऽस्माकं मन्त्रपूर्वश्च यो विधिः ..
गृहस्थेन सदा कार्यः पितॄणां परितुष्टये .. 2 ..
5.223.m: Now tell us the procedure accompanied by mantras / that must always be performed by a householder for the satisfaction of the ancestors.

5.223.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
praṇamyāmaṃtritā ye ca śrādrārthaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ ..
ānīya kutape kāle tānsarvānprārthayedi dam .. 3 ..
5.223.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
प्रणम्यामंत्रिता ये च श्राद्रार्थं ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ..
आनीय कुतपे काले तान्सर्वान्प्रार्थयेदि दम् .. 3 ..
5.223.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Having bowed and invited the excellent brahmins for the śrāddha, / having brought them at the kutapa hour, he should pray thus to them all:

5.223.s:
āgacchaṃtu mahābhāgā viśvedevā mahābalāḥ ..
ye yatra vihitāḥ śrāddhe sāvadhānā bhavaṃtu te .. 4 ..
5.223.d:
आगच्छंतु महाभागा विश्वेदेवा महाबलाः ..
ये यत्र विहिताः श्राद्धे सावधाना भवंतु ते .. 4 ..
5.223.m: "May the highly fortunate, mighty Viśvedevas come; / may those who are appointed for this śrāddha be attentive!"

5.223.s:
evamabhyarcya tānsarvāṃstataḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām..
jānunī bhūtale nyasya tataścārghaṃ pradāpayet .. 5 ..
5.223.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य तान्सर्वांस्ततः कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणाम्..
जानुनी भूतले न्यस्य ततश्चार्घं प्रदापयेत् .. 5 ..
5.223.m: Having thus worshiped all of them, then having circumambulated them clockwise, / placing both knees upon the ground, he should then offer the water of hospitality.

5.223.s:
maṃtreṇānena rājeṃdra sapuṣpākṣatacaṃdanaiḥ ..
arghamenaṃ pragṛhṇaṃtu mayā dattaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
pādaprakṣālanārthāya prakurvaṃtu mama priyam.. 6 ..
5.223.d:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेंद्र सपुष्पाक्षतचंदनैः ..
अर्घमेनं प्रगृह्णंतु मया दत्तं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
पादप्रक्षालनार्थाय प्रकुर्वंतु मम प्रियम्.. 6 ..
5.223.m: With this mantra, O ruler of kings, with flowers, unbroken rice grains, and sandalwood paste: / "May the best of the twice-born accept this offering of hospitality given by me; / for the washing of feet, may you do what is pleasing to me!"

5.223.s:
evamuktvā mahīpṛṣṭhe anulipte tataḥ param ..
sākṣatānprakṣipeddarbhānviśvedevānprakīrtayan .. 7 ..
5.223.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महीपृष्ठे अनुलिप्ते ततः परम् ..
साक्षतान्प्रक्षिपेद्दर्भान्विश्वेदेवान्प्रकीर्तयन् .. 7 ..
5.223.m: Having spoken thus, on the surface of the earth smeared [with cow dung], / he should then scatter darbha grass with unbroken rice grains, pronouncing [the names of] the Viśvedevas.

5.223.s:
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā darbhāṃstilasamanvitān ..
dviguṇānprakṣipedbhūmau pitṝnuddiśya cātmanaḥ .. 8 ..
5.223.d:
अपसव्यं ततः कृत्वा दर्भांस्तिलसमन्वितान् ..
द्विगुणान्प्रक्षिपेद्भूमौ पितॄनुद्दिश्य चात्मनः .. 8 ..
5.223.m: Then, having worn the sacred cord over the right shoulder, / he should throw double-folded darbha grass accompanied by sesame seeds onto the ground, intending it for his ancestors.

5.223.s:
evaṃ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā daivikā savyapūrvikāḥ ..
paitṛkāścāpasavyena muktvā nāṃdīmukhānpitṝn .. 9 ..
5.223.d:
एवं सर्वाः क्रियाः कार्या दैविका सव्यपूर्विकाः ..
पैतृकाश्चापसव्येन मुक्त्वा नांदीमुखान्पितॄन् .. 9 ..
5.223.m: In this way, all rites for the gods are to be performed with the sacred cord over the left shoulder, / and those for the ancestors with the sacred cord over the right shoulder, except for the ancestors having joyful faces.

5.223.s:
sarve pūrvāmukhāḥ sthāpyā yugmāśca śaktito nṛpa ..
pitaro mātṛpakṣīyāḥ sthāpyāścodaṅmukhāstathā .. 6.224.10 ..
5.223.d:
सर्वे पूर्वामुखाः स्थाप्या युग्माश्च शक्तितो नृप ..
पितरो मातृपक्षीयाः स्थाप्याश्चोदङ्मुखास्तथा .. 6.224.10 ..
5.223.m: All are to be seated facing east in pairs according to capacity, O king, / and the ancestors on the mother's side are to be seated facing north.

5.223.s:
ekaikaṃ vā trayo vā'pi syurekaikaṃ vā pṛthakpṛthaka ..
paitṛkānsthāppa cakreṇa pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye .. 11 ..
5.223.d:
एकैकं वा त्रयो वाऽपि स्युरेकैकं वा पृथक्पृथक ..
पैतृकान्स्थाप्प चक्रेण पितॄणां परितुष्टये .. 11 ..
5.223.m: There may be one each, or three each, or each one separately; / he should seat the ancestral [brahmins] in order for the satisfaction of the ancestors.

5.223.s:
ṣaṣṭhyā vibhaktyā tu teṣāmāsanaṃ ca pradāpayet ..
ṛjubhiḥ sākṣatairdarbhaiḥ sodakairdakṣiṇāṃgataḥ .. 12 ..
5.223.d:
षष्ठ्या विभक्त्या तु तेषामासनं च प्रदापयेत् ..
ऋजुभिः साक्षतैर्दर्भैः सोदकैर्दक्षिणांगतः .. 12 ..
5.223.m: He should offer them a seat with the genitive case ending, / using straight darbha grass with unbroken rice grains and water, from the right side;

5.223.s:
viṣamau dviguṇairdarbhaiḥ satilairvāmapārśvataḥ ..
pāṇau toyaṃ parikṣipya na darbhāṃstu kathaṃ cana .. 13 ..
5.223.d:
विषमौ द्विगुणैर्दर्भैः सतिलैर्वामपार्श्वतः ..
पाणौ तोयं परिक्षिप्य न दर्भांस्तु कथं चन .. 13 ..
5.223.m: to an uneven [number of ancestral brahmins], with double-folded darbha grass together with sesame seeds from the left side. / Having poured water into the hand, he must never [place] darbha grass [in the hand].

5.223.s:
yo haste cāsanaṃ dadyācceddārbhaṃ buddhivarjitaḥ ..
pitaro nāsane tatra prakurvaṃti niveśanam .. 14 ..
5.223.d:
यो हस्ते चासनं दद्याच्चेद्दार्भं बुद्धिवर्जितः ..
पितरो नासने तत्र प्रकुर्वंति निवेशनम् .. 14 ..
5.223.m: If a man devoid of understanding places a seat made of darbha grass in the hand, / the ancestors do not take their seat on that seat.

5.223.s:
āvāhanaṃ prakartavyaṃ vibhaktyā ca dvitīyayā ..
yenāgacchaṃti te sarve samāhūtāḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 15 ..
5.223.d:
आवाहनं प्रकर्तव्यं विभक्त्या च द्वितीयया ..
येनागच्छंति ते सर्वे समाहूताः पृथक्पृथक् .. 15 ..
5.223.m: The invocation is to be made with the accusative case ending, / so that all of them, called individually, will come.

5.223.s:
anyayā ca vibhaktyā cetpitṝnāvāhayetkvacit ..
nāgacchaṃti mahābhāgā yadyapi syurbubhukṣitāḥ .. 16 ..
5.223.d:
अन्यया च विभक्त्या चेत्पितॄनावाहयेत्क्वचित् ..
नागच्छंति महाभागा यद्यपि स्युर्बुभुक्षिताः .. 16 ..
5.223.m: If he should invoke the ancestors with any other case ending, / the highly fortunate ones do not come, even though they might be hungry.

5.223.s:
viśvedevāsa āgata maṃtreṇānena pārthiva ..
teṣāmāvāhanaṃ kāryamakṣataiśca śiroṃ'tikāt .. 17 ..
5.223.d:
विश्वेदेवास आगत मंत्रेणानेन पार्थिव ..
तेषामावाहनं कार्यमक्षतैश्च शिरोंऽतिकात् .. 17 ..
5.223.m: "O Viśvedevas, come!"—with this mantra, O ruler of the earth, / their invocation is to be made with unbroken rice grains from near the head.

5.223.s:
uśaṃtastveti ca tilaiḥ pitṝnāvāhayettataḥ ..
āyaṃtu na iti japettataḥ pārthivasattama .. 18 ..
5.223.d:
उशंतस्त्वेति च तिलैः पितॄनावाहयेत्ततः ..
आयंतु न इति जपेत्ततः पार्थिवसत्तम .. 18 ..
5.223.m: With "Desiring you, [we place you]..." and with sesame seeds, he should then invoke the ancestors; / then he should murmur "May they come to us...", O best of kings.

5.223.s:
śanno devīti maṃtreṇa svāhākārasamanvitam ..
pitṝṇāmarghapātreṣu tathaiva ca jalaṃ kṣipet .. 19 ..
5.223.d:
शन्नो देवीति मंत्रेण स्वाहाकारसमन्वितम् ..
पितॄणामर्घपात्रेषु तथैव च जलं क्षिपेत् .. 19 ..
5.223.m: With the mantra "May the divine [waters] be for our welfare..." accompanied by the utterance "svāhā", / he should likewise pour water into the hospitality vessels of the ancestors.

5.223.s:
yavo'si yavayāsmaddvetyakṣatāṃstatra nikṣipet ..
caṃdanaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ dadyādyathākramam ..
sapavitreṣu hasteṣu dadyādarghyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 6.224.20 ..
5.223.d:
यवोऽसि यवयास्मद्द्वेत्यक्षतांस्तत्र निक्षिपेत् ..
चंदनं गंधपुष्पाणि धूपं दद्याद्यथाक्रमम् ..
सपवित्रेषु हस्तेषु दद्यादर्घ्यं समाहितः .. 6.224.20 ..
5.223.m: With "You are barley, separate us [from our sins]...", he should throw unbroken grains there; / he should give sandalwood paste, fragrant flowers, and incense in proper order; / with a concentrated mind, he should offer the water of hospitality into their hands that have purificatory loops.

5.223.s:
yā divyā iti mantreṇa svāhākārasamanvitam ..
pitṝṇāmarghapātreṣu tathaiva ca jalaṃ kṣipet .. 21 ..
5.223.d:
या दिव्या इति मन्त्रेण स्वाहाकारसमन्वितम् ..
पितॄणामर्घपात्रेषु तथैव च जलं क्षिपेत् .. 21 ..
5.223.m: With the mantra 'yā divyāḥ' accompanied by the exclamation 'svāhā', / he should likewise pour water into the ancestors' argha vessels.

5.223.s:
tilo'si somadaivatyo gosave devanirmitaḥ ..
pratnavadbhiḥ pṛktaḥ svadhayā pitṝnimām̐llokānprīṇāhi naḥ svadheti prakṣipettilān .. 22 ..
5.223.d:
तिलोऽसि सोमदैवत्यो गोसवे देवनिर्मितः ..
प्रत्नवद्भिः पृक्तः स्वधया पितॄनिमाम्̐ल्लोकान्प्रीणाहि नः स्वधेति प्रक्षिपेत्तिलान् .. 22 ..
5.223.m: He should scatter sesamum seeds with: 'You are sesamum, sacred to Soma, created by the gods at the Gosava; / mingled with the ancients through svadhā, gladden these ancestors and these worlds for us, svadhā!'

5.223.s:
yādivyeti ca mantreṇa tato hyarghyaṃ pradāpayet ..
pitṛpātre samādāya arghyapātrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 23 ..
5.223.d:
यादिव्येति च मन्त्रेण ततो ह्यर्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् ..
पितृपात्रे समादाय अर्घ्यपात्राणि कृत्स्नशः .. 23 ..
5.223.m: Then indeed, with the mantra 'yā divyāḥ', he should present the arghya, / taking up all the arghya vessels into the vessel for the ancestors.

5.223.s:
adhomukhaṃ ca tatpātraṃ mantravatsthāpayettataḥ ..
āyuṣkāmastu tattoyaṃ locanābhyāṃ na vīkṣayet .. 24 ..
5.223.d:
अधोमुखं च तत्पात्रं मन्त्रवत्स्थापयेत्ततः ..
आयुष्कामस्तु तत्तोयं लोचनाभ्यां न वीक्षयेत् .. 24 ..
5.223.m: Then, accompanied by the mantra, he should place that vessel face down. / One who desires a full lifespan must not look at that water with his eyes.

5.223.s:
tatastu candanādīni dīpāṃtāni samādadet ..
tataḥ pākaṃ samādāya pṛcchedviprāndvijo ttamān .. 25 ..
5.223.d:
ततस्तु चन्दनादीनि दीपांतानि समाददेत् ..
ततः पाकं समादाय पृच्छेद्विप्रान्द्विजो त्तमान् .. 25 ..
5.223.m: Then he should offer [articles] beginning with sandalwood and ending with lamps. / Next, taking the cooked food, he should ask the brahmins, best of the twice-born:

5.223.s:
ahamagnau kariṣyāmi homaṃ pitṛsamudbhavam ..
anujñā dīyatāṃ mahyamapasavyāśritasya bhoḥ .. 26 ..
5.223.d:
अहमग्नौ करिष्यामि होमं पितृसमुद्भवम् ..
अनुज्ञा दीयतां मह्यमपसव्याश्रितस्य भोः .. 26 ..
5.223.m: 'I shall perform the burnt offering in the fire pertaining to the ancestors. / O sirs, let permission be granted to me as I wear the sacred thread over the right shoulder.'

5.223.s:
kuruṣveti ca taiḥ prokte gatvāgni śaraṇaṃ tataḥ ..
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti prathamāhutiḥ .. 27 ..
5.223.d:
कुरुष्वेति च तैः प्रोक्ते गत्वाग्नि शरणं ततः ..
अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्वाहेति प्रथमाहुतिः .. 27 ..
5.223.m: When told by them, 'Do so,' he approaches the fireplace; / the first oblation is: 'To Agni the bearer of the kavyas, svāhā!'

5.223.s:
somāya pitṛmate svadheti ca tataḥ param ..
hutamannaṃ ca śeṣaṃ ca śrāddhārhebhyaḥ pradīyate .. 28 ..
5.223.d:
सोमाय पितृमते स्वधेति च ततः परम् ..
हुतमन्नं च शेषं च श्राद्धार्हेभ्यः प्रदीयते .. 28 ..
5.223.m: And after that: 'To Soma accompanied by the ancestors, svadhā!' / The offered food and what remains are given to those worthy of the śrāddha.

5.223.s:
iṣṭamannaṃ tato dattvā pātramālabhya saṃjapet ..
viprāṃguṣṭhaṃ samādāya pākamadhye nidhāya ca .. 29 ..
5.223.d:
इष्टमन्नं ततो दत्त्वा पात्रमालभ्य संजपेत् ..
विप्रांगुष्ठं समादाय पाकमध्ये निधाय च .. 29 ..
5.223.m: Having then given the desired food, touching the dish, he should recite prayers; / taking the brahmin's thumb and placing it within the cooked food,

5.223.s:
pṛthivī te pātramādāya vaiṣṇa vyā ca ṛcā tathā ..
svahastena na vai dadyātpratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā .. 6.224.30 ..
5.223.d:
पृथिवी ते पात्रमादाय वैष्ण व्या च ऋचा तथा ..
स्वहस्तेन न वै दद्यात्प्रत्यक्षं लवणं तथा .. 6.224.30 ..
5.223.m: taking [the vessel] with 'pṛthivī te pātraṃ' and with the Vaiṣṇava verse. / And one must not give plain salt with one's own hand.

5.223.s:
svahastena ca yaddattaṃ pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ nṛpa ..
tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti dhṛte datterddhabhuktake ..
tṛptāñjñātvā tato viprānagre tvannaṃ parikṣipet .. 31 ..
5.223.d:
स्वहस्तेन च यद्दत्तं प्रत्यक्षलवणं नृप ..
तच्छ्राद्धं व्यर्थतां याति धृते दत्तेर्द्धभुक्तके ..
तृप्ताञ्ज्ञात्वा ततो विप्रानग्रे त्वन्नं परिक्षिपेत् .. 31 ..
5.223.m: What plain salt is given with one's own hand, O king, / makes that śrāddha futile, if it is given while held and half-consumed. / Knowing the brahmins to be sated, he should then scatter food in front of them:

5.223.s:
agnidagdhāśca ye jīvā yepyadagdhāḥ kule mama ..
bhūmau dattena tṛpyaṃtu tṛptā yāṃtu parāṃ gatim .. 32 ..
5.223.d:
अग्निदग्धाश्च ये जीवा येप्यदग्धाः कुले मम ..
भूमौ दत्तेन तृप्यंतु तृप्ता यांतु परां गतिम् .. 32 ..
5.223.m: 'May the living beings who have been burned by fire and those not burned in my family / be satisfied by what is given on the ground, and being sated, may they attain the supreme state!'

5.223.s:
sakṛtsakṛjjalaṃ dattvā gāyatrītritayaṃ japet ..
madhuvāteti saṃkīrtya tataḥ pṛccheddvijottamān .. 33 ..
5.223.d:
सकृत्सकृज्जलं दत्त्वा गायत्रीत्रितयं जपेत् ..
मधुवातेति संकीर्त्य ततः पृच्छेद्द्विजोत्तमान् .. 33 ..
5.223.m: Having given water once each, he should recite the triplet of the Gāyatrī. / Having chanted 'madhu vātāḥ', he should then ask the best of the twice-born:

5.223.s:
tṛptāḥ stha iti rājendra anujñāṃ prārthayettataḥ ..
bandhūnāṃ bhojanārthāya śeṣasyānnasya bhaktimān .. 34 ..
5.223.d:
तृप्ताः स्थ इति राजेन्द्र अनुज्ञां प्रार्थयेत्ततः ..
बन्धूनां भोजनार्थाय शेषस्यान्नस्य भक्तिमान् .. 34 ..
5.223.m: 'Are you satisfied?', O best of kings; then, full of devotion, / he should request permission for the feeding of relatives with the remaining food.

5.223.s:
ucchiṣṭasannidhau paścātpitṛvediṃ samācaret ..
pitṛviprāsanasthānāṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ dvijasannidhau ..35 ..
5.223.d:
उच्छिष्टसन्निधौ पश्चात्पितृवेदिं समाचरेत् ..
पितृविप्रासनस्थानां नोच्छिष्टं द्विजसन्निधौ ..35 ..
5.223.m: Afterward, near the leftovers, he should make the altar for the ancestors; / the leftovers of those seated on the ancestors' brahmin seats are not to be near the twice-born.

5.223.s:
tato vediṃ samādhāya paitṛkīṃ dakṣiṇāplavām ..
tasyāṃ darbhānsamādhāya kuryāccaivāvanejanam .. 36 ..
5.223.d:
ततो वेदिं समाधाय पैतृकीं दक्षिणाप्लवाम् ..
तस्यां दर्भान्समाधाय कुर्याच्चैवावनेजनम् .. 36 ..
5.223.m: Then, having prepared the ancestral altar sloping toward the south, / and having arranged darbha grass upon it, he should perform the ablution.

5.223.s:
vibhaktyā pūrvayā paścātpiṃḍāndadyādyathākramam ..
bhūyo'pyatra jalaṃ dadyātpitṛtīrthena pārthiva ..
sūtraṃ ca pratipiṇḍe vai dayātteṣu pṛthakpṛthak .. 37 ..
5.223.d:
विभक्त्या पूर्वया पश्चात्पिंडान्दद्याद्यथाक्रमम् ..
भूयोऽप्यत्र जलं दद्यात्पितृतीर्थेन पार्थिव ..
सूत्रं च प्रतिपिण्डे वै दयात्तेषु पृथक्पृथक् .. 37 ..
5.223.m: Afterward, with the previous case ending, he should offer the piṇḍas in due order. / Here too he should give water via the ancestral sacred ford, O king, / and he should offer a thread on each piṇḍa, separately on each of them.

5.223.s:
yaḥ sūtraṃ pūrvapiṇḍeṣu satataṃ viniyojayet ..
sa virodhaṃ caretteṣāṃ troṭanācca parasparam .. 38 ..
5.223.d:
यः सूत्रं पूर्वपिण्डेषु सततं विनियोजयेत् ..
स विरोधं चरेत्तेषां त्रोटनाच्च परस्परम् .. 38 ..
5.223.m: One who continuously fastens a thread upon earlier piṇḍas / would cause hostility and severance among them reciprocally.

5.223.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjayetsarvānpiṃḍānyadvaddvijottamān ..
ācamya prakṣālya tathā hastau pādau ca pārthiva .. 39 ..
5.223.d:
ततः संपूजयेत्सर्वान्पिंडान्यद्वद्द्विजोत्तमान् ..
आचम्य प्रक्षाल्य तथा हस्तौ पादौ च पार्थिव .. 39 ..
5.223.m: Then he should worship all the piṇḍas just as he did the best of the twice-born. / Having sipped water and washed his hands and feet, O king,

5.223.s:
namaskṛtya pitṝnpaścātsuprokṣitaṃ tataḥ param ..
kṛtvā savyena rājendra yācayitvā varāśiṣaḥ .. 6.224.40 ..
5.223.d:
नमस्कृत्य पितॄन्पश्चात्सुप्रोक्षितं ततः परम् ..
कृत्वा सव्येन राजेन्द्र याचयित्वा वराशिषः .. 6.224.40 ..
5.223.m: and having bowed to the ancestors, after having sprinkled thoroughly, / and doing so with the sacred thread over the left shoulder, O king of kings, having asked for excellent blessings:

5.223.s:
akṣayyasalilaṃ deyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā caiva tataḥ param ..
pavitrāṇi samādāya ūrdhvaṃ svadheti kīrtayet..
astu svadheti tairukte piṃḍopari parikṣipet .. 41 ..
5.223.d:
अक्षय्यसलिलं देयं षष्ठ्या चैव ततः परम् ..
पवित्राणि समादाय ऊर्ध्वं स्वधेति कीर्तयेत्..
अस्तु स्वधेति तैरुक्ते पिंडोपरि परिक्षिपेत् .. 41 ..
5.223.m: Inexhaustible water is to be given, and then with the sixth [case]; / taking the purifying blades of grass, he should proclaim upwards, 'svadhā!' / When it is said by them, 'Let there be svadhā,' he should throw [them] onto the piṇḍas.

5.223.s:
tato madhu samādāya pāyasaṃ ca tilodakam ..
ūrjasveti ca mantreṇa pitṝṇāmuparikṣipet o. 42 ..
5.223.d:
ततो मधु समादाय पायसं च तिलोदकम् ..
ऊर्जस्वेति च मन्त्रेण पितॄणामुपरिक्षिपेत् ओ. 42 ..
5.223.m: Then, taking honey, milk-rice, and water with sesamum, / he should sprinkle them over the ancestors with the mantra 'ūrjasvatīḥ'.

5.223.s:
uttānamarghapātraṃ tu kṛtvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām ..
hiraṇyaṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ rajataṃ tathā .. 43 ..
5.223.d:
उत्तानमर्घपात्रं तु कृत्वा दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ..
हिरण्यं देवतानां च पितॄणां रजतं तथा .. 43 ..
5.223.m: Turning the arghya vessel face up, he should give the priestly gift: / gold for the deities, and silver likewise for the ancestors.

5.223.s:
tataḥ svastyudakaṃ dadyātpitṛpūrvaṃ ca savyataḥ ..
na strībhirna ca bālena nānye naiva ca kenacit .. 44 ..
5.223.d:
ततः स्वस्त्युदकं दद्यात्पितृपूर्वं च सव्यतः ..
न स्त्रीभिर्न च बालेन नान्ये नैव च केनचित् .. 44 ..
5.223.m: Then he should offer water of blessing, beginning with the ancestors and on the left. / Neither by women, nor by a child, nor by any other person—

5.223.s: śrāddhīyaviprapātraṃ ca svayameva pracālayet .. 45 ..
5.223.d: श्राद्धीयविप्रपात्रं च स्वयमेव प्रचालयेत् .. 45 ..
5.223.m: one should move the vessel of the śrāddha brahmin oneself alone.

5.223.s:
tataḥ kṛtāṃjalirbhūtvā prārthayetpārthivottama ..
aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu asmadgotraṃ vivarddhatām .. 46 ..
5.223.d:
ततः कृतांजलिर्भूत्वा प्रार्थयेत्पार्थिवोत्तम ..
अघोराः पितरः सन्तु अस्मद्गोत्रं विवर्द्धताम् .. 46 ..
5.223.m: Then, joining his hands in reverence, he should pray, O best of kings: / 'May the ancestors be non-terrifying; may our lineage flourish!

5.223.s:
dātāro no'bhivardhaṃtāṃ vedāḥ santatireva naḥ ..
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamadbahudheyaṃ ca no'stviti .. 47 ..
5.223.d:
दातारो नोऽभिवर्धंतां वेदाः सन्ततिरेव नः ..
श्रद्धा च नो मा व्यगमद्बहुधेयं च नोऽस्त्विति .. 47 ..
5.223.m: May our givers increase; may the Vedas and our offspring [prosper]! / May faith never abandon us, and may we have much to bestow!

5.223.s:
annaṃ ca no bahu bhavedatithīṃśca labhemaddi ..
yācitāraśca naḥ santu mā ca yāciṣma kaścana .. 48 ..
5.223.d:
अन्नं च नो बहु भवेदतिथींश्च लभेमद्दि ..
याचितारश्च नः सन्तु मा च याचिष्म कश्चन .. 48 ..
5.223.m: May our food be abundant, and may we receive guests! / May there be suitors coming to us, and may we never beg from anyone!'

5.223.s:
etā evāśiṣaḥ santu viśvedevāḥ prīyaṃtāṃ tataḥ ..
svastyarthamudakaṃ dadyātpitṛpūrvaṃ ca savyataḥ .. 49 ..
vājevājeti ca ṛcā visṛjecca tataḥ param ..
āmā vājasyeti pradakṣiṇīkṛtyopaveśayet ..6.224.5...
5.223.d:
एता एवाशिषः सन्तु विश्वेदेवाः प्रीयंतां ततः ..
स्वस्त्यर्थमुदकं दद्यात्पितृपूर्वं च सव्यतः .. 49 ..
वाजेवाजेति च ऋचा विसृजेच्च ततः परम् ..
आमा वाजस्येति प्रदक्षिणीकृत्योपवेशयेत् ..6.224.5...
5.223.m:
'May these very blessings be granted! May the Viśvedevas be pleased!' Then, / he should give water for well-being, beginning with the ancestors and on the left.
And after that, he should dismiss [them] with the verse 'vāje vāje'. / Having circumambulated clockwise with 'ā mā vājasya', he should seat them.

5.223.s:
pādāvamardanaṃ kṛtvā āsīmāṃtamanuvrajet ..
baliṃ ca nikṣipettasmādbhojanaṃ ca samācaret .. 51 ..
5.223.d:
पादावमर्दनं कृत्वा आसीमांतमनुव्रजेत् ..
बलिं च निक्षिपेत्तस्माद्भोजनं च समाचरेत् .. 51 ..
5.223.m: Having massaged their feet, he should follow them as far as the boundary. / And from that he should cast an offering, and then take food.

5.223.s: maunena dṛśyate sūryo yāvattāvannarādhipa .. 52 ..
5.223.d: मौनेन दृश्यते सूर्यो यावत्तावन्नराधिप .. 52 ..
5.223.m: In silence, as long as the sun is visible, O lord of men.

5.223.s:
yaścaivāstamite sūrye bhuṃkte ca śrāddhakṛnnaraḥ ..
vyarthatāṃ yāti tacchrāddhaṃ tasmādbhuṃjīta no niśi .. 53 ..
5.223.d:
यश्चैवास्तमिते सूर्ये भुंक्ते च श्राद्धकृन्नरः ..
व्यर्थतां याति तच्छ्राद्धं तस्माद्भुंजीत नो निशि .. 53 ..
5.223.m: And the man performing the śrāddha who eats when the sun has set— / that śrāddha of his becomes futile; therefore, one should not eat at night.

5.223.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhavidhivarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 224 ..
5.223.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे श्राद्धविधिवर्णनंनाम चतुर्विंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 224 ..
5.223.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Rules for the Śrāddha' in the Śrāddhakalpa of the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.224.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
ekoddiṣṭavidhiṃ brūhi mama tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara ..
pārvaṇaṃ tu yathā proktaṃ vistareṇa mahāmate .. 1 ..
5.224.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
एकोद्दिष्टविधिं ब्रूहि मम त्वं वदतां वर ..
पार्वणं तु यथा प्रोक्तं विस्तरेण महामते .. 1 ..
5.224.m: Ānarta said: / Tell me the procedure for the ekoddiṣṭa, O best of speakers, / just as the pārvaṇa was described in full detail, O noble-minded one.

5.224.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
trīṇi saṃcayanādarvāktāni tvaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam ..
yasminsthāne bhavenmṛtyustatra śrāddhaṃ tu kārayet ..2..
5.224.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
त्रीणि संचयनादर्वाक्तानि त्वं शृणु सांप्रतम् ..
यस्मिन्स्थाने भवेन्मृत्युस्तत्र श्राद्धं तु कारयेत् ..2..
5.224.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Hear now of the three [rites] prior to the gathering of the bones: / one should perform the śrāddha at that place where death occurs;

5.224.s:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tato mārge viśrāmo yatra kāritaḥ ..
tataḥ saṃcayanasthāne tṛtīyaṃ śrāddhamiṣyate .. 3 ..
5.224.d:
एकोद्दिष्टं ततो मार्गे विश्रामो यत्र कारितः ..
ततः संचयनस्थाने तृतीयं श्राद्धमिष्यते .. 3 ..
5.224.m: then the ekoddiṣṭa on the road where rest was taken; / then at the place of bone-gathering the third śrāddha is prescribed.

5.224.s:
prathame'hni dvitīyehni pañcame saptame tathā ..
navame daśame caiva nava śrāddhāni tāni ca .. 4 ..
5.224.d:
प्रथमेऽह्नि द्वितीयेह्नि पञ्चमे सप्तमे तथा ..
नवमे दशमे चैव नव श्राद्धानि तानि च .. 4 ..
5.224.m: On the first day, the second day, on the fifth, likewise on the seventh, / on the ninth, and on the tenth: these are the nine śrāddhas.

5.224.s:
vaitariṇyāśca saṃprāptau pretastṛptimavāpnuyāt ..
ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnamekārghaikapavitrakam .. 5 ..
5.224.d:
वैतरिण्याश्च संप्राप्तौ प्रेतस्तृप्तिमवाप्नुयात् ..
एकोद्दिष्टं दैवहीनमेकार्घैकपवित्रकम् .. 5 ..
5.224.m: And upon reaching the Vaitaraṇī, the deceased spirit attains satisfaction. / The ekoddiṣṭa is devoid of deities, having a single argha and a single pavitra,

5.224.s:
āvāhanaparityaktaṃ kāryaṃ pārthivasattama ..
tṛptipraśnastathā kāryaḥ svaditaṃ ca sakṛttataḥ .. 6 ..
5.224.d:
आवाहनपरित्यक्तं कार्यं पार्थिवसत्तम ..
तृप्तिप्रश्नस्तथा कार्यः स्वदितं च सकृत्ततः .. 6 ..
5.224.m: and must be performed without the invocation, O best of kings. / Likewise, the question about satisfaction should be asked, and 'svadita' [is uttered] once then.

5.224.s:
abhiramyatāmiti mantreṇa brāhmaṇasya visarjanam ..
acchinnāgramabhinnāgraṃ kuryāddarbhatṛṇadvayam ..
pavitraṃ tadvijānīyādekoddiṣṭe vidhīyate .. 7 ..
5.224.d:
अभिरम्यतामिति मन्त्रेण ब्राह्मणस्य विसर्जनम् ..
अच्छिन्नाग्रमभिन्नाग्रं कुर्याद्दर्भतृणद्वयम् ..
पवित्रं तद्विजानीयादेकोद्दिष्टे विधीयते .. 7 ..
5.224.m: The dismissal of the brahmin is with the formula 'abhiramyatām'. / One should make two blades of darbha grass with uncut tips and unsevered ends; / one should know that to be the pavitra prescribed in the ekoddiṣṭa.

5.224.s:
sarvatraiva pitaḥ proktaṃ pitā tarpaṇakarmaṇi ..
pitrye saṃkalpakāle ca piturakṣayyadāpane .. 8 ..
5.224.d:
सर्वत्रैव पितः प्रोक्तं पिता तर्पणकर्मणि ..
पित्र्ये संकल्पकाले च पितुरक्षय्यदापने .. 8 ..
5.224.m: Everywhere [the vocative] 'O Father' (pitaḥ) is prescribed; [the nominative] 'father' (pitā) in the rite of tarpaṇa; / and in ancestral rites at the time of resolution (saṅkalpa); and [the genitive] 'of the father' (pituḥ) at the offering of the inexhaustible (akṣayya). / 8

5.224.s:
gotraṃ svarāṃtaṃ sarvatra gotre tarpaṇakarmaṇi ..
gotrāya kalpanavidhau gotrasyākṣayyadāpane .. 9 ..
5.224.d:
गोत्रं स्वरांतं सर्वत्र गोत्रे तर्पणकर्मणि ..
गोत्राय कल्पनविधौ गोत्रस्याक्षय्यदापने .. 9 ..
5.224.m: Everywhere the gotra ending in a vowel [is used]; [the locative/vocative] gotre in the rite of tarpaṇa; / gotrāya [dative] in the rule of preparation; and gotrasya [genitive] at the offering of the inexhaustible. / 9

5.224.s:
śarmannarghyādikartavye śarmā tarpaṇakarmaṇi ..
śarmaṇe sasyadāne ca śarmaṇo'kṣayyake vidhau .. 6.225.10 ..
5.224.d:
शर्मन्नर्घ्यादिकर्तव्ये शर्मा तर्पणकर्मणि ..
शर्मणे सस्यदाने च शर्मणोऽक्षय्यके विधौ .. 6.225.10 ..
5.224.m: [The vocative] śarman when the arghya and so forth is to be performed; [the nominative] śarmā in the rite of tarpaṇa; / [the dative] śarmaṇe in the offering of grain; and [the genitive] śarmaṇaḥ in the rite of the inexhaustible. / 6.225.10

5.224.s:
mātarmātre tathā māturāsane kalpane'kṣaye ..
gotre gotrāyai gotrāyāḥ prathamādyā vibhaktayaḥ .. 11 ..
5.224.d:
मातर्मात्रे तथा मातुरासने कल्पनेऽक्षये ..
गोत्रे गोत्रायै गोत्रायाः प्रथमाद्या विभक्तयः .. 11 ..
5.224.m: Mātar [vocative] for the mother, and mātre [dative] and mātuḥ [genitive] in the seat, preparation, and inexhaustible [offering]; / gotre [vocative], gotrāyai [dative], and gotrāyāḥ [genitive] are the case endings beginning with the first. / 11

5.224.s:
devi devyai tathā devyā evaṃ mātuśca kīrtayet ..
prathamā ca caturthī ca ṣaṣṭhī syācchrāddhasiddhaye .. 12 ..
5.224.d:
देवि देव्यै तथा देव्या एवं मातुश्च कीर्तयेत् ..
प्रथमा च चतुर्थी च षष्ठी स्याच्छ्राद्धसिद्धये .. 12 ..
5.224.m: Devi, devyai, and devyāḥ—thus one should utter for the mother as well. / The nominative, dative, and genitive are used for the accomplishment of the śrāddha. / 12

5.224.s:
vibhaktirahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kriyate vā viparyayāt ..
akṛtaṃ tadvijānīyātpitṛṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhati .. .. 13 ..
5.224.d:
विभक्तिरहितं श्राद्धं क्रियते वा विपर्ययात् ..
अकृतं तद्विजानीयात्पितृणां नोपतिष्ठति .. .. 13 ..
5.224.m: If a śrāddha is performed devoid of case endings or through inversion, / one should know that it is undone; it does not reach the ancestors. / 13

5.224.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇena vijānatā ..
vibhaktibhiryathoktābhiḥ śrāddhe kāryo vidhiḥ sadā .. 14 ..
5.224.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणेन विजानता ..
विभक्तिभिर्यथोक्ताभिः श्राद्धे कार्यो विधिः सदा .. 14 ..
5.224.m: Therefore, with every effort, by a learned brahmin / the rite should always be performed in the śrāddha with the case endings as stated. / 14

5.224.s:
tataḥ sapiṃḍīkaraṇaṃ vatsarā dūrdhvataḥ sthitam ..
vṛddhirvā''gāminī cetsyāttadārvāgapi kārayet .. 15 ..
5.224.d:
ततः सपिंडीकरणं वत्सरा दूर्ध्वतः स्थितम् ..
वृद्धिर्वा'ऽगामिनी चेत्स्यात्तदार्वागपि कारयेत् .. 15 ..
5.224.m: Thereafter, the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa is prescribed after a year; / or, if an auspicious increase (vṛddhi) is impending, one should cause it to be done even prior [to that]. / 15

5.224.s:
pārvaṇoktavidhānena tridaivatyamadaivikam ..
pretamuddiśya kartavyameko ddiṣṭaṃ ca pārthiva .. 16 ..
5.224.d:
पार्वणोक्तविधानेन त्रिदैवत्यमदैविकम् ..
प्रेतमुद्दिश्य कर्तव्यमेको द्दिष्टं च पार्थिव .. 16 ..
5.224.m: It should be performed for the deceased (preta) by the rite prescribed for pārvaṇa, dedicated to three deities, devoid of [offerings to] the viśvedevas, / and as a single-destination (ekoddiṣṭa) [rite], O king. / 16

5.224.s:
ekenaiva tu pākena mama caitanmataṃ smṛtam ..
arghapātraṃ samādāya yatpretārthaṃ prakalpitam .. 17 ..
5.224.d:
एकेनैव तु पाकेन मम चैतन्मतं स्मृतम् ..
अर्घपात्रं समादाय यत्प्रेतार्थं प्रकल्पितम् .. 17 ..
5.224.m: And in my traditional view, it is with a single cooking [of the offering]. / Taking up the vessel of arghya that was prepared for the sake of the deceased, / 17

5.224.s:
pitṛpātreṣu triṣveva tridhā tacca parikṣipet ..
evaṃ piṃḍaṃ tridhā kṛtvā pitṛpiṃḍeṣu ca triṣu .. 18 ..
5.224.d:
पितृपात्रेषु त्रिष्वेव त्रिधा तच्च परिक्षिपेत् ..
एवं पिंडं त्रिधा कृत्वा पितृपिंडेषु च त्रिषु .. 18 ..
5.224.m: one should pour it threefold into the three vessels of the ancestors. / Likewise, dividing the lump of food (piṇḍa) into three, [he joins them] into the three lumps of the ancestors, / 18

5.224.s:
ye samāneti mantrābhyāṃ na syātpretastataḥ param ..
avanejanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṛpūrvaṃ yathākramam .. 19 ..
5.224.d:
ये समानेति मन्त्राभ्यां न स्यात्प्रेतस्ततः परम् ..
अवनेजनं ततः कृत्वा पितृपूर्वं यथाक्रमम् .. 19 ..
5.224.m: with the two mantras beginning with 'ye samānāḥ'. Thenceforth he is no longer a preta. / Having then performed the avanejana, in proper order beginning with the father, / 19

5.224.s:
gandhadhūpādikaṃ sarvaṃ punareva pradāpayet ..
pitṛpūrvaṃ samuccārya varjayecca caturthakam .. 6.225.20 ..
5.224.d:
गन्धधूपादिकं सर्वं पुनरेव प्रदापयेत् ..
पितृपूर्वं समुच्चार्य वर्जयेच्च चतुर्थकम् .. 6.225.20 ..
5.224.m: he should again bestow everything, beginning with incense and sandal-paste. / Uttering [the names] beginning with the father, he should omit the fourth. / 6.225.20

5.224.s:
keciccaturthaṃ kurvaṃti pretaṃ ca svapitustataḥ ..
pituḥ pūrvaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ paraṃ naitanmataṃ mama .. 21 ..
5.224.d:
केचिच्चतुर्थं कुर्वंति प्रेतं च स्वपितुस्ततः ..
पितुः पूर्वं भवेच्छ्राद्धं परं नैतन्मतं मम .. 21 ..
5.224.m: Some make the preta the fourth [ancestor] after their own father; / the śrāddha would then be before the father, but this is not my opinion. / 21

5.224.s:
sapiṇḍīkaraṇādūrdhvamekoddiṣṭaṃ na kārayet ..
kṣayāhaṃ ca parityajya śastrāhata caturdaśīm .. 22 ..
5.224.d:
सपिण्डीकरणादूर्ध्वमेकोद्दिष्टं न कारयेत् ..
क्षयाहं च परित्यज्य शस्त्राहत चतुर्दशीम् .. 22 ..
5.224.m: After the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa, one should not cause an ekoddiṣṭa to be performed, / except on the anniversary of death and on the fourteenth day for those slain by weapons. / 22

5.224.s:
yaḥ sapiṇḍīkṛtaṃ pretaṃ pṛthakpiṇḍe niyojayet ..
akṛtaṃ tadvijānīyātpitṛhā copajāyate ...23 ..
5.224.d:
यः सपिण्डीकृतं प्रेतं पृथक्पिण्डे नियोजयेत् ..
अकृतं तद्विजानीयात्पितृहा चोपजायते ...23 ..
5.224.m: He who assigns a separate piṇḍa to a deceased person who has undergone sapiṇḍīkaraṇa, / should know that it is undone, and he becomes a slayer of his ancestors. / 23

5.224.s:
pitā yasya tu nirvṛtto jīvate ca pitāmahaḥ ..
pituḥ sa nāma saṃkīrtya kīrtayetprapitāmaham .. 24 ..
5.224.d:
पिता यस्य तु निर्वृत्तो जीवते च पितामहः ..
पितुः स नाम संकीर्त्य कीर्तयेत्प्रपितामहम् .. 24 ..
5.224.m: He whose father is deceased, but whose grandfather is alive, / having uttered the father's name, should utter the great-grandfather's. / 24

5.224.s:
pitāmahastu pratyakṣaṃ bhuktvā gṛhṇāti piṇḍakam ..
pitāmahakṣayāhe ca pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhamiṣyate .. 25 ..
5.224.d:
पितामहस्तु प्रत्यक्षं भुक्त्वा गृह्णाति पिण्डकम् ..
पितामहक्षयाहे च पार्वणं श्राद्धमिष्यते .. 25 ..
5.224.m: For the grandfather eats and receives the piṇḍa in person. / And on the anniversary of the grandfather's death, a pārvaṇa-śrāddha is prescribed. / 25

5.224.s:
janakaṃ svaṃ parityajya kathaṃcinnāsya dīyate ..
tasyākṛtena śrāddhena na svalpaṃ pitṛto bhayam .. 26 ..
5.224.d:
जनकं स्वं परित्यज्य कथंचिन्नास्य दीयते ..
तस्याकृतेन श्राद्धेन न स्वल्पं पितृतो भयम् .. 26 ..
5.224.m: Leaving out one's own father, it is never offered to him. / From a śrāddha left unperformed for him, no small fear arises from the ancestors. / 26

5.224.s:
amāvāsyāsu sarvāsu mṛte pitari pārvaṇam ..
nabhasyāparapakṣasya madhye caitadudāhṛtam.. 27 ..
5.224.d:
अमावास्यासु सर्वासु मृते पितरि पार्वणम् ..
नभस्यापरपक्षस्य मध्ये चैतदुदाहृतम्.. 27 ..
5.224.m: On all new moon days when the father is dead, a pārvaṇa [śrāddha is performed]; / and this is declared [also] in the midst of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada. / 27

5.224.s: yāvatsapiṃḍatā naiva na tāvacchrāddhamācaret .. 28 ..
5.224.d: यावत्सपिंडता नैव न तावच्छ्राद्धमाचरेत् .. 28 ..
5.224.m: As long as the status of sapiṇḍa is not attained, one should not perform [that] śrāddha. / 28

5.224.s:
janake mṛtyumāpanne śrāddhapakṣe samāgate ..
pitāmahādeḥ kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ yannaikapiṃḍatā ..29..
5.224.d:
जनके मृत्युमापन्ने श्राद्धपक्षे समागते ..
पितामहादेः कर्तव्यं श्राद्धं यन्नैकपिंडता ..29..
5.224.m: When the father has met with death, and the fortnight of śrāddha arrives, / the śrāddha must be performed for the grandfather and the rest, since there is not yet unity of the piṇḍa. / 29

5.224.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sapiṃḍīkaraṇavidhivarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 225 ..
5.224.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सपिंडीकरणविधिवर्णनंनाम पञ्चविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 225 ..
5.224.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Rule of Sapiṇḍīkaraṇa', in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa. / 225

5.225.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
yataḥ sapiṃḍatā proktā pitṛpiṇḍaiḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
yāvatsapiṇḍatā naiva tāvatpretaḥ sa tiṣṭhati .. 1 ..
5.225.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
यतः सपिंडता प्रोक्ता पितृपिण्डैः समंततः ..
यावत्सपिण्डता नैव तावत्प्रेतः स तिष्ठति .. 1 ..
5.225.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Since sapiṇḍa status is declared all around by means of the ancestors' piṇḍas, / as long as there is no sapiṇḍa status, he remains a preta, / 1

5.225.s:
api dharmasamopetastapasā'pi samanvitaḥ ..
etasmātkāraṇātproktā munibhistu sapiṃḍatā .. 2 ..
5.225.d:
अपि धर्मसमोपेतस्तपसाऽपि समन्वितः ..
एतस्मात्कारणात्प्रोक्ता मुनिभिस्तु सपिंडता .. 2 ..
5.225.m: even if endowed with righteousness, even if endowed with austerity. / For this reason, the sapiṇḍa status has been spoken of by the sages. / 2

5.225.s:
yasyayasya ca yo'nyatra yoniṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ..
tatrasthastṛptimāpnoti yaddattaṃ tasya vaṃśajaiḥ .. 3 ..
5.225.d:
यस्ययस्य च योऽन्यत्र योनिं प्राप्नोति मानवः ..
तत्रस्थस्तृप्तिमाप्नोति यद्दत्तं तस्य वंशजैः .. 3 ..
5.225.m: Whatever womb a human being reaches elsewhere, / abiding there he attains satisfaction from whatever is given by those born of his lineage. / 3

5.225.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
ye dṛśyaṃte nijāḥ svapne cirātpitṛpitāmahāḥ ..
prārthayaṃti nijānkāmāṃstataḥ kiṃ syānmahāmune .. 4 ..
5.225.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
ये दृश्यंते निजाः स्वप्ने चिरात्पितृपितामहाः ..
प्रार्थयंति निजान्कामांस्ततः किं स्यान्महामुने .. 4 ..
5.225.m: Ānarta said: / When one's own fathers and grandfathers appear in a dream after a long time / and request their desires, what then follows, O great sage? / 4

5.225.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
yeṣāṃ gatirna saṃjātā pretatve ca vyavasthitāḥ ..
darśayaṃti ca te sarve svayamātmānameva hi .. 5 ..
5.225.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
येषां गतिर्न संजाता प्रेतत्वे च व्यवस्थिताः ..
दर्शयंति च ते सर्वे स्वयमात्मानमेव हि .. 5 ..
5.225.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / Those who have not obtained a [good] destiny and abide in the state of a preta, / they all indeed show their own selves / 5

5.225.s:
svavaṃśyānāṃ na cānye tu satyametanmayoditam ..
yathā loke'tra saṃjātā ye ca kṛtyaiḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ .. 6 ..
5.225.d:
स्ववंश्यानां न चान्ये तु सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
यथा लोकेऽत्र संजाता ये च कृत्यैः शुभाशुभैः .. 6 ..
5.225.m: to those of their own lineage, and not to others; this is the truth spoken by me, / just as those born here in this world [reap results] through auspicious and inauspicious deeds. / 6

5.225.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
yasya no vidyate putraḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ katham ..
tasya kāryaṃ bhavedatra tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi .. .. 7 ..
5.225.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
यस्य नो विद्यते पुत्रः सपिण्डीकरणं कथम् ..
तस्य कार्यं भवेदत्र तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि .. .. 7 ..
5.225.m: Ānarta said: / For him who has no son, how should sapiṇḍīkaraṇa / be performed here for him? You ought to tell me that. / 7

5.225.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
yasya no vidyate putra aurasaśca mahīpate ..
caturṇāṃ svapitṝṇāṃ tu kathaṃ sa syāccaturthakaḥ .. 8 ..
5.225.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
यस्य नो विद्यते पुत्र औरसश्च महीपते ..
चतुर्णां स्वपितॄणां तु कथं स स्याच्चतुर्थकः .. 8 ..
5.225.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / For him who has no bodily son, O king, / how could he become the fourth among the four ancestors? / 8

5.225.s:
prakarṣeṇa vrajedyasmāttasmātpretaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
putreṇa bhrātrā patnyā vā tasya kāryā sapiṃḍatā .. 9 ..
5.225.d:
प्रकर्षेण व्रजेद्यस्मात्तस्मात्प्रेतः प्रकीर्तितः ..
पुत्रेण भ्रात्रा पत्न्या वा तस्य कार्या सपिंडता .. 9 ..
5.225.m: Because he departs violently (prakarṣeṇa vrajet), therefore he is declared a preta. / His sapiṇḍa status must be performed by a son, a brother, or a wife. / 9

5.225.s:
caturtho yadi rājeṃdra jāyate na kathaṃcana ..
kṣetrajādīnsutānetānekādaśa yathoditān .. 6.226.10 ..
5.225.d:
चतुर्थो यदि राजेंद्र जायते न कथंचन ..
क्षेत्रजादीन्सुतानेतानेकादश यथोदितान् .. 6.226.10 ..
5.225.m: If, O best of kings, a fourth is not born in any way, / these eleven sons, beginning with the child born of the wife (kṣetraja) as stated, / 6.226.10

5.225.s:
putrapratinidhīnāhuḥ kriyālopānmanīṣiṇaḥ ..
kāle yadi na rājeṃdra jāyate'syottarakriyā .. 11 ..
5.225.d:
पुत्रप्रतिनिधीनाहुः क्रियालोपान्मनीषिणः ..
काले यदि न राजेंद्र जायतेऽस्योत्तरक्रिया .. 11 ..
5.225.m: the wise call substitutes for a son, lest the rites fail. / If at that time his subsequent rite (uttarakriyā) does not take place, O best of kings, / 11

5.225.s:
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryaḥ pretatvasya vināśakaḥ ..
yathānyeṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāmapamṛtyumupeyuṣām ..
kāryaścaivātmahaṃtṝṇāṃ brāhmaṇānmṛtyumīyuṣām .. 12 ..
5.225.d:
नारायणबलिः कार्यः प्रेतत्वस्य विनाशकः ..
यथान्येषां मनुष्याणामपमृत्युमुपेयुषाम् ..
कार्यश्चैवात्महंतॄणां ब्राह्मणान्मृत्युमीयुषाम् .. 12 ..
5.225.m: the Nārāyaṇabali must be performed, which destroys the state of being a preta; / just as for other men who have met with an untimely death, / and it should also be performed for those who commit suicide, [or] who die at the hands of a brahmin. / 12

5.225.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ mṛtyumavāpnoti puruṣo'tra mahāmate .. 13 ..
5.225.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
कथं मृत्युमवाप्नोति पुरुषोऽत्र महामते .. 13 ..
5.225.m: Ānarta said: / How does a man meet with death here, O highly intelligent one? / 13

5.225.s:
svargaṃ vā narakaṃ vāpi karmaṇā kena gacchati ..
mokṣaṃ vā'tha mahābhāga sarvaṃ me vista rādvada .. 14 ..
5.225.d:
स्वर्गं वा नरकं वापि कर्मणा केन गच्छति ..
मोक्षं वाऽथ महाभाग सर्वं मे विस्त राद्वद .. 14 ..
5.225.m: And by what action does he go to heaven or to hell, / or to liberation, O fortunate one? Tell me all in detail. / 14

5.225.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
dharmī pāpī tathā jñānī tisro'tra gatayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
dharmātsaṃprāpyate svargaḥ pāpānnaraka eva ca .. 15 ..
5.225.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
धर्मी पापी तथा ज्ञानी तिस्रोऽत्र गतयः स्मृताः ..
धर्मात्संप्राप्यते स्वर्गः पापान्नरक एव च .. 15 ..
5.225.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / The righteous, the sinful, and the possessor of knowledge—three destinations are taught here: / from righteousness heaven is attained, and from sin, hell alone; / 15

5.225.s:
jñānātsaṃprāpyate mokṣaḥ satyametanmayoditam ..
enamarthaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ tu bhīṣmaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ nṛpa .. 16 ..
5.225.d:
ज्ञानात्संप्राप्यते मोक्षः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
एनमर्थं भविष्यं तु भीष्मं शांतनवं नृप .. 16 ..
5.225.m: from knowledge, liberation is attained; this is the truth spoken by me. / Concerning this matter, O king, Yudhiṣṭhira, the great king, / 16

5.225.s:
yudhiṣṭhiro mahārāja dharmaputro nṛpottamaḥ ..
kṛṣṇena saha rājeṃdra pitāmahamapṛcchata .. 17 ..
5.225.d:
युधिष्ठिरो महाराज धर्मपुत्रो नृपोत्तमः ..
कृष्णेन सह राजेंद्र पितामहमपृच्छत .. 17 ..
5.225.m: the son of Dharma and best of kings, together with Kṛṣṇa, / questioned the grandfather Bhīṣma, the son of Śaṃtanu, O best of kings. / 17

5.225.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kiyaṃto narakāḥ khyātā yamaloke pitāmaha ..
kena pāpena gacchaṃti teṣu sarveṣu jaṃtavaḥ .. 18 ..
5.225.d:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
कियंतो नरकाः ख्याता यमलोके पितामह ..
केन पापेन गच्छंति तेषु सर्वेषु जंतवः .. 18 ..
5.225.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How many hells are proclaimed in the realm of Yama, O grandfather? / By what sin do all creatures go into them? / 18

5.225.s:
.. śrībhīṣma uvāca .. ..
ekaviṃśatpramāṇāḥ syurnarakā yamamaṃdire ..
prāṇinasteṣu gacchaṃti nijakarmānusārataḥ .. 19 ..
5.225.d:
.. श्रीभीष्म उवाच .. ..
एकविंशत्प्रमाणाः स्युर्नरका यममंदिरे ..
प्राणिनस्तेषु गच्छंति निजकर्मानुसारतः .. 19 ..
5.225.m: Glorious Bhīṣma said: / There are twenty-one hells in the abode of Yama. / Living beings go to them according to their own actions.

5.225.s: khyātau citravicitrau ca kāyasthau yamamaṃdire .. 6.226.20 ..
5.225.d: ख्यातौ चित्रविचित्रौ च कायस्थौ यममंदिरे .. 6.226.20 ..
5.225.m: The two scribes, Citra and Vicitra, are renowned in the abode of Yama.

5.225.s:
citro'tha likhate dharmaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇisamudbhavam ..
vicitraḥ pātakaṃ sarvaṃ paramaṃ yatnamāsthitaḥ .. 21 ..
5.225.d:
चित्रोऽथ लिखते धर्मं सर्वं प्राणिसमुद्भवम् ..
विचित्रः पातकं सर्वं परमं यत्नमास्थितः .. 21 ..
5.225.m: Citra then writes down all the dharma originating from living beings, / [while] Vicitra, exerting the greatest effort, [writes down] every sin.

5.225.s:
yamadūtāḥ sadaivāṣṭau dharmarājasamudbhavāḥ ..
ye nayaṃti narānmṛtyulokātsvavaśagānsadā.. 22 ..
5.225.d:
यमदूताः सदैवाष्टौ धर्मराजसमुद्भवाः ..
ये नयंति नरान्मृत्युलोकात्स्ववशगान्सदा.. 22 ..
5.225.m: There are always eight messengers of Yama born from the King of Dharma, / who continually lead men from the world of mortals into their own power:

5.225.s:
karālo vikarālaśca vakranāso mahodaraḥ ..
saumyaḥ śāṃtastathā naṃdaḥ suvākyaścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 23 ..
5.225.d:
करालो विकरालश्च वक्रनासो महोदरः ..
सौम्यः शांतस्तथा नंदः सुवाक्यश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः .. 23 ..
5.225.m: Karāla, Vikarāla, Vakranāsa, Mahodara, / Saumya, Śānta, Nanda, and Suvākya is recorded as the eighth.

5.225.s:
eteṣāṃ ye purā proktāścatvāro raudrarūpiṇaḥ ..
pāpaṃ janaṃ ca te sarve nayanti yamasādanam .. 24 ..
5.225.d:
एतेषां ये पुरा प्रोक्ताश्चत्वारो रौद्ररूपिणः ..
पापं जनं च ते सर्वे नयन्ति यमसादनम् .. 24 ..
5.225.m: Of these, the four mentioned first are of terrifying form; / they lead all sinful people to the abode of Yama.

5.225.s:
catvāro ye pare proktāḥ saumyarūpavapurddharāḥ ..
dharmiṇaṃ te janaṃ sarvaṃ nayaṃti yamasādanam .. 25 ..
5.225.d:
चत्वारो ये परे प्रोक्ताः सौम्यरूपवपुर्द्धराः ..
धर्मिणं ते जनं सर्वं नयंति यमसादनम् .. 25 ..
5.225.m: The other four mentioned possess gentle forms and bodies; / they lead all righteous people to the abode of Yama,

5.225.s: vimānena samārūḍhamapsarogaṇasevitam .. 26 ..
5.225.d: विमानेन समारूढमप्सरोगणसेवितम् .. 26 ..
5.225.m: mounted upon a vimāna, served by hosts of apsarases.

5.225.s:
likhitasyānurūpeṇa pāpadharmodbhavasya ca ..
eteṣāṃ kiṃkarā ye ca teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na jāyate .. 27 ..
5.225.d:
लिखितस्यानुरूपेण पापधर्मोद्भवस्य च ..
एतेषां किंकरा ये च तेषां संख्या न जायते .. 27 ..
5.225.m: In accordance with what is written regarding the production of sin and dharma, / there are servants of these [messengers], and of them no count is known.

5.225.s:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ teṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ parikalpitam ..
sahāyārthaṃ yamenātra jvarayakṣmāṃtarasthitam .. 28 ..
5.225.d:
अष्टोत्तरशतं तेषां व्याधीनां परिकल्पितम् ..
सहायार्थं यमेनात्र ज्वरयक्ष्मांतरस्थितम् .. 28 ..
5.225.m: One hundred and eight diseases have been appointed by Yama / to assist them here, with fever and consumption at their head.

5.225.s: te gatvā vyādhayaḥ pūrvaṃ vaśe kurvaṃti mānavam .. 29 ..
5.225.d: ते गत्वा व्याधयः पूर्वं वशे कुर्वंति मानवम् .. 29 ..
5.225.m: Those diseases go forth first and bring the mortal under control.

5.225.s:
yamadūtāstato gatvā nābhimūlavyavasthitam..
vāyurūpaṃ samādāya janaiḥ sarvairalakṣitāḥ .. 6.226.30 ..
5.225.d:
यमदूतास्ततो गत्वा नाभिमूलव्यवस्थितम्..
वायुरूपं समादाय जनैः सर्वैरलक्षिताः .. 6.226.30 ..
5.225.m: Then, having gone there, Yama's messengers take hold of the [soul in the] form of wind / situated at the root of the navel, unseen by any people.

5.225.s:
gacchaṃti yamamārgeṇa dehaṃ saṃsthāpya bhūtale ..
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yamamārgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. .. 31 ..
5.225.d:
गच्छंति यममार्गेण देहं संस्थाप्य भूतले ..
षडशीतिसहस्राणि यममार्गः प्रकीर्तितः .. .. 31 ..
5.225.m: Leaving the body behind on the earth, they proceed along the path of Yama; / the path of Yama is proclaimed to be eighty-six thousand [yojanas].

5.225.s:
tatra vaitaraṇīnāma nadī pūrvaṃ pariśrutā ..
srotobhyāṃ sā mahābhāga tatra saṃsthā sadaiva hi .. 32 ..
5.225.d:
तत्र वैतरणीनाम नदी पूर्वं परिश्रुता ..
स्रोतोभ्यां सा महाभाग तत्र संस्था सदैव हि .. 32 ..
5.225.m: There is a river formerly renowned by the name Vaitaraṇī; / with two streams, O fortunate one, she is ever stationed there.

5.225.s:
tatra śoṇitamekasminsrotasyasyā vaha tyalam..
śastrāṇi ca sutīkṣṇāni tanmadhye bharatarṣabha .. 33 ..
5.225.d:
तत्र शोणितमेकस्मिन्स्रोतस्यस्या वह त्यलम्..
शस्त्राणि च सुतीक्ष्णानि तन्मध्ये भरतर्षभ .. 33 ..
5.225.m: In one of her streams, blood flows profusely, / and within it are very sharp weapons, O bull of the Bharatas.

5.225.s:
mṛtyukāle prayacchaṃti ye dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya vai ..
tasyāḥ pucchaṃ samāśritya te taraṃti ca tāṃ nṛpa..34..
5.225.d:
मृत्युकाले प्रयच्छंति ये धेनुं ब्राह्मणाय वै ..
तस्याः पुच्छं समाश्रित्य ते तरंति च तां नृप..34..
5.225.m: Those who give a cow to a brahmin at the time of death, / clinging to her tail, they cross over it, O king.

5.225.s:
svabāhubhistathaivānye śatayojanavistṛtam..
dvitīyaṃ caiva tatsroto vaitaraṇyā vyavasthitam..
tasyāstatsalilasrāvi gamyaṃ dharmavatāṃ sadā..35..
5.225.d:
स्वबाहुभिस्तथैवान्ये शतयोजनविस्तृतम्..
द्वितीयं चैव तत्स्रोतो वैतरण्या व्यवस्थितम्..
तस्यास्तत्सलिलस्रावि गम्यं धर्मवतां सदा..35..
5.225.m: Others [must cross] by their own arms over a breadth of a hundred yojanas. / And the second stream of Vaitaraṇī is situated there: / flowing with pure water, it is ever passable for the righteous.

5.225.s:
ye narā gopradātāro mṛtyukāle vyavasthite..
te gopucchaṃ samāśritya tāṃ taraṃti pṛthūdakām..
anye svabāhubhiḥ kṛtvā gopradānavivarjitāḥ..36..
5.225.d:
ये नरा गोप्रदातारो मृत्युकाले व्यवस्थिते..
ते गोपुच्छं समाश्रित्य तां तरंति पृथूदकाम्..
अन्ये स्वबाहुभिः कृत्वा गोप्रदानविवर्जिताः..36..
5.225.m: Those men who are givers of cows when the time of death arrives, / clinging to the tail of the cow, cross that broad-watered [river]; / others, devoid of the gift of a cow, [must do so] by their own arms.

5.225.s:
gopradānaṃ prakartavyaṃ tasmāccaiva viśeṣataḥ..
mṛtyukāle'tra saṃprāpte ya icchedgatimātmanaḥ..37..
5.225.d:
गोप्रदानं प्रकर्तव्यं तस्माच्चैव विशेषतः..
मृत्युकालेऽत्र संप्राप्ते य इच्छेद्गतिमात्मनः..37..
5.225.m: Therefore, the gift of a cow should be made especially / when the time of death has arrived here, by one who desires his own good course.

5.225.s:
tasyā anantaraṃ yāṃti pāpamārgeṇa pāpinaḥ..
dharmiṣṭhā dharmamārgeṇa vimānavaramāśritāḥ..38..
5.225.d:
तस्या अनन्तरं यांति पापमार्गेण पापिनः..
धर्मिष्ठा धर्ममार्गेण विमानवरमाश्रिताः..38..
5.225.m: After that [river], sinners go along the path of sin, / while the most righteous go along the path of dharma, seated on an excellent vimāna.

5.225.s:
vaitaraṇyāḥ paraṃ pāre paṃcayojanamāyatam..
asipatravanaṃnāma pāpalokasya duḥkhadam..39..
5.225.d:
वैतरण्याः परं पारे पंचयोजनमायतम्..
असिपत्रवनंनाम पापलोकस्य दुःखदम्..39..
5.225.m: On the farther shore of the Vaitaraṇī, five yojanas in length, / is the forest named Asipatravana, bringing misery to sinful people.

5.225.s:
tatra lohamayānyevāsipatrāṇāṃ śatāni ca..
yāni kṛntaṃti martyānāṃ śarīrāṇi samaṃtataḥ..6.226.40..
5.225.d:
तत्र लोहमयान्येवासिपत्राणां शतानि च..
यानि कृन्तंति मर्त्यानां शरीराणि समंततः..6.226.40..
5.225.m: There are hundreds of sword-blades made of iron, / which slice the bodies of mortals on all sides.

5.225.s:
yairhṛtaṃ paravittaṃ ca kalatraṃ ca durātmabhiḥ..
nava śrāddhāni teṣāṃ cettasmānmuktiḥ prajāyate..41..
5.225.d:
यैर्हृतं परवित्तं च कलत्रं च दुरात्मभिः..
नव श्राद्धानि तेषां चेत्तस्मान्मुक्तिः प्रजायते..41..
5.225.m: For those evil-souled ones by whom another’s wealth and wife were stolen, / if nine śrāddhas are performed, liberation from that arises.

5.225.s:
tasmātparataro jñeyo vikhyātaḥ kūṭaśālmaliḥ..
adhomukhāḥ pralaṃbaṃte tasminkaṃṭakasaṃkule..42..
5.225.d:
तस्मात्परतरो ज्ञेयो विख्यातः कूटशाल्मलिः..
अधोमुखाः प्रलंबंते तस्मिन्कंटकसंकुले..42..
5.225.m: Beyond that, the renowned Kūṭaśālmali is known; / [sinners] hang face downward on it, thick with thorns,

5.225.s:
adhastādvahninā caiva dahyamānā divāniśam..
viśvāsaghātakā ye ca sarvadaiva sunirdayāḥ..
tasmānmuktiṃ prayāṃti sma śrāddhe hyekādaśe kṛte..43..
5.225.d:
अधस्ताद्वह्निना चैव दह्यमाना दिवानिशम्..
विश्वासघातका ये च सर्वदैव सुनिर्दयाः..
तस्मान्मुक्तिं प्रयांति स्म श्राद्धे ह्येकादशे कृते..43..
5.225.m: and burned from below by fire day and night. / Those who are betrayers of trust and always utterly merciless / attain liberation from it when the eleventh-day śrāddha has been performed.

5.225.s:
yaṃtrātmakastataḥ prokto narako dāruṇākṛtiḥ..
brahmaghnāstatra pīḍyaṃte ye cā'nye pāpakarmiṇaḥ..44..
5.225.d:
यंत्रात्मकस्ततः प्रोक्तो नरको दारुणाकृतिः..
ब्रह्मघ्नास्तत्र पीड्यंते ये चाऽन्ये पापकर्मिणः..44..
5.225.m: After that is proclaimed the dread-formed hell named Yantra; / there the slayers of brahmins are tortured, as are other evildoers.

5.225.s:
śrāddhena dvādaśotthena tebhyo dattena pārthiva..
tasmānmuktiṃ pragacchanti yantrākhyanarakātsphuṭam .. 45 ..
5.225.d:
श्राद्धेन द्वादशोत्थेन तेभ्यो दत्तेन पार्थिव..
तस्मान्मुक्तिं प्रगच्छन्ति यन्त्राख्यनरकात्स्फुटम् .. 45 ..
5.225.m: By the śrāddha on the twelfth day offered for them, O ruler of the earth, / they clearly attain liberation from the hell named Yantra.

5.225.s:
tato lohasamāḥ staṃbhā jvalamānā vyavasthitāḥ ..
āliṃgaṃti ca tānsarvānparadāraratāśca ye .. .. 46 ..
5.225.d:
ततो लोहसमाः स्तंभा ज्वलमाना व्यवस्थिताः ..
आलिंगंति च तान्सर्वान्परदाररताश्च ये .. .. 46 ..
5.225.m: Next stand blazing pillars made of iron, / and those who delight in other men's wives are made to embrace them all.

5.225.s: māsikotthe kṛte śrāddhe tebhyo muktimavāpnuyuḥ 47 ..
5.225.d: मासिकोत्थे कृते श्राद्धे तेभ्यो मुक्तिमवाप्नुयुः 47 ..
5.225.m: When the monthly śrāddha is performed, they obtain liberation from them.

5.225.s:
lohadaṃṣṭrāstato raudrāḥ sārameyā vyavasthitāḥ ..
bhakṣayaṃti ca te pāpānpṛṣṭhamāṃsā śino narān ..
traipakṣike kṛte śrāddhe tebhyo muktimavāpnuyuḥ .. 48 ..
5.225.d:
लोहदंष्ट्रास्ततो रौद्राः सारमेया व्यवस्थिताः ..
भक्षयंति च ते पापान्पृष्ठमांसा शिनो नरान् ..
त्रैपक्षिके कृते श्राद्धे तेभ्यो मुक्तिमवाप्नुयुः .. 48 ..
5.225.m: Next are stationed fierce hounds with iron fangs; / they devour the sinners who ate the flesh of [another's] back (slanderers). / When the forty-fifth-day śrāddha is performed, they obtain liberation from them.

5.225.s:
lohacaṃcumayāḥ kākāḥ saṃsthitāstadanaṃtaram ..
sarāgairlocenairyaiśca īkṣitāḥ para yoṣitaḥ .. 49 ..
5.225.d:
लोहचंचुमयाः काकाः संस्थितास्तदनंतरम् ..
सरागैर्लोचेनैर्यैश्च ईक्षिताः पर योषितः .. 49 ..
5.225.m: Immediately after that stand crows with beaks of iron. / Those by whom other men's wives were looked upon with lustful eyes—

5.225.s:
teṣāṃ netrāṇi te ghnaṃti bhūyo jātāni bhūriśaḥ .
dvimāsikaṃ ca yacchrāddhaṃ tena muktiḥ prajāyate . 6.226.50 ..
5.225.d:
तेषां नेत्राणि ते घ्नंति भूयो जातानि भूरिशः .
द्विमासिकं च यच्छ्राद्धं तेन मुक्तिः प्रजायते . 6.226.50 ..
5.225.m: they strike at their eyes, which are repeatedly regenerated in abundance. / And by the two-month śrāddha, liberation from that arises.

5.225.s:
tataḥ śālmalikūṭastu tathānye lohakaṇṭakāḥ ..
teṣāṃ madhyena nīyaṃte paiśunyaniratā narāḥ ..
trimāsikaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tena muktiḥ prajāyate .. 51 ..
5.225.d:
ततः शाल्मलिकूटस्तु तथान्ये लोहकण्टकाः ..
तेषां मध्येन नीयंते पैशुन्यनिरता नराः ..
त्रिमासिकं तु यच्छ्राद्धं तेन मुक्तिः प्रजायते .. 51 ..
5.225.m: Then there is the peak of the silk-cotton tree and other iron thorns; / through the midst of them men devoted to slander are led. / But by the three-month śrāddha, liberation from that arises.

5.225.s:
rauravo'tha suvikhyāto dāruṇo narako mahān ..
brahmaghnānāṃ samādiṣṭaḥ sa mahākleśakārakaḥ .. 52 ..
5.225.d:
रौरवोऽथ सुविख्यातो दारुणो नरको महान् ..
ब्रह्मघ्नानां समादिष्टः स महाक्लेशकारकः .. 52 ..
5.225.m: Next is the well-known Raurava, a great and dreadful hell; / it is prescribed for the slayers of brahmins, causing great torment.

5.225.s:
chidyaṃte vividhaiḥ śastraistatrasthā ye muhurmuhuḥ ..
caturmāsikaśrāddhena muktisteṣāṃ prajāyate .. 53 ..
5.225.d:
छिद्यंते विविधैः शस्त्रैस्तत्रस्था ये मुहुर्मुहुः ..
चतुर्मासिकश्राद्धेन मुक्तिस्तेषां प्रजायते .. 53 ..
5.225.m: Those situated there are repeatedly hacked by various weapons; / through the four-month śrāddha, their liberation arises.

5.225.s:
aparastu samākhyātaḥ kṣārodastu sudāruṇaḥ ..
kṛtaghnānāṃ samādiṣṭaḥ sadaiva bahuvedanaḥ .. 54 ..
5.225.d:
अपरस्तु समाख्यातः क्षारोदस्तु सुदारुणः ..
कृतघ्नानां समादिष्टः सदैव बहुवेदनः .. 54 ..
5.225.m: Another is proclaimed, Kṣāroda, extremely dreadful; / it is prescribed for the ungrateful, ever bringing great suffering,

5.225.s:
adhomukhā ūrdhva pādāḥ pīḍyaṃte yatra laṃbitāḥ ..
pañcamāsikadānena muktisteṣāṃ prajāyate .. 55 ..
5.225.d:
अधोमुखा ऊर्ध्व पादाः पीड्यंते यत्र लंबिताः ..
पञ्चमासिकदानेन मुक्तिस्तेषां प्रजायते .. 55 ..
5.225.m: where they are tortured hanging upside down with feet raised aloft; / through the five-month offering, their liberation arises.

5.225.s:
kumbhīpākastato jñeyo narako dāruṇākṛtiḥ ..
tailena kṣipyamāṇāstu yatra daṇḍābhisaṃdhitāḥ ..
dṛśyaṃte janahaṃtāro bālahaṃtāra eva ca .. 56 ..
5.225.d:
कुम्भीपाकस्ततो ज्ञेयो नरको दारुणाकृतिः ..
तैलेन क्षिप्यमाणास्तु यत्र दण्डाभिसंधिताः ..
दृश्यंते जनहंतारो बालहंतार एव च .. 56 ..
5.225.m: Then Kumbhīpāka is known, a hell of dreadful form, / where, thrown into oil and struck with clubs, / killers of people and killers of children are seen.

5.225.s:
pataṃti narake raudre narā viśvāsaghātakāḥ..
ṣaṇmāsikapradānena mucyaṃte tatra saṃkaṭāt .. 57 ..
5.225.d:
पतंति नरके रौद्रे नरा विश्वासघातकाः..
षण्मासिकप्रदानेन मुच्यंते तत्र संकटात् .. 57 ..
5.225.m: Men who betray trust fall into that terrible hell; / through the six-month offering they are released from that plight.

5.225.s:
sarpavṛścikasaṃyuktastathā'nyo narakaḥ śrutaḥ ..
tatra ye dāṃbhikā loke te gacchanti narādhamāḥ ..
saptamāsikadānena teṣāṃ muktiḥ prajāyate .. 58 ..
5.225.d:
सर्पवृश्चिकसंयुक्तस्तथाऽन्यो नरकः श्रुतः ..
तत्र ये दांभिका लोके ते गच्छन्ति नराधमाः ..
सप्तमासिकदानेन तेषां मुक्तिः प्रजायते .. 58 ..
5.225.m: Another hell filled with serpents and scorpions is known; / there the hypocrites in the world go, the lowest of men. / Through the seven-month offering, their liberation arises.

5.225.s:
tathā saṃvartakonāma narako'nyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
vedaviplāvakāḥ sādhuniṃdakāśca durātmakāḥ .. 59 ..
5.225.d:
तथा संवर्तकोनाम नरकोऽन्यः प्रकीर्तितः ..
वेदविप्लावकाः साधुनिंदकाश्च दुरात्मकाः .. 59 ..
5.225.m: Likewise another hell is proclaimed by the name Saṃvartaka; / perverters of the Vedas and evil-minded revilers of the virtuous [go there].

5.225.s:
utpāṭyate tato jihvā sandaṃśairva hnisambhavaiḥ ..
svakārye ye'nṛtaṃ brūyustadgātraṃ khādyate śvabhiḥ .. 6.226.60 ..
5.225.d:
उत्पाट्यते ततो जिह्वा सन्दंशैर्व ह्निसम्भवैः ..
स्वकार्ये येऽनृतं ब्रूयुस्तद्गात्रं खाद्यते श्वभिः .. 6.226.60 ..
5.225.m: Then the tongue is torn out with tongs born of fire. / For those who speak untruth in their own interest, their limbs are eaten by dogs;

5.225.s:
parārthe'pi ca ye brūyusteṣāṃ gātrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
aṣṭamāsikadānena teṣāṃ muktiḥ prajāyate .. 61 ..
5.225.d:
परार्थेऽपि च ये ब्रूयुस्तेषां गात्राणि कृत्स्नशः ..
अष्टमासिकदानेन तेषां मुक्तिः प्रजायते .. 61 ..
5.225.m: and for those who speak [untruth] for the sake of another, their limbs [are devoured] entirely. / Through the eight-month offering, their liberation arises.

5.225.s:
agnikūṭo mahāplāvo dāruṇo narako mahān ..
tatra te yāṃti vai mūḍhāḥ kūṭasākṣyipradā narāḥ .. 62 ..
5.225.d:
अग्निकूटो महाप्लावो दारुणो नरको महान् ..
तत्र ते यांति वै मूढाः कूटसाक्ष्यिप्रदा नराः .. 62 ..
5.225.m: The fire-summit hell is a vast inundation, terrible and great; / there those fools go who bear false witness.

5.225.s:
tatrasthā yātanāṃ raudrāṃ sahaṃ te'tīva duḥkhitāḥ ..
navamāsikadānaṃ ca teṣāmāhlādanaṃ param .. 63 ..
5.225.d:
तत्रस्था यातनां रौद्रां सहं तेऽतीव दुःखिताः ..
नवमासिकदानं च तेषामाह्लादनं परम् .. 63 ..
5.225.m: Standing there, they endure fierce torment, intensely miserable; / and a gift made in the ninth month brings them supreme joy.

5.225.s:
tato lohamayaiḥ kīlaiḥ saṃcito'nyaḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
tatra cāgnipradātāraḥ strīṇāṃ hantāra eva ca .. 64 ..
5.225.d:
ततो लोहमयैः कीलैः संचितोऽन्यः समंततः ..
तत्र चाग्निप्रदातारः स्त्रीणां हन्तार एव च .. 64 ..
5.225.m: Then there is another [hell] filled all around with iron stakes; / and there go incendiaries and the murderers of women.

5.225.s:
tatra dhāvaṃti duḥkhārtāstāḍyamānāśca kiṃkaraiḥ ..
daśamāsikajaṃ dānaṃ tatra teṣāṃ pramuktaye ..685..
tatoṃ'gāramayaiḥ puṃjairāvṛtābhūḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
svāmidroharatāstatra bhrāmyaṃte sarvato diśaḥ .. 66 ..
ekādaśodbhavaṃ dānaṃ tatra muktyai prajāyate ..
saṃtaptasikatāpūrṇo narako dāruṇākṛtiḥ .. ..67..
svāminaṃ cāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ ..
ye bhavanti narāstatra pacyaṃte te'pi duḥkhitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ dvādaśamāsīyaṃ śrāddhaṃ caivopatiṣṭhati ..68..
yatkiṃciddīyate toyamannaṃ vā vatsarāṃtare ..
prabhuṃjate ca tanmārge pradattaṃ nijabāndhavaiḥ .. 69 ..
tataḥ saṃvatsarādūrdhvaṃ nijakarmasamudbhavam ..
śubhāśubhaṃ prapadyaṃte dharmarājasamīpagāḥ .. 6.226.70 ..
evaṃ paṃcadaśaitāni saṃsevya narakāṇi te ..
prāpnuvaṃti tato janma martyaloke punarnarāḥ .. 71 ..
5.225.d:
तत्र धावंति दुःखार्तास्ताड्यमानाश्च किंकरैः ..
दशमासिकजं दानं तत्र तेषां प्रमुक्तये ..685..
ततोंऽगारमयैः पुंजैरावृताभूः समंततः ..
स्वामिद्रोहरतास्तत्र भ्राम्यंते सर्वतो दिशः .. 66 ..
एकादशोद्भवं दानं तत्र मुक्त्यै प्रजायते ..
संतप्तसिकतापूर्णो नरको दारुणाकृतिः .. ..67..
स्वामिनं चागतं दृष्ट्वा पलायनपरायणाः ..
ये भवन्ति नरास्तत्र पच्यंते तेऽपि दुःखिताः ..
तेषां द्वादशमासीयं श्राद्धं चैवोपतिष्ठति ..68..
यत्किंचिद्दीयते तोयमन्नं वा वत्सरांतरे ..
प्रभुंजते च तन्मार्गे प्रदत्तं निजबान्धवैः .. 69 ..
ततः संवत्सरादूर्ध्वं निजकर्मसमुद्भवम् ..
शुभाशुभं प्रपद्यंते धर्मराजसमीपगाः .. 6.226.70 ..
एवं पंचदशैतानि संसेव्य नरकाणि ते ..
प्राप्नुवंति ततो जन्म मर्त्यलोके पुनर्नराः .. 71 ..
5.225.m:
There they run, stricken with misery and beaten by the attendants; / a gift born of the tenth month is for their deliverance there.
Then the ground is covered all around with heaps of burning coals; / there those who delight in treason against their master wander in every direction.
A gift arising from the eleventh [month] brings about liberation there. / Hell full of scorching sand is dreadful in appearance.
And those men who, seeing their master arrive, take to flight, / are cooked there, miserable; / and the śrāddha of the twelfth month assists them.
Whatever water or food is given in the course of that year, / offered by their own relatives, they enjoy upon that path.
Then, beyond the year, having approached the King of Dharma, / they experience the good and the bad arising from their own deeds.
Having thus experienced these fifteen hells, / those men then obtain birth once again in the mortal world.

5.225.s:
prāpnuvaṃti videśe ca janma ye hetuvādakāḥ ..
nityaṃ tarpaṇadānena teṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate .. 72 ..
svāmidroharatā ye ca kurājye janma cāpnuyuḥ ..
haṃtakārapradānena teṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate .. 73 ..
adattvā ye naro'śnaṃti pitṛdevadvijātiṣu ..
durbhikṣe janma teṣāṃ tu tena pāpena jāyate .. 74 ..
5.225.d:
प्राप्नुवंति विदेशे च जन्म ये हेतुवादकाः ..
नित्यं तर्पणदानेन तेषां तृप्तिः प्रजायते .. 72 ..
स्वामिद्रोहरता ये च कुराज्ये जन्म चाप्नुयुः ..
हंतकारप्रदानेन तेषां तृप्तिः प्रजायते .. 73 ..
अदत्त्वा ये नरोऽश्नंति पितृदेवद्विजातिषु ..
दुर्भिक्षे जन्म तेषां तु तेन पापेन जायते .. 74 ..
5.225.m:
And those sophists obtain birth in a foreign land; / by the daily offering of tarpaṇa, their satisfaction is produced.
And those intent on treason against their master obtain birth in a wicked realm; / by the offering of an alms-portion, their satisfaction is produced.
Those men who eat without giving to the ancestors, gods, and twice-born / are born in famine through that sin.

5.225.s:
kṣayāhe śrāddhasaṃprāptau tata stṛptiḥ prajāyate .. 758 ..
ye prakurvaṃti dampatyorbhedaṃ vai sānurāgayoḥ ..
parasparamasatyāni teṣāṃ bhāryā'satī bhavet .. 76 ..
ekasminvacane prokte daśa brūte krudhānvitā ..
virūpā bhramamāṇā ca sarvalokavigarhitā ..
kanyādānaphalaisteṣāṃ tatrāsāṃ ca sukhaṃ bhavet .. 77 ..
kanyakādānavighnaṃ hi vikrayaṃ vā karoti yaḥ ..
sa kanyāḥ kevalāḥ sūte na putraṃ kevalaṃ kvacit .. 78 ..
jāyaṃte tāśca baṃdhakyo vidhavā durbhagāstathā ..
kanyādānaphala prāptyā tāsāṃ saukhyaṃ prajāyate .. 79 ..
yairhṛtāni ca ratnāni tathā śāstrāṃtarāṇi ca ..
te daridrāḥ prajāyaṃte mūkāḥ khaṃjā vicakṣuṣaḥ..
teṣāṃ śāstra pradānena iha saukhyaṃ prajāyate .. 6.226.80 ..
ete tu narakāḥ proktā martyalokasamudbhavāḥ ..
etairvijñāyate sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham .. 81 ..
5.225.d:
क्षयाहे श्राद्धसंप्राप्तौ तत स्तृप्तिः प्रजायते .. 758 ..
ये प्रकुर्वंति दम्पत्योर्भेदं वै सानुरागयोः ..
परस्परमसत्यानि तेषां भार्याऽसती भवेत् .. 76 ..
एकस्मिन्वचने प्रोक्ते दश ब्रूते क्रुधान्विता ..
विरूपा भ्रममाणा च सर्वलोकविगर्हिता ..
कन्यादानफलैस्तेषां तत्रासां च सुखं भवेत् .. 77 ..
कन्यकादानविघ्नं हि विक्रयं वा करोति यः ..
स कन्याः केवलाः सूते न पुत्रं केवलं क्वचित् .. 78 ..
जायंते ताश्च बंधक्यो विधवा दुर्भगास्तथा ..
कन्यादानफल प्राप्त्या तासां सौख्यं प्रजायते .. 79 ..
यैर्हृतानि च रत्नानि तथा शास्त्रांतराणि च ..
ते दरिद्राः प्रजायंते मूकाः खंजा विचक्षुषः..
तेषां शास्त्र प्रदानेन इह सौख्यं प्रजायते .. 6.226.80 ..
एते तु नरकाः प्रोक्ता मर्त्यलोकसमुद्भवाः ..
एतैर्विज्ञायते सर्वं कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम् .. 81 ..
5.225.m:
When a śrāddha is received on the anniversary of death, satisfaction is produced thereby.
Those who cause division between an affectionate couple [by telling] / mutual untruths—their wife becomes unfaithful.
When one word is spoken, she speaks ten in anger, / misshapen, wandering about, and reviled by all people; / by the fruits of giving a maiden, happiness may arise for them there and for these [women].
He who obstructs the giving of a maiden, or sells her, / begets only daughters, never a son at all.
And they are born unchaste, widowed, and unfortunate; / through the attainment of the fruit of giving a maiden, happiness arises for them.
And those by whom jewels and sacred scriptures have been stolen / are born poor, mute, lame, and blind; / by the gift of scriptures, happiness is produced for them here.
These hells arising in the mortal world have been declared; / by these, all actions done, good and evil, are recognized.

5.225.s:
tīrthayātrāphalaistasya tataḥ śuddhiḥ prajāyate .. 82 ..
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭosmi narādhipa ..
ekaviṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca narakāṇāṃ yathā sthitam .. 83 ..
bhūyaśca pṛccha rājeṃdra saṃdeho yo hṛdi sthitaḥ .. 84 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe bhīṣmayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde tattadduritaprāpyaikaviṃśatinarakayātanātannivāraṇopāyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaradviśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ ..226 ..
5.225.d:
तीर्थयात्राफलैस्तस्य ततः शुद्धिः प्रजायते .. 82 ..
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोस्मि नराधिप ..
एकविंशत्प्रमाणं च नरकाणां यथा स्थितम् .. 83 ..
भूयश्च पृच्छ राजेंद्र संदेहो यो हृदि स्थितः .. 84 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागर खण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे भीष्मयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे तत्तद्दुरितप्राप्यैकविंशतिनरकयातनातन्निवारणोपायवर्णनंनाम षड्विंशत्युत्तरद्विशत तमोऽध्यायः ..226 ..
5.225.m:
Through the fruits of pilgrimage to sacred fords, purification is then produced for him.
Bhīṣma said: / All this has been declared to you, what I was asked, O ruler of men, / and the extent of the twenty-one hells as it stands.
Ask again, O best of kings, whatever doubt remains in your heart.
Thus ends the two hundred twenty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the torments of the twenty-one hells reached through respective sins and the means of averting them', in the Śrāddhakalpa within the dialogue between Bhīṣma and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.226.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
narakāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ ca śrutvā me bhayamāgatam ..
kathaṃ muktirbhavetteṣāṃ pāpānāmapi pārthiva ..
vratairvā niyamairvāpi homairvā tīrthasaṃśrayaiḥ .. 1 ..
5.226.d:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
नरकाणां स्वरूपं च श्रुत्वा मे भयमागतम् ..
कथं मुक्तिर्भवेत्तेषां पापानामपि पार्थिव ..
व्रतैर्वा नियमैर्वापि होमैर्वा तीर्थसंश्रयैः .. 1 ..
5.226.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Having heard the nature of the hells, fear has come upon me. / How can there be liberation for these sins, O king, / through vows, observances, oblations, or resort to sacred fords?

5.226.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
gaṃgāyāmasthipāto'tra yeṣāṃ saṃjāyate nṛṇām ..
na teṣāṃ nārako vahniḥ prabhavenmadhyavartinām .. 2 ..
5.226.d:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
गंगायामस्थिपातोऽत्र येषां संजायते नृणाम् ..
न तेषां नारको वह्निः प्रभवेन्मध्यवर्तिनाम् .. 2 ..
5.226.m: Bhīṣma said: / For those men whose bones happen to be cast into the Gaṅgā here, / the fire of hell cannot overpower them, even if they dwell in its midst.

5.226.s:
gaṃgāyāṃ kriyate śrāddhaṃ yeṣāṃ nāmnā svakaiḥ sutaiḥ ..
te vimānaṃ samāśritya prayāṃti narakopari .. .. 3 ..
5.226.d:
गंगायां क्रियते श्राद्धं येषां नाम्ना स्वकैः सुतैः ..
ते विमानं समाश्रित्य प्रयांति नरकोपरि .. .. 3 ..
5.226.m: Those in whose name a śrāddha is performed in the Gaṅgā by their own sons / board an aerial chariot and go above hell.

5.226.s:
pāpaṃ kṛtvā prakurvaṃti prāyaścittaṃ yathoditam ..
hema yacchaṃti vā bhūpa na teṣāṃ narako bhavet .. 4 ..
5.226.d:
पापं कृत्वा प्रकुर्वंति प्रायश्चित्तं यथोदितम् ..
हेम यच्छंति वा भूप न तेषां नरको भवेत् .. 4 ..
5.226.m: If, having committed a sin, they perform expiation as prescribed, / or give gold, O king, hell does not befall them.

5.226.s:
śeṣāḥ svakarmaṇaḥ prāptyā sevaṃte ca yathocitam ..
svarga vā narakaṃ vāpi sevante te narādhipa .. 5 ..
5.226.d:
शेषाः स्वकर्मणः प्राप्त्या सेवंते च यथोचितम् ..
स्वर्ग वा नरकं वापि सेवन्ते ते नराधिप .. 5 ..
5.226.m: The rest experience heaven or hell as appropriate, O ruler of men, / through the attainment of [the fruits of] their own actions.

5.226.s:
dhārātīrthe mriyaṃte ye svāminaḥ purataḥ sthitāḥ ..
te gacchaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ narakāṇāṃ sudūrataḥ .. 6 ..
5.226.d:
धारातीर्थे म्रियंते ये स्वामिनः पुरतः स्थिताः ..
ते गच्छंति परं स्थानं नरकाणां सुदूरतः .. 6 ..
5.226.m: Those who die in the sacred ford of the sword's edge, standing before their master, / go to the supreme abode, far away from the hells.

5.226.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre naimiṣe nāgare pure ..
prayāge vā prabhāse vā yastyajettanumā tmanaḥ ..
mahāpātakayukto'pi narakaṃ na sa paśyati .. 7 ..
5.226.d:
वाराणस्यां कुरुक्षेत्रे नैमिषे नागरे पुरे ..
प्रयागे वा प्रभासे वा यस्त्यजेत्तनुमा त्मनः ..
महापातकयुक्तोऽपि नरकं न स पश्यति .. 7 ..
5.226.m: He who casts off his own body in Vārāṇasī, Kurukṣetra, Naimiṣa, the city of the Nāgaras, / Prayāga, or Prabhāsa, / does not see hell, even if possessed of great sins.

5.226.s:
nīlo vā vṛṣabho yasya vivāhe saṃniyujyate ..
svaputreṇa na saṃpaśyennarakaṃ brahmahā'pi saḥ .. 8 ..
5.226.d:
नीलो वा वृषभो यस्य विवाहे संनियुज्यते ..
स्वपुत्रेण न संपश्येन्नरकं ब्रह्महाऽपि सः .. 8 ..
5.226.m: He whose son employs a dark-blue bull at his [ceremonial] marriage / does not behold hell, even if he is a slayer of a brahmin.

5.226.s:
prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā hṛdayasthe janārdane ..
yastyajetpuruṣaḥ prāṇānnarakaṃ na sa paśyati .. 9 ..
5.226.d:
प्रायोपवेशनं कृत्वा हृदयस्थे जनार्दने ..
यस्त्यजेत्पुरुषः प्राणान्नरकं न स पश्यति .. 9 ..
5.226.m: A man who casts off his vital breaths by undertaking a fast unto death, / with Janārdana situated in his heart, does not see hell.

5.226.s:
prāyopaveśanaṃ yo ca citreśvaraniveśane ..
kurvanti narakaṃ naiva te gacchaṃti kadācana .. 6.227.10 ..
5.226.d:
प्रायोपवेशनं यो च चित्रेश्वरनिवेशने ..
कुर्वन्ति नरकं नैव ते गच्छंति कदाचन .. 6.227.10 ..
5.226.m: And those who undertake a fast unto death in the abode of Citreśvara / never go to hell at all.

5.226.s:
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca pathiśramamupeyuṣām ..
tīrthayātrāparāṇāṃ ca yo yacchati sadā'śanam ..
kāle vā yadi vā'kāle narakaṃ na sa paśyati .. 11 ..
5.226.d:
दीनांधकृपणानां च पथिश्रममुपेयुषाम् ..
तीर्थयात्रापराणां च यो यच्छति सदाऽशनम् ..
काले वा यदि वाऽकाले नरकं न स पश्यति .. 11 ..
5.226.m: He who always gives food, in season or out of season, / to the distressed, the blind, the wretched, / to those fatigued by the road, and to those intent on pilgrimage, does not see hell.

5.226.s:
jaladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāddhṛṣasaṃsthe divākare ..
tiladhenuṃ mṛgasthe ca narakaṃ na sa paśyati .. 12 ..
5.226.d:
जलधेनुं च यो दद्याद्धृषसंस्थे दिवाकरे ..
तिलधेनुं मृगस्थे च नरकं न स पश्यति .. 12 ..
5.226.m: And he who gives a water-cow when the sun is in Taurus, / and a sesame-cow when it is in Capricorn, does not see hell.

5.226.s:
