some somagrahe caiva somanāthasya darśanāt ..
samudre ca sarasvatyāṃ snātvā na narakaṃ vrajet .. 13 ..
5.226.d:
सोमे सोमग्रहे चैव सोमनाथस्य दर्शनात् ..
समुद्रे च सरस्वत्यां स्नात्वा न नरकं व्रजेत् .. 13 ..
5.226.m: On a Monday, and especially during a lunar eclipse, by darśana of Somanātha / and bathing in the ocean and the Sarasvatī, one does not go to hell.

5.226.s:
sannihityāṃ kurukṣetre rāhugraste divākare ..
sūryavāreṇa yaḥ yāti narakaṃ na sa paśyati .. 14 ..
5.226.d:
सन्निहित्यां कुरुक्षेत्रे राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे ..
सूर्यवारेण यः याति नरकं न स पश्यति .. 14 ..
5.226.m: He who goes on a Sunday to the Sannihitī [pool] in Kurukṣetra / when the sun is seized by Rāhu does not see hell.

5.226.s:
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām ..
tripuṣkarasya maunena narakaṃ na sa paśyati .. 15 ..
5.226.d:
कार्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे यः करोति प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
त्रिपुष्करस्य मौनेन नरकं न स पश्यति .. 15 ..
5.226.m: He who performs circumambulation in silence of Tripuṣkara / on the full moon of Kārttika under the conjunction with Kṛttikā does not see hell.

5.226.s:
mṛgasaṃkramaṇe ye tu sūryavāreṇa saṃsthite ..
caṇḍīśaṃ vīkṣayaṃti sma na te narakagāminaḥ .. 16 ..
5.226.d:
मृगसंक्रमणे ये तु सूर्यवारेण संस्थिते ..
चण्डीशं वीक्षयंति स्म न ते नरकगामिनः .. 16 ..
5.226.m: Those who behold Caṇḍīśa at the Makara-saṅkrānti / when it occurs on a Sunday do not go to hell.

5.226.s:
gāṃ paṃkādbrāhmaṇīṃ dāsyātsādhūnstenāddvijaṃ vadhāt ..
mocayanti ca ye rājanna te narakagāminaḥ .. 17 ..
5.226.d:
गां पंकाद्ब्राह्मणीं दास्यात्साधून्स्तेनाद्द्विजं वधात् ..
मोचयन्ति च ये राजन्न ते नरकगामिनः .. 17 ..
5.226.m: And those who deliver a cow from mud, a brahmin woman from servitude, / good people from a thief, and a twice-born from murder, O king, do not go to hell.

5.226.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi narādhipa ..
yathā na narakaṃ yāti puruṣastu svakarmaṇā ..
yathā ca narakaṃ yāti svalpapāpo'pi mānavaḥ .. 18 ..
5.226.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि नराधिप ..
यथा न नरकं याति पुरुषस्तु स्वकर्मणा ..
यथा च नरकं याति स्वल्पपापोऽपि मानवः .. 18 ..
5.226.m: All this has been explained to you, as I was asked, O ruler of men: / how a person does not go to hell by his own action, / and how a man, even with slight sin, goes to hell.

5.226.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe bhīṣmayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde narakayātanānirasanopāyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 227 ..
5.226.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागर खण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे भीष्मयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे नरकयातनानिरसनोपायवर्णनंनाम सप्तविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 227 ..
5.226.m: Thus ends the two hundred twenty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Means to Avert the Torments of Hell' in the dialogue between Bhīṣma and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Rules for Śrāddha, in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.227.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyacca biladvāri śayanārthe vyavasthitam ..
dṛṣṭvā pramucyate pāpī devaṃ ca jalaśāyinam .. 1 ..
5.227.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यच्च बिलद्वारि शयनार्थे व्यवस्थितम् ..
दृष्ट्वा प्रमुच्यते पापी देवं च जलशायिनम् .. 1 ..
5.227.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, having seen the god lying upon the waters, situated for sleeping at the mouth of the cavern, / another sinner is completely freed [from sin].

5.227.s:
snātvā tasminbiladvāre pavitre lokasaṃśraye ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā śeṣaparyaṃkaśāyinam ..
ājanmamaraṇātpāpātsa ca muktimavāpnuyāt .. 2 ..
5.227.d:
स्नात्वा तस्मिन्बिलद्वारे पवित्रे लोकसंश्रये ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या शेषपर्यंकशायिनम् ..
आजन्ममरणात्पापात्स च मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् .. 2 ..
5.227.m: Having bathed at that mouth of the cavern, holy and a refuge for the worlds, / he who worships with devotion him who lies on the couch of Śeṣa, / attains liberation from the sins of a lifetime.

5.227.s:
caturo vārṣikānmāsānsuprasuptaṃ sureśvaram..
saṃpūjayati yo bhaktyā na sa bhūyo'tra jāyate .. 3 ..
5.227.d:
चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्सुप्रसुप्तं सुरेश्वरम्..
संपूजयति यो भक्त्या न स भूयोऽत्र जायते .. 3 ..
5.227.m: He who with devotion fully worships the lord of the gods soundly asleep / during the four months of the rainy season is not born here again.

5.227.s:
tatra pūrvaṃ mahābhāgā munayaḥ sevya taṃ prabhum ..
mṛttikāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā tasya cāyatane śubhe .. 4 ..
5.227.d:
तत्र पूर्वं महाभागा मुनयः सेव्य तं प्रभुम् ..
मृत्तिकाग्रहणं कृत्वा तस्य चायतने शुभे .. 4 ..
5.227.m: There in ancient times, highly fortunate sages served that lord, / and having taken soil in his auspicious shrine,

5.227.s:
saṃprāptāḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ tadriṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ..
yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ tasya pūjāyāṃ cāturmāsyāṃ prajāyate .. 5 ..
5.227.d:
संप्राप्ताः परमं स्थानं तद्रिष्णोः परमं पदम् ..
यत्फलं सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं तस्य पूजायां चातुर्मास्यां प्रजायते .. 5 ..
5.227.m: they attained the highest state, that supreme abode of Viṣṇu. / Whatever fruit is in all sacred fords, whatever fruit in all sacrifices, / that fruit arises from worshipping him during the four months [of the rainy season].

5.227.s:
yatphalaṃ gograhe mṛtyuṃ saṃprāptā yāṃti mānavāḥ ..
tatphalaṃ caturo māsānpūjayā jalaśāyinaḥ .. 6 ..
5.227.d:
यत्फलं गोग्रहे मृत्युं संप्राप्ता यांति मानवाः ..
तत्फलं चतुरो मासान्पूजया जलशायिनः .. 6 ..
5.227.m: Whatever fruit men obtain who meet death during the seizure of cows, / that fruit is obtained by four months of worship of the one who lies upon the water.

5.227.s:
api pāpasamācāraḥ paradārarato'pica ..
brahmaghno'pi surāpo'pi strīhantā'pi vigarhitaḥ ..
pūjayā caturo māsāṃstasya devasya mucyate .. 7 ..
5.227.d:
अपि पापसमाचारः परदाररतोऽपिच ..
ब्रह्मघ्नोऽपि सुरापोऽपि स्त्रीहन्ताऽपि विगर्हितः ..
पूजया चतुरो मासांस्तस्य देवस्य मुच्यते .. 7 ..
5.227.m: Even a person of sinful conduct, one devoted to another's wife, / a slayer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, and a despised slayer of women, / is freed by worshipping that god for four months.

5.227.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ tatrasthaṃ jalaśāyinam ..
biladvāre kathaṃ sūta tatra naḥ saṃśayo mahān .. 8 ..
5.227.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं तत्रस्थं जलशायिनम् ..
बिलद्वारे कथं सूत तत्र नः संशयो महान् .. 8 ..
5.227.m: The seers said: / Regarding what was spoken by you of him who lies upon the water staying there: / how is he at the mouth of the cavern, O Sūta? In that matter our doubt is great.

5.227.s:
sa kila śrūyate devaḥ kṣīrābdhau madhusūdanaḥ ..
sadaiva bhagavāñchete yoganidrāṃ samāśritaḥ . 9 ...
5.227.d:
स किल श्रूयते देवः क्षीराब्धौ मधुसूदनः ..
सदैव भगवाञ्छेते योगनिद्रां समाश्रितः . 9 ...
5.227.m: Indeed, that god, Madhusūdana, is heard to be in the Ocean of Milk; / the Lord lies ever resorting to yogic sleep.

5.227.s:
kathaṃ sa bhagavāñchete biladvāre vyavasthitaḥ ..
etatkīrtaya kārtsnyena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 6.228.10 ..
5.227.d:
कथं स भगवाञ्छेते बिलद्वारे व्यवस्थितः ..
एतत्कीर्तय कार्त्स्न्येन परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 6.228.10 ..
5.227.m: How does that Lord lie stationed at the mouth of the cavern? / Recount this completely, for our curiosity is supreme.

5.227.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāgāḥ kṣīrābdhau madhusūdanaḥ ..
yoganidrāṃ gataḥ śete śeṣaparyaṃkaśā yakaḥ .. 11 ..
5.227.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभागाः क्षीराब्धौ मधुसूदनः ..
योगनिद्रां गतः शेते शेषपर्यंकशा यकः .. 11 ..
5.227.m: Sūta said: / This is true, O highly fortunate ones: in the Ocean of Milk, Madhusūdana, / resting on the couch of Śeṣa, lies gone into yogic sleep.

5.227.s:
sa yathā tatra kṣetre tu saṃśrito bhagavānsvayam ..
jalaśāyisvarūpeṇa tacchṛśudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ 12 ..
5.227.d:
स यथा तत्र क्षेत्रे तु संश्रितो भगवान्स्वयम् ..
जलशायिस्वरूपेण तच्छृशुध्वं समाहिताः 12 ..
5.227.m: Hear with concentrated minds how the Lord himself resorted to that sacred field / in the form of the one who lies upon the water,

5.227.s:
yathā ca caturo māsānpūjitastatra saṃsthitaḥ ..
muktiṃ dadāti puṃsāṃ sa tathā saṃkīrtayāmyaham .. 13 ..
5.227.d:
यथा च चतुरो मासान्पूजितस्तत्र संस्थितः ..
मुक्तिं ददाति पुंसां स तथा संकीर्तयाम्यहम् .. 13 ..
5.227.m: and how, staying there, worshipped for four months, / he grants liberation to men; thus I shall narrate.

5.227.s:
catvāro'pi yathā māsā garhaṇīyā dharātale ..
sarvakarmasu mukhyeṣu yajñodvā hādiṣu dvijāḥ .. 14 ..
5.227.d:
चत्वारोऽपि यथा मासा गर्हणीया धरातले ..
सर्वकर्मसु मुख्येषु यज्ञोद्वा हादिषु द्विजाः .. 14 ..
5.227.m: And how the four months on the surface of the earth are censured / in all principal undertakings, such as sacrifices and marriages, O twice-born,

5.227.s:
tadvo'haṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi namaskṛtya dvijotamāḥ ..
tasmai devādhidevāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane .. 15 ..
5.227.d:
तद्वोऽहं कीर्तयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्य द्विजोतमाः ..
तस्मै देवाधिदेवाय निर्गुणाय गुणात्मने .. 15 ..
5.227.m: that I shall recount to you, O best of the twice-born, having bowed / to that god over the gods, devoid of qualities yet the soul of all qualities,

5.227.s:
avyaktāyā'prameyāya sarvadevamayāya ca ..
sarvajñāya kavīśāya sarvabhūtātmane tathā .. 16 ..
5.227.d:
अव्यक्तायाऽप्रमेयाय सर्वदेवमयाय च ..
सर्वज्ञाय कवीशाय सर्वभूतात्मने तथा .. 16 ..
5.227.m: unmanifest, immeasurable, consisting of all gods, / all-knowing, the lord of poets, and the soul of all beings.

5.227.s:
purāsīddānavo raudro hiraṇyakaśipurmahān ..
nārasiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā viṣṇunā yo nipātitaḥ .. 17 ..
5.227.d:
पुरासीद्दानवो रौद्रो हिरण्यकशिपुर्महान् ..
नारसिंहं वपुः कृत्वा विष्णुना यो निपातितः .. 17 ..
5.227.m: Formerly there was a terrible and great Dānava, Hiraṇyakaśipu, / who was struck down by Viṣṇu having assumed a man-lion form.

5.227.s:
tasya putradvayaṃ jajñe sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam ..
prahlādaścāṃdhakaścaiva vīryeṇāpratimau yudhi .. 19 ..
hiraṇyakaśipau prāpte paraṃ lokaṃ mahāsure ..
amātyairabhiṣekāya prahlādaḥ sa niyojitaḥ .. 19 ..
5.227.d:
तस्य पुत्रद्वयं जज्ञे सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् ..
प्रह्लादश्चांधकश्चैव वीर्येणाप्रतिमौ युधि .. 19 ..
हिरण्यकशिपौ प्राप्ते परं लोकं महासुरे ..
अमात्यैरभिषेकाय प्रह्लादः स नियोजितः .. 19 ..
5.227.m:
Two sons were born to him, endowed with all auspicious marks: / Prahlāda and Andhaka, peerless in prowess in battle.
When the great Asura Hiraṇyakaśipu had gone to the other world, / that Prahlāda was appointed by the ministers for consecration.

5.227.s:
sa naicchata tadā rājyaṃ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat..
samāgatamapi prājño yasmāttadvo vadāmyaham .. 6.228.20 ..
5.227.d:
स नैच्छत तदा राज्यं पितृपैतामहं महत्..
समागतमपि प्राज्ञो यस्मात्तद्वो वदाम्यहम् .. 6.228.20 ..
5.227.m: The wise one then did not desire that great ancestral kingdom, / even when it had come to him; I shall tell you why.

5.227.s:
dānavānāṃ sadā dveṣo devena saha cakriṇā ..
na karoti punardveṣaṃ taṃ samuddiśya sarvadā .. .. 21 ..
5.227.d:
दानवानां सदा द्वेषो देवेन सह चक्रिणा ..
न करोति पुनर्द्वेषं तं समुद्दिश्य सर्वदा .. .. 21 ..
5.227.m: The Dānavas' hostility is always with the discus-bearing god; / he, on the other hand, never harbored hostility toward him.

5.227.s:
etasmātkāraṇātsarve tena tyaktā diteḥ sutāḥ ..
svarājyamapi saṃtyajya viṣṇustena samāśritaḥ .. 22 ..
5.227.d:
एतस्मात्कारणात्सर्वे तेन त्यक्ता दितेः सुताः ..
स्वराज्यमपि संत्यज्य विष्णुस्तेन समाश्रितः .. 22 ..
5.227.m: For this reason, all the sons of Diti were abandoned by him; / having renounced even his own kingdom, he took refuge in Viṣṇu.

5.227.s:
tatastairdānavaiḥ kṣudrairviṣṇudveṣaparāyaṇaiḥ ..
andhakaḥ sthāpito rājye pitṛpaitāmahe tadā .. 23 ..
5.227.d:
ततस्तैर्दानवैः क्षुद्रैर्विष्णुद्वेषपरायणैः ..
अन्धकः स्थापितो राज्ये पितृपैतामहे तदा .. 23 ..
5.227.m: Then by those vile Dānavas devoted to hostility toward Viṣṇu, / Andhaka was installed at that time in the ancestral kingdom.

5.227.s:
andhako'pi samārādhya devadevaṃ caturmukham..
amaratvaṃ tato lebhe yāvaccandrārkatārakam .. 24 ..
5.227.d:
अन्धकोऽपि समाराध्य देवदेवं चतुर्मुखम्..
अमरत्वं ततो लेभे यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम् .. 24 ..
5.227.m: Andhaka, too, having propitiated the four-faced god of gods, / obtained immortality from him as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure.

5.227.s: varapuṣṭastataḥ so'pi cakre śakreṇa vigraham .. 25 ..
5.227.d: वरपुष्टस्ततः सोऽपि चक्रे शक्रेण विग्रहम् .. 25 ..
5.227.m: Strengthened by that boon, he then waged war with Śakra.

5.227.s:
jitvā śakraṃ mahāsaṃkhye yajñāṃśāñjagṛhe svayam ..
gatvā'marāvatīṃ daityo niḥsārya ca śatakratum ..
svavargeṇa samopetaḥ svargaṃ samaharattadā .. 26 ..
5.227.d:
जित्वा शक्रं महासंख्ये यज्ञांशाञ्जगृहे स्वयम् ..
गत्वाऽमरावतीं दैत्यो निःसार्य च शतक्रतुम् ..
स्ववर्गेण समोपेतः स्वर्गं समहरत्तदा .. 26 ..
5.227.m: Having conquered Śakra in great battle, he personally seized the sacrificial portions; / having gone to Amarāvatī and driven out Śatakratu, / the Daitya, accompanied by his host, then seized heaven.

5.227.s:
śakro'pi ca samārādhya śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram ..
sarvadevasamopeto bhṛtyavatparivartate ..27..
5.227.d:
शक्रोऽपि च समाराध्य शंकरं लोकशंकरम् ..
सर्वदेवसमोपेतो भृत्यवत्परिवर्तते ..27..
5.227.m: Śakra too, having propitiated Śaṃkara, who brings peace to the world, / lived like a servant, accompanied by all the gods.

5.227.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tasya tuṣṭaḥ pinākadhṛk ..
taṃ prāha varado'smīti vada śakra karomi kim .. 28 ..
5.227.d:
ततः कालेन महता तस्य तुष्टः पिनाकधृक् ..
तं प्राह वरदोऽस्मीति वद शक्र करोमि किम् .. 28 ..
5.227.m: Then after a long time, the wielder of the Pināka, pleased with him, / said to him: 'I grant a boon; say, Śakra, what shall I do?'

5.227.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
aṃdhakena hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mama vīryātsureśvara ..
yajñabhāgaiḥ samopetaṃ hatvā''śu tatprayaccha me ..29..
5.227.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
अंधकेन हृतं राज्यं मम वीर्यात्सुरेश्वर ..
यज्ञभागैः समोपेतं हत्वा'ऽशु तत्प्रयच्छ मे ..29..
5.227.m: Indra said: / 'My kingdom, together with the sacrificial portions, has been taken by Andhaka / through his might, O Lord of gods; having quickly slain him, give it to me.'

5.227.s:
tacchrutvā tasya dīnasya bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ ..
provāca tava dāsyāmi rājyaṃ trailokyasaṃbhavam .. 6.228.30 ..
5.227.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य दीनस्य भगवाञ्छशिशेखरः ..
प्रोवाच तव दास्यामि राज्यं त्रैलोक्यसंभवम् .. 6.228.30 ..
5.227.m: Hearing that from him, distressed, the crescent-crested Lord / said: 'I shall give you the sovereignty over the three worlds.'

5.227.s:
tataḥ saṃpreṣayāmāsa dūtaṃ tasya vicakṣaṇam ..
gaṇeśaṃ vīrabhadrākhyaṃ gatvā taṃ brūhi cāṃdhakam .. 31 ..
5.227.d:
ततः संप्रेषयामास दूतं तस्य विचक्षणम् ..
गणेशं वीरभद्राख्यं गत्वा तं ब्रूहि चांधकम् .. 31 ..
5.227.m: Then he sent his discerning messenger, / the leader of the Gaṇas named Vīrabhadra, [saying]: 'Go and say to that Andhaka:

5.227.s:
mamādeśātparityajya svargaṃ gaccha dharātalam ..
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ sthānaṃ rājyaṃ tatra samācara .. 32 ..
5.227.d:
ममादेशात्परित्यज्य स्वर्गं गच्छ धरातलम् ..
पितृपैतामहं स्थानं राज्यं तत्र समाचर .. 32 ..
5.227.m: 'By my command, having abandoned heaven, go to the surface of the earth; / conduct your rule there, the ancestral abode;

5.227.s:
parityajasva yajñāṃśānno ceddhaṃtāsmi satvaram ..
sa gatvā cāṃdhakaṃ prāha yathoktaṃ śaṃbhunā sphuṭam .. 33 ..
5.227.d:
परित्यजस्व यज्ञांशान्नो चेद्धंतास्मि सत्वरम् ..
स गत्वा चांधकं प्राह यथोक्तं शंभुना स्फुटम् .. 33 ..
5.227.m: relinquish the sacrificial portions; if not, I shall quickly slay you.' / Having gone, he spoke clearly to Andhaka just as was said by Śambhu,

5.227.s:
saviśeṣamahābuddhiḥ svāmikāryaprasiddhaye ..
atha taṃ cādhakaḥ prāha pravihasya mahābalaḥ .. .. 34 ..
5.227.d:
सविशेषमहाबुद्धिः स्वामिकार्यप्रसिद्धये ..
अथ तं चाधकः प्राह प्रविहस्य महाबलः .. .. 34 ..
5.227.m: endowed with extraordinary great intellect, to achieve his master's task. / Then the mighty Andhaka laughed and said to him:

5.227.s:
avadhyo hi yathā dūtastena tvāṃ na nihanmyaham ..
ka syādvai śaṃkaronāma yo māmevaṃ prabhāṣate .. 35 ..
5.227.d:
अवध्यो हि यथा दूतस्तेन त्वां न निहन्म्यहम् ..
क स्याद्वै शंकरोनाम यो मामेवं प्रभाषते .. 35 ..
5.227.m: 'Since an envoy is not to be slain, I do not kill you. / Who might this Śaṃkara be, who speaks to me thus?

5.227.s: na māṃ vetti sa kiṃ mūḍhaḥ kiṃ vā mṛtyu mabhīpsate . 36 ..
5.227.d: न मां वेत्ति स किं मूढः किं वा मृत्यु मभीप्सते . 36 ..
5.227.m: Does that fool not know me, or does he desire death?

5.227.s:
athavā satyamevaitānnirviṇṇo jīvitācca saḥ..
daridropahato nityaṃ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ .. 37 ..
5.227.d:
अथवा सत्यमेवैतान्निर्विण्णो जीविताच्च सः..
दरिद्रोपहतो नित्यं सर्वभोगविवर्जितः .. 37 ..
5.227.m: Or is this truly so: he is weary of life, / perpetually afflicted by poverty, bereft of all pleasures,

5.227.s:
smaśāne krīḍanaṃ yasya bhasma gātravilepanam ..
bhūṣaṇaṃ cāhayo vastraṃ diśo yasya jaṭālakā .. 38 ..
5.227.d:
स्मशाने क्रीडनं यस्य भस्म गात्रविलेपनम् ..
भूषणं चाहयो वस्त्रं दिशो यस्य जटालका .. 38 ..
5.227.m: whose playground is the cremation ground, whose body ointment is ashes, / whose ornaments are serpents, whose garment is the directions, and whose matted locks are his curls?'

5.227.s:
kastasya jīvitenārthastenedaṃ māṃ bravīti saḥ..
tasmādgatvā drutaṃ brūhi madvākyaṃ dūta sasphuṭam.. 39 ..
5.227.d:
कस्तस्य जीवितेनार्थस्तेनेदं मां ब्रवीति सः..
तस्माद्गत्वा द्रुतं ब्रूहि मद्वाक्यं दूत सस्फुटम्.. 39 ..
5.227.m: "What purpose has he in living, that he says this to me? / Therefore, go swiftly, messenger, and speak my words clearly: 39

5.227.s:
tyaktvā kailāsamenaṃ tvaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ tapaḥ kuru ..
mayā sthānamidaṃ dattaṃ kailāsaṃ svasutasya ca .. 6.228.40 ..
5.227.d:
त्यक्त्वा कैलासमेनं त्वं वाराणस्यां तपः कुरु ..
मया स्थानमिदं दत्तं कैलासं स्वसुतस्य च .. 6.228.40 ..
5.227.m: ‘Leaving this Kailāsa, do austerity in Vārāṇasī. / I have granted this place, Kailāsa, to my son, 40

5.227.s:
vṛkasyāpi na sandeho vibhavena samanvitam ..
no cetprāṇānhariṣyāmi seṃdrasya tava śaṃkara .. 41 ..
5.227.d:
वृकस्यापि न सन्देहो विभवेन समन्वितम् ..
नो चेत्प्राणान्हरिष्यामि सेंद्रस्य तव शंकर .. 41 ..
5.227.m: and to Vṛka, endued with glory—of this there is no doubt. / Otherwise, Śaṃkara, I will take your life along with Indra’s!’" 41

5.227.s:
tacchrutvā vīrabhadrastu nirbhartsya ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
krodhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ kailāsaṃ samupāviśat.. 42 ..
5.227.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वीरभद्रस्तु निर्भर्त्स्य च मुहुर्मुहुः ..
क्रोधेन महताविष्टः कैलासं समुपाविशत्.. 42 ..
5.227.m: Hearing that, Vīrabhadra, repeatedly rebuking [him] / and seized by intense rage, entered Kailāsa. 42

5.227.s:
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa tadvākyaṃ ca pinākinaḥ ..
atikrūraṃ viśeṣeṇa tata kruddhaḥ pinākadhṛk .. 43 ..
5.227.d:
ततः स कथयामास तद्वाक्यं च पिनाकिनः ..
अतिक्रूरं विशेषेण तत क्रुद्धः पिनाकधृक् .. 43 ..
5.227.m: Then he reported those words to Pinākin, / [which were] exceedingly harsh; thereupon the wielder of the Pināka became enraged. 43

5.227.s: iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyupākhyāne brahmadattavarapradānoddhatāndhakāsurakṛtaśaṃkarājñāva mānanavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 228 ..
5.227.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जलशाय्युपाख्याने ब्रह्मदत्तवरप्रदानोद्धतान्धकासुरकृतशंकराज्ञाव माननवर्णनंनामाष्टाविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 228 ..
5.227.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-eighth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Disrespect to Śaṃkara's Command Committed by the Demon Andhaka, Who Was Arrogant Because of the Boon Granted by Brahmā," in the narration of Jalaśāyin, in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the sixth [section], the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 228
